description:
# ******Job Description Summary******

The Quality Inspector is responsible for supporting quality control activities on gas turbine components, including in-process quality inspection, final quality inspection, final report creation, and packing inspection processes. This role ensures that product quality requirements are met throughout the manufacturing and final preparation stages in accordance with approved work instructions, specifications, engineering requirements, and quality standards.  
In addition to executing inspection activities accurately and consistently, this role is expected to demonstrate strong Lean behaviors, actively support problem solving, maintain 5S standards, contribute to root cause analysis (RCA), raise quality concerns, initiate NCRs when required, and support overall quality control across the line. The Quality Inspector plays an important role in driving overall Lean implementation by identifying improvement opportunities, supporting standard work, reducing waste, and helping improve process flow and operational performance.

# **Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform **Quality Inspection** in accordance with approved work instructions, quality plans, and process requirements.
* Review and verify **Final Reports** for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with quality requirements.
* Raise quality concerns in a timely manner and escalate issues that may impact product quality, process compliance, or customer requirements.
* Initiate and support NCR (Non-Conformance Report) activities as required to document and control nonconforming product or process conditions.
* Contribute to root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective action activities to address recurring or significant quality issues.
* Support overall quality control by ensuring inspection discipline, process compliance, and adherence to quality standards across the line.
* Read and interpret work instructions, quality forms, technical documentation, specifications, and engineering drawings to ensure accurate inspection execution.
* Record and maintain accurate inspection results, quality findings, and supporting documentation as required.
* Use inspection tools, gauges, measuring devices, and related equipment safely and effectively.
* Identify nonconforming conditions and support containment, documentation, escalation, and follow-up actions as required.
* Adhere to Standard Work and Standard Work Combination Sheets to ensure consistency, quality, safety, and efficient line flow.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work area in accordance with 5S standards.
* Demonstrate strong understanding and application of Lean principles in daily work activities.
* Actively participate in problem solving, root cause analysis, and corrective action activities to address quality or process issues.
* Identify and communicate opportunities for continuous improvement in safety, quality, cycle time, flow, and waste reduction.
* Support improvements in standard work, line organization, visual management, and process discipline to strengthen overall Lean implementation.
* Contribute to team efforts that improve line performance, operational efficiency, and overall shop productivity.
* Work within takt time, cycle time, and standard process flow expectations to support production goals.
* Use shop floor systems and interfaces such as ELM, SmartShop, and MyAndon as required.
* Comply with company quality policies, safety requirements, applicable procedures, and standard work.

**Required Qualifications**

* Diploma, technical college degree, or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Knowledge or experience in welding quality inspection.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Min 2 years’ experience working with gas turbine components or other precision aerospace/industrial parts.
* NDT License is a plus

# ******Additional Information******

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

  

Addressing the climate crisis is an urgent global priority and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our singular mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify the world while simultaneously working to help decarbonize it.

If we want our energy future to be different…we must be different.

Our mission is embedded in our name. We retain our treasured legacy, “GE,” in our name as an enduring and hard-earned badge of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” / “verde” signal Earth’s verdant and lush ecosystems. “Nova,” from the Latin “novus,” nods to a new, innovative era of lower carbon energy that GE Vernova will help deliver.

Together, we have The Energy to Change the World. [www.gevernova.com](http://www.gevernova.com/)

## Company Description

**Work Force** is a leading sourcing and recruitment firm, dedicated to delivering exceptional talent solutions to top-tier hospitality and restaurant groups across Saudi Arabia. With a strong reputation for quality, efficiency, and reliability, we partner with clients to meet their workforce needs and support their operational excellence.

## Job Description

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Technician to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to our organization's technical operations and maintenance efforts.

* Perform installation, maintenance, and repair of various technical equipment and systems
* Read and interpret technical diagrams, schematics, and manuals to guide work processes
* Conduct regular inspections and preventive maintenance on equipment to ensure optimal performance
* Troubleshoot and diagnose technical issues, implementing effective solutions in a timely manner
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical problems
* Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of all work performed, including repairs, maintenance, and installations
* Adhere to all safety protocols and procedures while performing technical tasks
* Assist in the training and mentoring of junior technicians as needed
* Manage inventory of tools, parts, and supplies, ensuring adequate stock for ongoing operations
* Stay updated on the latest technological advancements and industry best practices

## Qualifications

* Associate's degree in a relevant technical field or equivalent work experience
* Proven experience as a technician in a similar role, with a strong mechanical aptitude
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting technical diagrams, schematics, and manuals
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship
* Ability to work efficiently and organize tasks effectively
* Proficient in using hand tools and technical equipment safely and accurately
* Basic computer skills for record-keeping, reporting, and communication
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
* Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and work schedules
* Physical ability to lift up to 50 pounds and work in various positions (standing, kneeling, crouching)
* Willingness and ability to work in hot climate conditions (specific to Riyadh location)
* Valid driver's license and clean driving record may be required
* Industry-specific certifications are a plus

## Additional Information

* Competitive salary package
* Professional and supportive work environment
* Opportunities for growth within a reputed brand.

description:
Position Summary  
  
The Senior Resident Quality Engineer is the primary representative at the customer manufacturing plant in Saudi Arabia. The position acts as the direct interface between the customer and the supplying plants in the Europe and China, ensuring customer satisfaction during launch and serial production.  
  
The role focuses on customer quality management, issue resolution, launch support, and proactive communication to prevent disruptions at the customer assembly plant.  
  
  
  
Main Responsibilities  
  
Customer Interface  
  
Act as the first point of contact for all quality-related matters at the customer.  
  
Develop and maintain strong working relationships with customer  
  
Participate in daily production and quality meetings at the customer site.  
  
Represent professionally and ensure timely communication of customer expectations and concerns.  
  
Quality Management  
  
Problem Solving & Escalation  
  
Launch & Serial Production Support  
  
Reporting & Communication  
  
Provide regular quality performance reports and escalation updates to management.  
  
Ensure efficient communication between Lucid and the supplying plants.  
  
Share lessons learned and customer feedback throughout the organization.  

* * *

Qualifications  
  
Minimum 7 years of experience in Automotive Quality.  
  
Previous experience as Resident Engineer, Customer Quality Engineer, Supplier Quality Engineer, or Plant Quality Engineer.  
  
Proven experience managing OEM customer relationships.  
  
Experience supporting new product launches and serial production.  
  
Experience in the automotive glazing industry is highly preferred.  
  
Technical Skills  
  
Strong knowledge of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and 8D methodology.  
  
Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills.  
  
Knowledge of IATF 16949 requirements.  
  
Understanding of automotive glass manufacturing processes (bending, lamination, coating, encapsulation, assembly) is a strong advantage.  
  
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and customer specifications.  
  
Languages  
  
Fluent Arabic (mandatory).  
  
Fluent English (mandatory).  
  
Additional language skills are considered an advantage.  
  
Personal Competencies  
  
Strong customer focus and relationship-building capabilities.  
  
Excellent communication and negotiation skills.  
  
High level of autonomy and accountability.  
  
Strong sense of urgency and responsiveness.  
  
Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and international environment.  
  
Strong coordination, escalation management, and decision-making skills.

job_title: Restaurant Manager - Mediterranean - Raffles The Red Sea
description:
## Company Description

Raffles & Fairmont the Red Sea, positioned in the kingdom's groundbreaking Red Sea Project, will provide visitors access to two nature-focused resorts. With 361 rooms, 11 distinct dining concepts, including overwater restaurant with views of the Red Sea and the mangroves, and a Spa.

**Raffles The Red Sea** will be a sanctuary of refined elegance and timeless luxury, nestled within Saudi Arabia’s extraordinary Red Sea destination. Blending Raffles’ legendary graciousness and personalized service with the natural beauty and sustainability ethos of Red Sea Global, the property offers a curated haven for the world’s most discerning travellers.

## Job Description

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Supervision & Quality Assurance:**

* Oversee the daily operations of the Mediterranean restaurant, ensuring a seamless, intuitive, and refined service experience in alignment with Raffles standards of excellence.
* Ensure the restaurant environment reflects the rich heritage and multicultural identity of Mediterranean cuisine, blending elegance with vibrant authenticity in ambiance, presentation, and service flow.
* Conduct daily briefings and meticulous inspections to ensure consistency in food quality, service rituals, cleanliness, and attention to detail.
* Maintain strict control of inventory, sourcing, and cost management, ensuring the use of authentic ingredients while optimizing efficiency and minimizing waste.
* Ensure full compliance with HACCP standards, local regulations, and Raffles operational policies.

**Guest Experience & Service Excellence:**

* Curate a soulful and immersive Mediterranean dining journey, where each guest experience is personalized, memorable, and emotionally engaging.
* Bring dishes to life through storytelling, sharing the heritage, cultural influences, and inspirations behind each offering, reflecting the Mediterranean's diverse culinary identity.
* Anticipate guest needs with intuition and grace, ensuring seamless service delivery that feels both effortless and bespoke.
* Handle guest feedback and service recovery with empathy, discretion, and a commitment to turning moments into lasting impressions.
* Build meaningful relationships with guests, recognizing preferences and creating a sense of belonging that encourages return visits.

**Team Leadership & Development:**

* Lead and inspire a team of Heartists®, fostering a culture of passion, pride, and excellence in every interaction.
* Coach and develop team members on service artistry, Mediterranean cuisine knowledge, and personalized guest engagement.
* Embed Raffles service culture through continuous training, storytelling, and role modeling of brand values.
* Ensure high standards of grooming, professionalism, and emotional intelligence within the team.
* Support talent development, succession planning, and the growth of future leaders within the Raffles family.

**Financial Performance & Commercial Focus:**

* Drive revenue growth through strategic upselling, promotions, and optimization of average check value.
* Monitor financial performance, including revenue, labor costs, and cost of sales, ensuring alignment with budget targets.
* Prepare forecasts, analyze trends, and implement action plans to improve profitability.
* Collaborate with marketing and events teams to promote the Mediterranean restaurant through campaigns, activations, and partnerships.
* Ensure accurate billing, cash handling, and compliance with financial procedures.

**Brand, Culture & Pre-Opening Excellence:**

* Bring to life the spirit of Raffles through the restaurant concept, blending timeless elegance with the vibrant soul of Mediterranean cuisine.
* Support pre-opening initiatives including recruitment, onboarding, training programs, and the creation of bespoke service rituals.
* Contribute to the development of SOPs, guest journey mapping, and service choreography aligned with Raffles standards.
* Champion a culture of belonging, creativity, and excellence, where every team member contributes to creating “magic".
* Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure a seamless and elevated guest journey across all touchpoints.

**Health, Safety & Compliance:**

* Ensure adherence to all health, safety, and hygiene standards in line with local regulations and company policies.
* Conduct regular audits and ensure corrective actions are implemented promptly.
* Promote a safe working environment for colleagues and guests at all times.

## Qualifications

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Hospitality Management, Food & Beverage, or a related field.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in a luxury hotel or high-end restaurant, with exposure to Mediterranean cuisine preferred.
* Strong understanding of luxury service standards and guest engagement.
* Pre-opening experience is highly advantageous.

**Competencies:**

* Inspirational leadership with a passion for people development
* Deep appreciation for Mediterranean cuisine and cultural storytelling
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong commercial awareness and financial acumen
* Attention to detail with a commitment to excellence
* Emotional intelligence and ability to create meaningful guest connections

## Additional Information

* Strong understanding of Raffles & Fairmont service culture and emotional luxury philosophy.
* A proactive and anticipatory approach to guest service, ensuring every moment is meaningful and memorable.
* Impeccable grooming and personal presentation aligned with ultra-luxury standards.
* Flexibility to work shifts, including weekends and public holidays.

description:
Pinnacle Solutions is looking for a Field Service Representative to work in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. The Field Service Representative (FSR) provides conventional maintenance support for Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) associated support equipment at designated locations within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This position supports a level-of-effort (LOE), best-effort maintenance construct focused on sustaining operational readiness of tactical vehicles, generators, and material handling equipment. The FSR operates as an in-country resource assigned to a specific site and performs maintenance in accordance with applicable OEM Technical Manuals (TMs) and Technical Bulletins (TBs) under Foreign Military Sales (FMS) program requirements.
To join our team of outstanding professionals, apply today!
Responsibilities
+ Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on assigned equipment in accordance with OEM technical guidance.
+ Maintain and repair:
+ Heavy tactical wheeled vehicles (HEMTT family).
+ Trailers and battery support equipment.
+ Material Handling Equipment (MHE), including rough terrain and multi-directional forklifts
+ Power generation systems, including HDT DRASH generators and 5kW HEMTT-mounted generators (Kubota/Cummins variants).
+ Conduct scheduled maintenance services (semi-annual and annual).
+ Execute diagnostics, troubleshooting, and fault isolation across mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic system.
+ Perform component-level repair and replacement (e.g., starters, alternators, fuel system components, belts, filters, and electrical assemblies).
+ Conduct inspections, testing, and adjustments to ensure equipment serviceability and operational readiness.
+ Utilize Technical Manuals (TMs) and maintenance documentation to ensure compliance with established standards.
+ Maintain accurate maintenance records and provide status updates as required.
+ Operate independently as the sole FSR at assigned location and coordinate maintenance priorities with supported units.
+ Support mission requirements through flexible work hours as needed to maintain equipment readiness.
Qualifications
+ Trained and qualified in accordance with 91B Wheeled Vehicle Mechanic or equivalent military/commercial certification.
+ 8–15 years of relevant maintenance experience supporting tactical or commercial heavy equipment.
+ Demonstrated experience with:
+ Diesel engine maintenance and repair.
+ Powertrain systems (transmissions, differentials, transfer cases).
+ Hydraulic and electrical system troubleshooting.
+ Preventive Maintenance Checks and Services (PMCS).
+ Ability to perform maintenance using OEM Technical Manuals and standard procedures.
+ Experience working independently in field or OCONUS environments.
Preferred Qualifications:
+ Prior experience supporting THAAD or similar defense systems.
+ Previous Field Service Representative (FSR) or Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) experience.
+ Familiarity with HEMTT platforms, MHE, and military support equipment.
+ Experience supporting programs in Saudi Arabia or similar operational environments.
+ Experience with generator maintenance and power generation systems.
+ Knowledge of air conditioning repair and maintenance principles.
+ Saudi Nationals preferred.
Additional Requirements:
+ Ability to meet medical, security, and deployment requirements for in-country assignment.
+ Ability to work in austere or remote environments with limited external support.
+ Must be capable of lifting, carrying, and operating maintenance equipment and tools as required.
+ Willingness to support extended hours based on mission requirements.

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Purchasing and Receiving Clerk, you’re not just purchasing goods for the hotel – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:
Support procurement operations: Assist with purchasing materials and supplies, researching prices, and ensuring compliance with purchasing policies and procedures
Process and verify deliveries: Accept all purchased products, ensuring accuracy by checking deliveries against purchase orders, invoices, and specifications

## Company Description

SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over 2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries, supported by a team of 99,500 dedicated professionals. With over 145 years of service excellence, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve the highest standards of quality, compliance, and sustainability.

## Job Description

* Perform “Hold”, “Witness” and “Surveillance” inspections and tests at manufacturing facilities or construction sites to ensure compliance with SAUDI ARAMCO requirements and project specifications.
* Inspect material and equipment as applicable to ensure compliance with SAUDI ARAMCO requirements for proper handling, storage and protection at SAUDI ARAMCO facilities and/or construction sites.
* Monitor Contractor’s Quality Systems, records and Quality Personnel for compliance with requirements.
* Review and evaluate the Contractor’s Quality document submittals.
* Witness on-site and off-site material and installations tests for compliance with SAUDI ARAMCO standards.
* Record legibly and accurately all controversial and non-complying construction practices, materials and equipment and report to supervisor detailed potential problems for early resolution.
* Write inspection reports and initiate Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), Worksheets (WSs) and Equipment Deficiency Report (EDRs) as needed.
* To do work as planned and scheduled with a better professional approach and to report the findings in the required format.
* To work safely during inspection activities and to advise others to work safely.
* To maintain the confidentiality requirements in each activity during the service period.

Job Description:

Translate the marketing plan into media and public relations priorities, detailing exposure themes, messaging focus areas, and reputation management objectives

Develop annual media and public relations plan covering paid, earned, and shared channels to strengthen Sakani’s visibility, reach, and engagement

Coordinate media placements and flighting schedules across print, broadcast, and outdoor channels, optimizing timing, frequency, and alignment with priority campaigns

Maintain relationships with media outlets, journalists, influencers, and public relations agencies, leveraging the approved corporate media partner list maintained by Institutional Marketing Communications

Coordinate with Institutional Marketing Communications to request media buying and PR agencies from framework agreements, align briefs and deliverables, and share performance evaluations for vendor management

Coordinate with Content & Creative to prepare media kits, press releases, feature articles, and talking points that support announcements, launches, and key communications

Facilitate media interviews, press briefings, and public appearances by reviewing briefing notes, Q&A materials, and media handling guidelines for executives and spokespersons

Manage review and approval workflows for media materials with Institutional Marketing Communications to ensure adherence to corporate branding, disclosure protocols, and messaging standards

Supervise media dissemination by routing approved materials to journalists, outlets, and agencies, managing timing, placement, embargoes, and corrections to secure optimal coverage

Report on media coverage and sentiment, identifying trends, misinformation risks, and opportunities for proactive engagement or narrative adjustment

Implement crisis communications responses by preparing holding statements, escalation protocols, and messaging in coordination with Institutional Marketing Communications to safeguard Sakani’s reputation

Coordinate with Events Management to plan media engagement and coverage for conferences, exhibitions, and ceremonies, aligning narratives and timing with campaign objectives

Review performance of media campaigns by tracking impressions, reach, earned value, and sentiment, consolidating structured reports and recommendations for Product Marketing

Supervise maintenance of repositories for press releases, media kits, coverage reports, and journalist databases, ensuring traceability, accessibility, and reuse across campaigns

Review media and public relations practices against leading institutions, documenting lessons learned and refining frameworks, workflows, and approval processes with stakeholders’ feedback

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Communications, Media Studies, Journalism, or any related field is required

A minimum of 9 years of relevant experience with at least 2 years of experience in a leadership role

Certifications in CIPR Professional PR Diploma, PRSA Accreditation in Public Relations (APR), IABC Communication Management Professional (CMP), or CIPR Chartered Practitioner are optional

## Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

## Job Description

**What you get to do in this role:**

**Customer Advisory**

* Engage executives to determine and manage custom industry-aligned digital transformation advisory engagements at select customers, applying ServiceNow methodologies
* Lead discovery workshops with prospective and existing customer leadership and their teams to understand goals and challenges
* Document and present insights and recommended solutions to meet customer goals
* Create high-quality deliverables that communicate strategic agreement, present multi-year roadmaps and document the full business case to justify action
* Communicate and advise in 1:1 and 1: many environments

**Sales and Customer Success Advisory**

* Work with sales and customer success to help determine account plans and sales strategy for accounts in the region.
* Provide expertise to help assess and prioritize accounts and strategies
* Provide full lifecycle business outcome and value realization advice
* Thought leadership
* Identify and lead to the creation of new IP (best practices, white papers, workshops, etc.)
* Improve current methods and frameworks
* Work with and enable the ServiceNow teams on a business consulting approach to sales

## Qualifications

**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 10+ years of relevant experience as a Management consultant with exposure to cloud technologies or a customer-facing strategy manager with a technology vendor
* Executive / leadership experience working on digital transformation projects or enterprise software deployments preferred
* Experience in a major industry (such as FSI, Telco, Manufacturing, Retail, etc.) is preferred
* Experience developing C-Level relationships with an ability to simplify and communicate complex topics to an audience
* Experience with public speaking, meeting facilitation and white boarding
* Deep customer connects in regions
* High level of executive presence with a humble demeanor
* Analytical and financial experience
* Enjoyment working in a collaborative environment
* Ability to travel up to 40% of the time
* Fluent in Arabic and English

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. description:
**Title:**

Electrical Technician I(Saudi Nationals)

KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) provides holistic and value-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle. These include world-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets.

**KBR is looking for an Electrician**

  
**Responsibilities:**

* Execute day to-day electrical maintenance activities on all electrical systems plant, equipment and facilities within the designated area of responsibility.

* Ensure, complies and applied SATORP's Safety and Quality procedures, during the execution of electrical maintenance activities.
* Ensure a proper execution of work and check on the activities engaged in routine maintenance activities.
* Carryout repairing and troubleshooting activities on electrical assets are carried out in timely and quality manner that helps increase the availability and reliability of these systems.
* Receive work directions from the respective Electrical Supervisor, in relation to electrical systems maintenance orders/requests.
* Follow-up on electrical maintenance work progress and submit regular progress reports to the respective Electrical Supervisor.  Keep a record of daily maintenance works against planned maintenance programs and prepare work completion reports, where applicable.
* Enforce SATORP’s policies, procedures and regulations and ensure that all safety measures and precautions are strictly considered and taken care of during conducting maintenance works.
* Perform Preventive maintenance in HV and LV switchgear and control gears including testing of electronic protection relay, power circuit breaker, bus, bar contactors, motor starters, ATS.
* Perform the readings of partial discharge capacitor in HV motor.
* Perform on line analysis of current signature of motors.
* Perform testing on all kinds of transformers
* Support the switchgear operations in electrical substation when are request to do so
* Perform other related duties as assigned by his respective Electrical Leader.
* Proactive Safety aptitude and behavior.
* Strong knowledge of maintaining and repairing Electrical systems.
* Good knowledge in Electrical equipment design, installation and maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of maintaining and repairing Mechanical and electro hydraulic systems
* Good knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance principles and working procedures.
* Strong knowledge of standards, procedures and regulation to develop activities taking care of Health, Safety and Environmental preservation
* Strong communication and people skills.
* Ability to perform work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
* Synergic and Capable of handling multiple tasks.
* Good commands oral and written English.
* Ensure that personnel have the skills, training and all needed resources, equipment’s and tools to conduct routine maintenance activities in safe and effectively manner, according to the contract terms and conditions.
* Holding certification of IECEx to repair explosion proof motors
* Ensure that personnel have the skills, training and all needed resources, equipment’s and tools to conduct routine maintenance activities in safe and effectively manner, according to the contract terms and conditions.
* Holding certification of IECEx to repair explosion proof motors

  
**Qualifications:**

* Minimum 8 years’ experience in Oil & Gas maintenance – High School.
* Minimum 6 years’ experience in Oil & Gas maintenance – Diploma.
* Hold a valid certification issued by a recognized third-party certification body or an accredited Saudi institute, attesting to the individual’s qualifications and competency to perform the works.
* Strong technical understanding of maintenance management of Oil & Gas Facilities
* Well organized and proactive with excellent communication skills
* Proven leadership skills with large organizations
* Maturity of judgment under pressure and ability to resolve problems
* Strategic management skills
* An ability to achieve business results working in a multi-cultural environment
* Flexibility to travel internationally and live in KSA

**Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!**

  

**KBR — Delivering Solutions, Changing the World.**

KBR brings together the best and brightest to deliver science, technology and engineering solutions that help governments and companies around the world accomplish their most critical missions and objectives.

In everything we do, we are guided by our **ONE KBR Values:**

* **We Value Our People –** We create diverse, inclusive environments in which each person can feel safe, respected and valued, and where everyone has opportunities to grow and reach their full potential.
    
* **We Deliver –** We are uncompromising in our commitment to deliver innovative, high-quality, technology-led solutions for our customers and exceptional, sustainable value for all our stakeholders.
    
* **We Are People of Integrity –** We value honesty, trust, courage, fairness, prudence and tenacity. We believe doing what’s right for the planet, the communities where we work, and our people is good for business.
    
* **We Empower –** We empower our people with a shared purpose, the right tools and the supportive culture they need to be proactive decision-makers, to be adaptive to change, and to succeed.
    
* **We Are a Team of Teams –** We have a will to succeed, but we value the achievements of our team of teams over individual accomplishments. Our collective focus makes us a better, stronger, more effective company.
    

We have also embedded environmental, social and governance (ESG) principles in every business operation and corporate function. Not only are we committed to operating safely, sustainably and equitably, but we are also committed to using our capabilities and expertise to help our customers accomplish their sustainability goals.

Worldwide, KBR employs a diverse workforce approximately 29,000 people strong, with customers in more than 80 countries and operations in 40 countries.

**At KBR, We Deliver.**

**Fraud Alert**

Fraud has infiltrated the job placement market via the internet, email and direct phone contact. Attempts have included unauthorized use of KBR’s name and logo to solicit potential job seekers or to extend false job offers. Bad actors may mix in fake job advertisements with legitimate postings. These ads can include contact instructions and require job seekers to send sensitive personal information or money to pay for visa applications, processing fees, etc., in exchange for consideration for a high-paying position.

KBR will never ask for any sort of advance payment as part of the recruiting/hiring process. Candidate profiles are carefully managed to protect personal information.

description:
### Job responsibilities

**MISSION**

* Actively participate in the development of the organization and the business in the region by building relationship of trust with all stakeholders externally and internally (in Dubai HQ and with other boutiques)
* Your understanding of our brand positioning and your business acumen will drive the teams to deliver sales and to provide our guests with unique and memorable experiences
* Close proximity to the teams and the clients, you will lead by example and accompany the development of team members to ensure structure and strong accountability
* Embracing the culture of entrepreneurship and innovation, you can adapt with agility in a fast-moving and ever-changing environment and proactively propose and implement new ways of working in line with the company’s vision and guidelines

**MAIN ACCOUNTABILITIES**

Business Management:

* Manage the entire boutique team, client and business operations in order to achieve sales objectives and store and service KPI’s.
* Ensuring to spend majority of the time on the shop floor with sales team and clients
* Concur to the definition of action plans related to the mystery shopping and Voice of the Client results and ensure their implementation
* Have a finger on pulse with competitor analysis and ahead of the retail landscape with key initiatives and movements happening within the local markets high luxury domain

**Team Management:**

* Adopt a coaching posture and use this skill consistently with the sales team on how to deliver a unique and memorable shopping experience (customer focus, story telling, extraordinary service, selling skills and attitude).
* Observe the sales floor and provide structured feedback accordingly depending on on-going client experience situations.
* Structure routine moments for coaching and feedbacking \[both on the spot and in monthly one to one meetings\]
* Ability to create and hold inspiring and impactful daily briefs that are motivational and empowering, throughout the day
* Partner with Sales Training department in defining key areas of educational, behavioral and skills based developmental needs that can be transmitted into SMART developmental action plans
* Ensure the participation of the store team to training sessions in order to develop and strengthen their knowledge on different topics (collections, selling techniques, brand and inspiration stories, security…)
* Adapt and implement localized on-boarding plans for new joiners where applicable

**Client Management:**

* Be proactive in recruiting new customers, promoting and creating events in order to generate new business opportunities
* Actively participate and involve sales teams in social events
* Support in cultivating a culture of long term relationship building
* Constantly nurture relationships with clients, in store and outside the store implementing client database activities, as per marketing guidelines
* Partner with the regional CRM teams in order to review, implement, and follow up on dedicated action plans for client retention, growth and amplification within local market
* Address client concerns/disputes/complains assuring that the client satisfaction is restored

### Profile

TECHNICAL SKILLS  
  
Knowledge of store procedures and processes  
Knowledge of digital processes  
Knowledge of the Luxury business  
Knowledge of competition  
  
   
SOFT SKILLS  
Driving and leading by example  
  
Business acumen  
Proactivity &Engagement  
Client satisfaction  
Being coach  
Delivering excellence  
Managerial Effectiveness  
Integrity and Trust  
Curiosity and Change Drive

### Additional information

**Master of the House:**

* Be responsible for the good maintenance, the safe environment, the good functioning of the store as well as the respect of product assortment and visual merchandising, respect of excellent uniforms and grooming standards, and supervise after sales service requests providing excellent pre and post service to the client
* Be responsible for the store stock, ensuring to efficiently and effectively manage it according to KPI’s, and proposing corrective actions
* Guarantee the correct application of company norms and procedures (discount etc..).
* Sponsor the development of a frictionless client experience through the different touch points, leveraging on the adoption of new digital tools and processes
* Sponsor the full store engagement on new omnichannel initiatives and amplify the change of mindset in store, driving the change

**Market Knowledge:**

* Related to their environment (city, street, mall, dept. Store) guarantee profound knowledge on brand locations, events and marketing activities

At Horizontal Digital, we hold ourselves to one key belief: You’re only as good as your worst customer experience. This mantra is what drives our digital consultancy to think beyond the easy answers and instead create websites, apps, portals, and other experiences that solve customer needs for Fortune 500 companies in intuitive and empathetic ways. And we make this lofty standard a reality by fusing strategy, data, design, and technology together to arrive at solutions that set the bar higher for everyone.

**We use these values to fuel superior results:**

**Lock arms**

We forge relationships that make our impact 1,000x stronger. This means working across departments and engaging both our clients and our communities to deliver the greatest good.

**Show hustle**

We’re not ones to sit on our hands and wait. Instead, we anticipate opportunities, collectively roll up our sleeves and find ways to execute the exceptional.

**Embrace change**

From new technologies to workplace philosophies, we welcome the unexpected and constantly anticipate what’s next.

**Elevate empathy**

We listen before we take action. This means understanding a variety of perspectives and holding ourselves to a higher standard of accountability.

**Never settle**

We motivate each other to push past the easy answers and collectively arrive at bigger, more inspiring ideas.

**But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.**

We are looking for a Saudi National Senior Project Manager who will lead full lifecycle digital transformation projects from inception to implementation using agile methodologies.

**What you’ll do:**

* Provide agile project management oversight for multiple projects:
* Define project objectives, scope, estimate, timeline and level of effort.
* Develop project strategies and plans, and identify the methods and tools required for the project.
* Keep projects on track and on budget while resolving issues with clients.
* Monitor progress and budget against plan.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide technical advice and to resolve problems.
* Manage scope by coordinating and responding to requests for changes from original specifications.
* Ensure quality through planning, execution, quality assurance, and quality control techniques.
* Identify, analyze and mitigate risks to maximize the results and minimize the consequences.
* Work closely with the end users, business technologists, and other stakeholders to understand and prioritize business goals and information needs, then develop system requirements and design specifications; direct efforts to refine conceptual systems design requirements into the technical design.
* Provide solutions, leadership, and motivation to project team members.

**Who you are:**

* You get it done. Grit is your middle name. You are organized, have excellent time management skills, and have spidey sense for issues before they arise. While doing all of that, you have a positive attitude and delivery high quality work for clients.
* You are a natural leader. You are self-motivated with a high degree of initiative and follow-through. Mentoring others is something you do out of habit. You are eager to succeed and understand that putting in the work is the way to get where you want to be.
* You’re an outstanding communicator. You are able to convey information to all key stakeholders in both written and verbal formats. Preparing and delivering presentations is second nature.

**What you bring:**

* A minimum of 5 years client-facing digital project management experience, preferably using agile methodologies.
* A minimum of 2 years agency/consultancy experience. 5+ years preferred.
* A minimum of 2 years of experience managing large scale website projects that include discovery, strategy, user experience, creative design, front end development, website development, QA, deployments, and maintenance.
* Prior exposure to digital marketing solutions such as Sitecore and Salesforce.
* Experience with Jira/Confluence preferred.
* Ability to earn SCRUM certification within 90 days.

**Our KSA Benefits include:**

* 22 days holiday

* Comprehensive medical insurance plan for employee and spouse and children

* Visa for employee and spouse and children (if required)

* Flexible office times and working from home twice per week

* Remote working from a place of your choice for 2 weeks a year

**Application Tips**

To help us review your application as smoothly as possible, we recommend submitting a clear, ATS-friendly CV using a simple format and standard headings such as Experience, Skills, and Education. Avoid complex layouts or graphics so your experience is captured accurately.

If you're unsure how to make your CV ATS-friendly, this guide provides helpful practical tips:   
[https://www.myperfectresume.com/career-center/resumes/how-to/ats-friendly](https://www.myperfectresume.com/career-center/resumes/how-to/ats-friendly)

## Overview

  

We are seeking a skilled HVAC Technician to install, operate, maintain, and repair heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems for residential, commercial, or industrial facilities. The role ensures HVAC systems operate efficiently, safely, and in compliance with project specifications and applicable standards.

  

## Your role

* Install, test, commission, maintain, and repair HVAC systems including:
    * Chillers, AHUs, FCUs, DX units, VRF/VRV systems
    * Split & packaged units, exhaust/fresh air systems
* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance as per schedules.
* Diagnose system faults and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control issues.
* Read and interpret drawings, schematics, and technical manuals.
* Ensure refrigerant charging, pressure testing, vacuuming, and leak detection are conducted properly.
* Monitor system performance and recommend improvements for efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with HSE standards, local codes, and project quality requirements.
* Maintain service reports, maintenance logs, and records.
* Coordinate with supervisors, engineers, and other trades as required.
* Respond to emergency breakdowns when required.

  

## About you

  

**Qualifications & Experience**

  

* Diploma/ITI in HVAC, Mechanical Engineering, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or equivalent.
* Minimum 3–7 years of hands-on HVAC experience (project/facilities-based).
* Strong knowledge of HVAC mechanical, electrical, and control systems.
* Experience in GCC/UAE projects preferred.
* Familiar with international standards (ASHRAE, SMACNA, CIBSE – preferred).

  

**Skills & Competencies**

  

* HVAC installation, testing & commissioning.
* Preventive & breakdown maintenance.
* Fault diagnosis & troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of refrigerants and handling procedures.
* Ability to work from drawings and method statements.
* Basic electrical & control panel knowledge.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.

description:
## Company Description

Tahaluf is the largest B2B live and on-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia by space, attendance, colleagues, and revenue. It is a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF).  
  
Tahaluf is bold, visionary, and determined to make an impact. Our team fosters a culture of collaboration, creativity, and a little fun, here teamwork rules and work feels as exciting as the events we create. Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia’s B2B and B2C large-scale events scene.  
  
Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of record-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape - the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA - a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East - the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector.  
  
Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. From day one, you’ll dive into large-scale projects under the guidance of a supportive leadership team that will encourage your personal development and open doors to new opportunities.

**About LIONS Riyadh**

LIONS Riyadh marks a bold new chapter for the world’s most prestigious platform for creative marketing. Launched by Tahaluf in partnership with LIONS and Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Media, it is a distinct Festival within the global LIONS community, home to the renowned Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity. Designed to amplify Middle Eastern creativity on the global stage, LIONS Riyadh will showcase the region’s talent, ideas and storytelling while connecting its creative industries with the world’s leading networks, brands and decision-makers. The inaugural three-day Festival takes place at KAFD, Riyadh, from 6–8 December 2027. It will bring together regional and global CMOs, creative leaders, agencies, brands and emerging talent around creative excellence, effectiveness, culture and the future of the industry.

## Job Description

This is an exciting opportunity for a Senior Marketing Manager with a strong focus on brand launch and event marketing.

The Senior Marketing Manager will play a key role in launching and growing LIONS Riyadh, translating the LIONS Riyadh proposition into high-impact campaigns that build awareness, audience demand and long-term brand relevance.

The role will work across brand, audience, digital, content and campaign marketing, helping position LIONS Riyadh as an essential destination for the region’s creative, marketing and media community.

The successful candidate will combine strong strategic thinking with hands-on campaign delivery, creative judgement and a deep understanding of how to engage different audience communities across Saudi Arabia, the GCC and international markets.

Working closely with the Head of Marketing, Content, PR, Creative and Commercial teams, the role will ensure every campaign is distinctive, culturally relevant, commercially effective and aligned with LIONS Riyadh standards.

**Responsibilities:**

**I. Brand Launch:**

* Market Research & Analysis: Understanding your target audience, competitors, and market trends is crucial. This involves conducting surveys, analyzing data, and identifying opportunities.
    

* Support the development and execution of the LIONS Riyadh brand and campaign strategy.
    

* Translate the LIONS Riyadh positioning into compelling audience propositions, messaging and campaign stories.
    
* Messaging & Positioning: Crafting compelling brand messages that resonate with your target audience and differentiate you from competitors. This includes developing taglines, brand stories, and key messages.
    
* Ensure all marketing activity reflects the creativity, quality and authority of LIONS Riyadh.
    
* Work with Creative teams and agencies to develop standout campaign concepts and assets across all channels.
    
* Content Creation & Marketing: Developing high-quality content that engages your target audience and communicates your brand message. This includes blog posts, social media updates, videos, infographics, newsletters, lead magnets and more. The Lions Riyadh Brand should be an expression of 360 marketing excellence all year through numerous content streams, to help support with brand awareness and acquisition.
    
* Use speakers, content, creative work, partnerships and Festival announcements as key campaign moments.
    
* Analytics & Measurement: Tracking key metrics to measure the success of your brand launch and identify areas for improvement. This includes website traffic, social media engagement, sales, and brand awareness.
    

**II. Audience & Event Marketing Skills:**

* Develop and deliver integrated marketing campaigns to attract priority audiences to LIONS Riyadh.
    
* Build targeted campaigns for CMOs, creative leaders, agencies, brands, media professionals, creators and emerging talent.
    
* Support audience-growth strategies across Saudi Arabia, the GCC and priority international markets.
    
* Deliver campaigns across paid media, social, CRM, email, digital, PR and strategic partnerships.
    
* Develop audience journeys that move from awareness and engagement through to registration and ticket conversion.
    
* Manage marketing budgets and ensure spend is optimised against agreed objectives.
    
* Manage external agencies and suppliers where required.
    
* Work closely with PR, Content and Partnerships to maximise the impact of key LIONS Riyadh announcements and Festival moments.
    
* Support onsite marketing activity and audience engagement during LIONS Riyadh.
    
* Conduct post-event analysis and use insights to improve future campaigns.
    

**III. Digital & Performance Marketing**

* Own and optimise digital campaign performance across paid social, search, display, CRM and other relevant channels.
    
* Use analytics and testing to improve audience acquisition, engagement and conversion.
    
* Monitor the LIONS Riyadh registration and ticketing funnel and identify opportunities to improve conversion at each stage.
    
* Develop audience segmentation and retargeting strategies.
    
* Manage PPC, SEO and digital acquisition activity where relevant.
    
* Use data and audience behaviour to continuously improve campaign messaging, creative and channel mix.
    
* Track campaign ROI and provide clear performance recommendations to the Head of Marketing.
    
* Manage and mentor marketing team members, providing direction and guidance against KPIs and objectives.
    
* Work closely with other departments to ensure alignment between marketing, content, commercial and Festival delivery.
    
* Collaborate closely with the wider LIONS Riyadh team to ensure campaigns remain aligned with brand standards and positioning.
    
* Work with Content and PR teams to identify stories and ideas capable of generating industry conversation around LIONS Riyadh.
    
* Partner with Commercial teams to support priority client campaigns and audience development where relevant.
    
* Champion creative quality, attention to detail and high standards across all LIONS Riyadh marketing output.
    

**IV. Leadership & Collaboration**

* Manage and mentor marketing team members, providing direction and guidance against KPIs and objectives.
    

* Work closely with other departments to ensure alignment between marketing, content, commercial and Festival delivery.
    

* Collaborate closely with the wider LIONS Riyadh team to ensure campaigns remain aligned with brand standards and positioning.
    

* Work with Content and PR teams to identify stories and ideas capable of generating industry conversation around LIONS Riyadh.
    

* Partner with Commercial teams to support priority client campaigns and audience development where relevant.
    

* Champion creative quality, attention to detail and high standards across all LIONS Riyadh marketing output.
    

## Qualifications

* Minimum of 8–10 years of experience in marketing, with strong experience in brand building, audience marketing or major events.
    
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
    
* Proven experience launching or growing a major brand, event, Festival, media platform or cultural proposition.
    
* Strong experience developing integrated campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels.
    
* Strong experience in digital marketing, analytics and campaign optimisation.
    
* Experience managing ticketing or audience-acquisition campaigns.
    
* Strong knowledge of digital performance marketing, PPC, SEO and CRM.
    
* Strong creative judgement with the ability to recognise effective ideas, messaging and campaign creative.
    
* Excellent understanding of brand positioning, audience segmentation and customer journeys.
    
* Strong written communication and storytelling skills.
    
* Ability to manage agencies, budgets and multiple campaigns simultaneously.
    
* Confident working with senior internal and external stakeholders.
    
* Strong interest in creativity, advertising, media, culture and emerging industry trends.
    
* Strong team management experience, motivating and developing a team to achieve marketing optimisation and excellence
    

**Desired Experience:**

* Background in large-scale events, Festivals, media, entertainment, creative industries or premium brands.
    
* Experience marketing to senior professional audiences as well as creators and emerging talent.
    
* Experience within advertising, marketing, media or the wider creative industries is highly desirable.
    
* Saudi Arabia or GCC market experience is desirable.
    
* Experience working on international campaigns or global brands is advantageous.
    
* Experience with marketing automation, CMS, creator economy and social-media management platforms.
    
* Arabic language.
    

## Additional Information

**Core Benefits:**

* Medical Insurance for individual and family
* Annual leave – 28 days
* Remote working on Sundays
* Working anywhere – 2 months every year
* School fees contribution, 40,000 SAR per child per year (up to a max of three children)
* Wellbeing Benefits
* Residency visa including yearly dependent fees
* Individual annual flight allowance for expats

**Local Relocation Package\*:**

* Paid flight to Riyadh – individual and family
* 30 days accommodation or suitable serviced apartment from arrival date or a one-off payment of SAR 5,000
* Up to SAR 2,500 reimbursement of shipping goods/excess baggage costs

\*If eligible

**International Relocation Package\*:**

* Paid flight to Riyadh – individual and family
* 60 days accommodation or a suitable serviced apartment from your arrival date, or a one-off payment of SAR 5,000
* Up to SAR 2,500 reimbursement of shipping goods/excess baggage costs
* Paid flight home for individual and end-of-service gratuity payment when leaving the company (if applicable)

\*If eligible

We work hard to make sure life at Tahaluf is rewarding, supportive and enjoyable for everyone. We’re not solely focused on a checklist of skills. We champion energy and ambition and look for colleagues who will roll their sleeves up, join in and help make things happen. We don't just accept difference, we celebrate it.  We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and circumstances and base hiring decisions on relevant qualifications and merit.  We are proud to provide a disability-friendly environment. If you require any support or adjustments to participate in our interview or selection processes, please let us know.

Your Journey with Hilton Starts Here
Hilton Makkah – Jabal Omar Hotels is offering a 24-month Diploma in Tourism and Hospitality, in collaboration with Makkah Private College and HRDF.
The program combines academic learning with practical hospitality training, giving participants the skills and experience needed to start a career in the Food & Beverage Department.
Throughout the program, participants will receive a SAR 4,000 monthly stipend and medical insurance.
Upon successful completion of the diploma and program requirements, participants will join Hilton Makkah – Jabal Omar Hotels as Food & Beverage Attendants.
This is an opportunity to learn the foundations of hospitality, gain practical experience and begin your career with Hilton.

What you’ll learn and experience during the program:
Complete the academic and practical requirements of the 24-month diploma program.
Learn Hilton’s standards of guest service and hospitality.
Gain practical exposure to Food & Beverage operations.
Learn how to prepare service areas and maintain cleanliness and organization.
Develop the skills needed to take and serve food and beverage orders accurately and efficiently.
Learn menu knowledge, service procedures and guest interaction.
Follow food safety, hygiene and workplace safety standards.
Work closely with team members and build strong communication and teamwork skills.
Maintain good attendance, performance and commitment throughout the program.
Successfully complete all required assessments and training.

Who can apply?
Saudi national.
Registered on Jadarat or the relevant program system.
Currently not employed and not receiving a retirement pension.
Does not hold a commercial registration.
Not included on a restricted list.
Meets and accepts the program's eligibility and support requirements.
Interested in building a career in hospitality and Food & Beverage.
Willing to learn, work with guests and be part of a team.
Committed to completing the full 24-month program.

How We’ll Help You Thrive

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program

Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents

Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care

Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves and their loved ones. In many countries, eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

*Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

**Title:**

Senior Planning Manager

Senior Planning Manager

### LOCATION

  

Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

  

**project description**

The project is a major infrastructure programme for a mixed-use development aiming to be a global landmark recognized for its unique vision and position as an authentic destination in Riyadh. The community will be a distinct, self-sustaining hub for Riyadh offering several iconic assets. KBR will provide PMO services, enterprise – level governance, assurance, integration and performance oversight across all projects and programs.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Sales Manager , you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
Here's what you'll do during a typical day:
+ Generate and convert new business: Research, prospect, and qualify leads through proactive outreach and database mining to drive group sales and exceed lead generation goals
+ Build and maintain client relationships: Serve as the primary contact for assigned market segments, nurturing existing accounts and developing new ones to grow room revenue and overall profitability
+ Develop targeted sales strategies: Analyze hotel and market trends to create and execute business plans and marketing initiatives that capture demand and meet sales goals
+ Lead end-to-end sales process: Prepare proposals, conduct site visits, negotiate terms, and secure contracts tailored to client needs while maximizing revenue
+ Manage booking details: Coordinate customer requirements including room, food and beverage, and meeting space, and ensure accurate and timely entry of account and reservation information in the hotel’s sales management system

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture
At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands (https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/) , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog (https://jobs.hilton.com/blogs) to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

description:
The Offshore Liaisonman is responsible for coordinating all personnel, logistics, documentation, and communication activities related to offshore rig and non-rig operations. The role ensures the smooth mobilization and demobilization of offshore personnel, compliance with client requirements, and effective coordination between offshore teams, onshore support functions, marine logistics, and client representatives.

**Requirements**

* Coordinate offshore personnel mobilization and demobilization in accordance with client schedules.
* Liaise with clients, offshore installations, marine logistics, helicopter operators, and internal departments to ensure uninterrupted operations.
* Arrange offshore travel, including helicopter and vessel bookings, crew change schedules, and transportation logistics.
* Process and maintain offshore documentation, including gate passes, offshore permits, manifests, travel requests, and client approvals.
* Ensure all personnel possess valid offshore certifications and medical clearances before deployment.
* Coordinate with HR, Operations, HSE, Logistics, and Marine departments regarding manpower requirements.
* Monitor offshore crew rotations and maintain updated personnel movement records.
* Support offshore rig and non-rig projects with administrative and logistical coordination.
* Follow up on client requests, approvals, and operational documentation.
* Maintain daily communication with offshore installations to resolve logistical or personnel-related issues.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports related to offshore manpower and logistics.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, client requirements, and offshore safety regulations.
* Assist during emergency crew changes and urgent mobilization requirements.

* Maintain accurate records of irrigation system operations, repairs, and maintenance activities.

* Adhere to all safety protocols when working with irrigation equipment and chemicals.
* Collaborate with landscaping and groundskeeping teams to optimize irrigation coverage and efficiency.

* Prior experience in irrigation system operation and maintenance, preferably in a golf course or landscaping environment.
* Basic knowledge of irrigation principles, equipment, and water management.
* Ability to identify and troubleshoot irrigation system issues.
* Physical capability to perform manual tasks outdoors in varying weather conditions.
* Good communication skills and ability to work as part of a team.

description:
Sanabil Studio is a venture builder that blends industry expertise, technology, and startup know-how to turn bold ideas into real businesses. We take concepts from zero to launch, and when a venture proves its potential, we back it with seed funding and hands-on support to help it scale.
At Revie , we believe great design combines technology with human understanding. We use smart tools to simplify the interior design and execution process, but what truly sets us apart is our attention to detail and focus on each client's needs. We are an interior design and execution company in Riyadh, helping you transform your space from concept to reality, from planning and design to execution and furnishing. Our team of interior designers and contractors ensures high-quality delivery at every stage, with a clear and structured experience from start to finish.
We are looking for a proactive and organized Junior Operations Associate to support the planning, administration, and daily coordination of interior design and fit-out projects, reporting to the Project Manager.
THE ROLE: What you'll own here.
Maintain project to-do lists, action trackers, and schedules, ensuring each task has a clear owner and deadline.

Follow up with suppliers and the operations, design, and sales teams on deliverables, approvals, material availability, and delivery dates.

Assist the Project Manager with project planning, meeting arrangements, and daily coordination.

Prepare meeting minutes, record action points, and follow up until completion.

Organize project files, correspondence, reports, and supporting documents.

Prepare regular progress updates highlighting completed tasks, pending actions, delays, and issues requiring the Project Manager's attention.

Communicate project priorities and updates clearly across all involved teams.

Escalate urgent matters promptly and support the coordination needed to resolve them.

Remain available for urgent coordination and support outside regular working hours when required, according to an agreed standby schedule.

THE PROFILE: You're probably a fit if…
You have a background in administration, business administration, project coordination, or a related field.

You have previous experience in an administrative or project support role; experience in interior design, construction, or fit-out is preferred.

You have strong organizational, time-management, and planning skills.

You can manage multiple priorities, work under pressure, and follow through on outstanding tasks.

You pick up instructions quickly and can learn new processes and tools efficiently.

You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Arabic and English.

You're proficient in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, with the ability to maintain schedules, trackers, and reports.

You're responsible and proactive, with strong attention to detail and reliable follow-up.

You have a personal vehicle and a valid Saudi driving license.

You hold a valid Iqama/residence ID.

THE ENVIRONMENT: What working here actually looks like.
Hands-On From Day One: You'll work on real client projects, not test briefs, mood boards, drawings, and specs that end up in finished spaces people actually live and work in.

Structured Mentorship: You'll work closely with our design and operations team, learning the full process, concept, material sourcing, and site coordination, with senior designers reviewing your work at every stage.

Fast-Paced, High Standards: We move quickly from concept to delivery, and every drawing and spec is held to the same bar our clients see in the finished space.

Located adjacent to the residential tower, expert service and world-class luxury combine in the Raffles Hotel Jeddah, which is ready to welcome you and your guests at any moment. Here, the high standards, special touches, and trademark elegance of the Raffles brand are the ultimate compliment to the charm and beauty of a stay in Jeddah.

## Job Description

* Greet all arriving guests and offer a detailed orientation of their rooms and its facilities.
* Co-ordinate with room service, all food and beverage items served in rooms and subsequent removal of used items.
* Co-ordinate the servicing of guest room and assist Housekeeping in the cleaning and servicing of all rooms to required standard, check that rooms are serviced to standard.
* Maintain the guest’s personal items, clothing and wardrobes in a clean, neat fashion throughout their stay.
* Collect, process, check, deliver all guests valet requirements, perform simple pressing of guest clothing as necessary.
* Unpack and pack guest’s luggage as required by guests request.
* Ensure Butler’s pantry in a clean orderly manner at all times.
* Maintain stock and charge in suite bars.
* Assist guest with room and local information; make bookings and reservations as required by guest.
* Assist as required in the following areas, restaurant, reception, luggage services, back of house cleaning and maintenance.

## Qualifications

* Minimum 5 years of experience as a butler or in a similar role within the luxury hospitality industry
* Proven supervisory experience in managing a team of service professionals
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with guests, team members, and other departments
* Strong leadership abilities and a talent for mentoring and developing staff
* Proficiency in household management software and MS Office suite
* Exceptional attention to detail and problem-solving skills
* Superior time management and multitasking abilities
* In-depth knowledge of etiquette, protocol, and luxury service standards
* Familiarity with Middle Eastern customs and etiquette is highly advantageous
* High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management or related field preferred
* Professional butler certification is a plus
* Fluency in English required; proficiency in Arabic is highly desirable
* Flexibility to work varying shifts, including weekends and holidays
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion at all times

* Being a Raffles employee means embodying and conveying the brand and the company mindset through our Heartiest service culture.
