description:
Daikin Middle East & Africa is a subsidiary of Daikin Industries Ltd. and the leading provider of heating, cooling, ventilation, air purification, and refrigeration technology. The company designs, manufactures and brings to market a broad portfolio of equipment, as well as tailor-made solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial purposes in Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). To date, Daikin EMEA has over 12 000 employees across more than 59 consolidated subsidiaries. It has 12 major manufacturing facilities based in Belgium, the Czech Republic, Germany, Italy, Spain, Turkey, Austria, and the UK. Our aim is to drive sustainable and effective solutions, sparking a good climate for the generations to come. And all this can only be achieved because of our People.

About the Role

The Project Execution Engineer (HVAC Projects) is based in Riyadh and accountable for the end-to-end delivery of HVAC projects across the Central Region of KSA. This includes chiller replacements, retrofit works, VRV system supply and installation, and full turnkey solutions. The role owns the full project lifecycle from handover by Sales through planning, execution, monitoring & control, financial governance, commissioning, and close-out ensuring delivery is on time, within budget, compliant with contractual obligations, and aligned with quality and HSE standards.

How You Will Make an Impact

You will lead the transformation and delivery of the projects business across KSA by driving operational excellence, strengthening governance, and ensuring profitable, on-time project execution across the following areas:

Project Launch & Initiation

• Validate project scope, specifications, commercial terms, and contractual obligations received from Sales.

• Identify key risks, assumptions, constraints, and mitigation strategies at the outset.

• Lead internal and external project kick-off meetings to align all stakeholders.

• Establish clear project objectives, success criteria, and communication protocols.

Planning & Execution

• Develop and manage integrated project execution plans covering schedule, resources, procurement, cash flow, and cost baselines.

• Coordinate with engineering, design, procurement, and logistics teams to ensure full project readiness and alignment.

• Review technical submittals, method statements, and compliance documentation to ensure project execution standards are met.

• Lead site execution of HVAC projects (chillers, VRV systems, retrofits, and turnkey solutions) while managing subcontractors and ensuring adherence to scope, quality, and timelines.

• Ensure strict compliance with HSE standards and maintain proactive coordination with clients, consultants, and stakeholders to resolve issues and prevent delays.

Monitoring & Control

• Track progress against baseline schedules and key milestones.

• Monitor cost performance, variations, and change orders.

• Issue accurate and timely progress reports, dashboards, and forecasts.

• Identify deviations early and implement corrective and preventive actions.

Project Financial Oversight

• Own project financial performance including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and margin protection.

• Manage payments, variations, and claims while ensuring alignment with contractual and profitability targets.

Testing, Commissioning & Handover

• Oversee testing and commissioning of HVAC systems, including chillers and VRV systems.

• Ensure systems meet design intent, operational performance, and client requirements.

• Lead final inspections, snag closure, and stakeholder approvals.

• Ensure complete and accurate handover documentation (as-built drawings, O&M manuals, warranties).

• Secure formal client acceptance and project closure.

Post-Implementation Review

• Conduct structured project close-out reviews focusing on performance, risks, and financial outcomes.

• Capture lessons learned and institutionalized best practices.

• Support service teams during the defect liability period (DLP).

• Strengthen client relationships to enable repeat business and long-term partnerships.

What You Need to Succeed

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or a related discipline.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in HVAC project execution, with strong exposure to chillers and VRV systems.

• Demonstrated experience delivering turnkey HVAC projects in KSA or GCC markets.

• Strong understanding of HVAC systems, particularly VRV technologies and central plant solutions.

• Solid knowledge of project management frameworks (e.g., PMI principles) and execution tools.

• Project Management certification (e.g., PMP or equivalent) is preferred.

• Proven financial acumen with experience in cost control, margin management, and contract administration.

• Strong technical analysis and problem-solving skills to support site execution and resolve day-to-day project issues.

• Ability to coordinate effectively with clients, consultants, and internal teams to ensure smooth project delivery.

• Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple tasks, submittals, and site activities.

• Good commercial awareness, with understanding of cost implications, material usage, and efficient resource utilization.

• Commitment to Quality, Compliance, and HSE standards, ensuring adherence to project specifications, regulatory requirements, and safe work practices on site.

• Hands-on experience with progress reporting, document preparation, and meeting support.

• Excellent communication skills in both English and Arabic.

Good climate starts with people
Our employees are the beating heart of our company. At Daikin, you get to work in a positive environment backed by trust, creativity and continuous improvement. Together, we create our top-quality solutions by empowering talented teams. You will get plenty of opportunities to learn and grow. We are deeply committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace culture that reflects the communities we serve. Good climate starts with people.

Do you want to love what you do at work? Do you want to make a difference, an impact, transform peoples lives? Do you want to work with a team that believes in disrupting the normal, boring, and average?

If yes, then this is the job you're looking for ,[webook.com](http://webook.com/) is Saudi's #1 event ticketing and experience booking platforms in terms of technology, features, agility, revenue serving some of the largest mega events in the Kingdom surpassing over 2 billion sales.

### Role Overview

The Senior Sales Specialist is responsible for driving high-impact revenue growth by owning complex deals, closing strategic partners, and consistently exceeding revenue targets. This role leads the full sales cycle end-to-end while acting as a role model for sales execution, deal discipline, and CRM excellence.

### Key Responsibilities

### Lead Generation & Strategic Prospecting

* Proactively source and develop high-value leads through outbound outreach, referrals, and market mapping
* Qualify partners against ICP, commercial viability, and long-term revenue potential
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities  
    

### Sales Leadership & Deal Ownership

* Own the full sales cycle from first contact to contract signature
* Lead high-stakes discovery, pitching, and commercial discussions with senior stakeholders
* Structure, negotiate, and close complex deals within approved commercial guardrails
* Drive urgency and momentum across longer sales cycles  
      
    

### Revenue & Performance Management

* Consistently achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets
* Forecast revenue accurately and maintain strong pipeline hygiene
* Ensure all sales activities, deal stages, and next steps are accurately reflected in the CRM
* Identify risks, blockers, and upsides early and proactively address them  
      
    

### Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with onboarding, operations, finance, and account management teams to ensure smooth partner activation
* Support junior sales team members through knowledge sharing, best practices, and informal coaching
* Act as a feedback loop for product, operations, and leadership teams based on partner and market insights  
      
    

### Process, Governance & Improvement

* Uphold high standards of deal quality, documentation, and commercial discipline
* Contribute to improving sales processes, playbooks, and tools
* Share competitive intelligence and market trends to support strategic decision-making  
      
    

**Requirements**

* 3-6+ years of experience in B2B sales, partnerships, or business development
* Strong track record of closing complex, high-value deals
* Advanced cold outreach, negotiation, and closing skills
* Ability to engage and influence senior decision-makers
* Strong analytical skills with experience using CRM and sales reporting tools

**About Jeeny:**

Jeeny is a leading ride-hailing platform that strives to revolutionize daily commuting and transportation. Our app connects users with their preferred modes of transportation, making mobility accessible, convenient, and affordable for all.

We are a joint venture between MEIG (Middle East Internet Group), Rocket Internet, and IMENA. Since our inception, we have grown exponentially and currently operate in Saudi Arabia and Jordan.

At Jeeny, we value innovation, teamwork, and a passion for delivering exceptional user experiences. Join us in our mission to transform the transportation landscape.

**About the Role:**

Jeeny is looking for an ambitious **Jeeny Ads Sales Specialist** to drive the growth of our advertising business in Riyadh. You will be responsible for identifying strategic accounts, engaging senior decision-makers, and owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing.

This is a high-impact **Individual Contributor (IC)** role for a strong “hunter” who can build relationships, win new business, and aggressively grow advertising revenue.

**Requirements**

* Sales Experience: 3+ years of proven experience in full-cycle B2B business development, media sales, or strategic account acquisition, with a track record of consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
* Industry Bonus: Direct experience in digital advertising, retail media networks (RMN), or a strong background working with media agencies and agency holding groups is highly preferred.
* Executive Presence: Experience engaging senior marketing leaders, navigating complex agency structures, and managing buying committees.
* Hunter Mentality: A self-starter attitude with the resilience, coachability, and urgency required to aggressively prospect, pitch, and close net-new business.
* Communication: Exceptional pitching, storytelling, and negotiation skills. Ability to translate performance metrics and data into compelling value propositions. Fluency in both English and Arabic.
* Adaptability: Comfort working with technology, performance data, and evolving sales processes in a fast-paced environment.  
    

**What You'll Do:**

* Scale Revenue: Own the end-to-end sales cycle, converting qualified leads and outbound prospects into advertising pipeline and closed revenue to accelerate year-over-year growth.
* Strategic Prospecting: Identify and penetrate high-potential accounts across key verticals (FMCG, Telecom, Finance, Entertainment). Map key marketing decision-makers and agency buying personas to develop tailored engagement strategies.
* Consultative Selling: Lead high-level conversations with CMOs, Brand Managers, and Agency Executives. Clearly communicate the unique value of Jeeny’s first-party data, audience reach, and multi-surface ad formats.
* Build Partnerships: Cultivate and nurture relationships with direct brand decision-makers and key stakeholders within the region's media landscape.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Marketing, and Operations to ensure campaigns are optimized, delivered successfully, and positioned for renewal.
* Data-Driven Sales: Maintain accurate account, contact, and activity data in our CRM, and share market trends, agency insights, and advertiser feedback with leadership to shape our evolving ad product offerings.

**Benefits**

**What We Offer:**

* An opportunity to collaborate with talented individuals while learning, growing, and expanding your skill set.
* An environment that encourages you to take ownership and produce excellent outcomes every day.
* Health benefits and insurance.
* Flexible working hours.

**Company Culture**

Jeeny is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a workplace where all aspects of employment are solely based on merit. We value diversity and absolutely do not discriminate in any form based on race, color, ethnicity, nationality, religion, gender, age, or mental or physical disability.

Description
Are you passionate about the intersection of cloud technology and the energy industry? Do you want to help some of the world's largest energy companies modernize their operations and accelerate digital transformation across the Middle East?
The Middle East is home to some of the world's most ambitious energy companies: national oil companies operating mega-scale upstream assets, integrated refining and petrochemical complexes, LNG export terminals, and pipeline networks that span entire countries. These organizations are investing billions in digital transformation, and require partners who understand their business from the wellhead to the fuel terminal. AWS is building deep capability across the full energy value chain in this region, and this role sits at the heart of that effort.
As a Technical Business Developer on the AWS Energy team, you will own the regional strategy for energy in the Middle East, identifying where data and AI can generate insights and acceleration across the value chain. You will draw on your own background and that of the strong team around you to help upstream operators accelerate seismic interpretation and reservoir modelling, enable a refinery to optimize throughput using real-time analytics and digital twins, or support a pipeline operator modernize SCADA infrastructure and emissions monitoring. You will need to understand the full energy landscape, from exploration, drilling, and production through to refining, petrochemicals, pipelines, and LNG, because the customers you serve often operate across all of it.
You will work across AWS account teams, ISVs, and systems integrators to shape solutions that fit how these operators actually run, bridging IT/OT convergence, industrial data platforms, subsurface data management, and advanced analytics with the commercial models that make adoption real. You will develop reference architectures and technical content grounded in real operational use cases, whether that is reservoir simulation workflows, turnaround planning, advanced process control, or pipeline integrity management, and build relationships with VP-level engineering and digital leaders at major operators who are making build-vs-buy decisions right now.
You will operate with full autonomy, identifying untapped opportunities, building your own pipeline, and driving complex pursuits from first conversation to signed deal. You will use your guile, industry credibility, and personal network to open doors that cold outreach cannot, seeking out and working with the best minds in the business, whether inside AWS, across our partner ecosystem, or within the customer's own organization, to deliver real outcomes.
You will raise the bar for those around you, mentoring teammates, elevating partner capabilities, and sharing the domain knowledge that helps the broader AWS Energy team win. You will be measured on pipeline generated, solutions adopted, and customer outcomes delivered, not slide decks produced.
This role suits someone who has spent real time in the energy industry, whether that is on a drilling rig, in a control room, on a plant floor, or embedded in an operator's digital transformation programme. You should understand a DCS from a historian, know why OSDU matters, and be able to hold your own in a conversation about reservoir management just as comfortably as turnaround planning or pipeline SCADA modernization. If you have the operational credibility, the commercial instincts, and the drive to help the Middle East's most important energy companies succeed with AWS, we want to hear from you.
Key job responsibilities
Develop and own a global go-to-market strategy for the midstream and downstream energy segment, identifying priority use cases and customer targets across regions.
Engage VP and C-level leaders at major mid/downstream companies, building trusted advisory relationships and connecting their operational challenges with AWS solutions.
Create and deliver technical content such as whitepapers, reference architectures, and solution briefs for use cases including digital twins and carbon management.
Build jointly with partners, customer account teams, and industry deployment and systems integrators to co-develop solutions for refining and pipeline operations.
A day in the life
Identify and qualify new business opportunities with energy customers in the Middle East, independently developing and executing strategies that align with regional priorities.
Leverage your network and industry expertise to build trusted relationships with C-suite executives, VPs of Technology, and engineering leaders, positioning AWS as the platform of choice.
Build and deliver technical presentations, workshops, and proof-of-concept demonstrations tailored to energy industry use cases such as OSDU, reservoir simulation, industrial IoT, digital twins, and advanced process control
Collaborate with and develop those around you, mentoring teammates, elevating partner capabilities, and sharing best practices that raise the bar for the entire team.
Proactively connect customers with the right AWS specialists, partners, and resources to accelerate their cloud journey and deliver tangible business results.
Develop and maintain a robust pipeline, tracking progress and providing accurate forecasts to leadership
Represent AWS Energy at regional industry events, conferences, and executive briefings across the Middle East.
About the team
The AWS Energy team works with some of the world's most complex and impactful companies to bring cloud computing to the energy industry. Our mission is to accelerate digital transformation across the energy value chain. We build alongside partners, customer account teams, and industry systems integrators to deliver real outcomes for our customers. The midstream and downstream segment represents a significant growth opportunity, and this role is central to building our presence with global refining, chemicals, and pipeline operators. We value curiosity and creative problem-solving, and we are committed to delivering results together.
Basic Qualifications
- 5+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
- 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Energy & Utilities industries experience
- 5+ years of professional or military experience, with 5+ years in Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting.
- Experience working with and presenting complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executives, and developing strategies that influence organizational-level leadership decisions.
- Experience with Data & AI technologies (AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage) and Advanced Compute technologies (Accelerated Compute, HPC, Visual/Spatial Compute, and/or IoT), plus a Bachelor’s degree.
Preferred Qualifications
- Master's degree in business economics, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, information technology or equivalent
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

# ****Job Description Summary****

Ready to gain hands-on experience and take the first step in your career journey? GE Vernova is offering a Co-op / Internship Program designed to help you learn, grow, and make a real impact.  
  
As part of the program, you’ll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with experienced professionals, and develop your leadership and communication skills and learn the GE Vernova way within your assigned function.  
  
If you’re eager to learn and ready to take the next step, we encourage you to apply. We welcome applications from diverse backgrounds, and candidates will be matched to suitable opportunities based on their academic background and interests.  
  
Program Duration: Up to 28 weeks (approximately 7 months)

# **Job Description**

**What You’ll Experience**

* Assignments & Projects: Work on projects aligned with your major to build practical experience
* Mentorship & Development: Learn from leaders across functions and develop leadership capabilities
* Exposure to Work Environment: Participate in hands-on activities and cross-functional collaboration

**Where You’ll Contribute**

**Materials & Operations:**

* Assist in material scheduling, inventory management, lean initiatives, process improvement, and system optimization.

**Engineering & Continuous Improvement:**

* Support project engineering, time studies, root cause analysis, and Lean/Kaizen projects.

**Sales & Services Support:**

* Help manage CRM data, support sales processes, customer service, parts delivery, and outage planning.

**Site Construction & Commissioning:**

* Assist in site planning, progress tracking, sub-contractor coordination, and safety compliance.

description:
### Role Overview

InnovationTeam is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the end-to-end delivery of strategic software and IT services engagements for key customers in Saudi Arabia. The role combines delivery leadership, customer relationship management, commercial discipline, and governance. The Senior Project Manager will be accountable for managing complex, business-critical technology projects from initiation through successful delivery and closure, ensuring alignment with contractual commitments, customer expectations, quality standards, and organizational objectives.

The successful candidate will provide senior-level leadership to multidisciplinary delivery teams, proactively manage project risks and dependencies, and maintain clear, decision-oriented communication with customer executives and internal leadership.

### Key Responsibilities

·   Own end-to-end delivery of complex software development, systems integration, digital transformation, and IT services projects.

·   Establish and maintain the project governance framework, ensuring compliance with delivery methodology, stage gates, quality controls, and change management processes.

·   Develop and manage integrated project plans covering scope, schedule, budget, resources, dependencies, quality, and acceptance criteria.

·   Maintain comprehensive RAID and decision logs, ensuring timely mitigation, escalation, and resolution of project risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies.

·   Lead project-level financial and commercial management, including budget tracking, resource utilization, revenue and cost awareness, milestone acceptance, and identification of contractual exposure.

·   Enforce formal change control and ensure additional customer requirements are assessed, estimated, approved, and commercially addressed before execution.

·   Manage cross-functional teams comprising software engineering, quality assurance, DevOps, architecture, business analysis, UX/UI, infrastructure, security, and third-party vendors.

·   Provide leadership and direction to Project Managers, workstream leads, technical leads, and delivery team members where applicable.

·   Apply appropriate SDLC and delivery methodologies, including Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid approaches, according to project and contractual requirements.

·   Ensure appropriate application of CI/CD, release management, configuration management, testing, and production deployment practices.

·   Lead customer governance meetings, executive reviews, SteerCo presentations, status reporting, and escalation discussions.

·   Translate complex technical and delivery information into clear, concise, and decision-ready communication for executive stakeholders.

·   Manage customer expectations, maintain strong working relationships, and drive timely decisions, approvals, and deliverable acceptance.

·   Coordinate resource planning with PMO, Operations, Engineering, and supporting functions, proactively addressing capacity gaps and delivery constraints.

·   Ensure project documentation, customer approvals, acceptance records, and contractual evidence are complete and properly maintained.

·   Drive project recovery plans when delivery deviates from agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, or customer expectations.

·   Support project closure, operational handover, lessons learned, and realization of agreed delivery outcomes.

·   Contribute to continuous improvement of PMO standards, delivery processes, templates, tools, metrics, and governance practices.

·   Support pre-sales and commercial teams when required by contributing to delivery approaches, estimates, assumptions, risks, resource plans, and transition strategies.

**Requirements**

### Education

·   Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

·   A master’s degree in business, technology, or project management is an advantage.

### Professional Experience

·   Minimum 10 years of total professional experience in software, technology, digital transformation, or IT services environments.

·   Minimum 6 years of direct project management experience with accountability for project scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, risks, and customer outcomes.

·   Proven experience managing complex software development or systems integration projects through the complete lifecycle, from initiation and planning through deployment, acceptance, and closure.

·   Demonstrated experience managing large enterprise or government customer accounts in Saudi Arabia.

·   Strong experience within a software development, IT consulting, systems integration, or managed services organization.

·   Experience leading cross-functional and geographically distributed delivery teams.

·   Demonstrated exposure to project financials, contract management, change requests, resource planning, and commercial risk.

·   Experience managing multiple workstreams, vendors, system dependencies, and senior stakeholders.

·   Previous experience working within STC, government entities, or other major KSA enterprise environments is highly desirable.

### Technical & Delivery Knowledge

·   Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and contemporary delivery models.

·   Practical knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid project delivery methodologies.

·   Good understanding of enterprise applications, digital platforms, APIs, integration architectures, cloud environments, and data migration.

·   Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, release management, quality assurance, and production deployment.

·   Strong competence in project planning, effort estimation, resource forecasting, financial tracking, RAID management, change control, and executive reporting.

·   Proficiency with common project and delivery management tools, such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, and Microsoft 365.

### Certifications

·   PMP certification is required.

·   PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, SAFe, CSM, PSM, or another recognized Agile certification is an advantage.

·   ITIL or a relevant service management certification is an advantage for candidates with managed services experience.

### Skills & Competencies

·   Strong leadership with hands-on ownership of delivery outcomes.

·   Excellent stakeholder management and customer relationship skills.

·   Executive-level communication and presentation capabilities.

·   Professional fluency in English; Arabic communication capability is strongly preferred.

·   Strong commercial awareness and ability to identify contractual or financial exposure before it materializes.

·   Ability to challenge unrealistic expectations professionally and protect approved project scope.

·   Structured problem-solving, negotiation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

·   Ability to work effectively under pressure and lead recovery of complex or challenged projects.

·   Strong attention to delivery evidence, governance discipline, and contractual documentation.

·   Collaborative leadership style with the ability to influence technical teams, business stakeholders, customers, and senior management.

### Work Requirements

·   Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

·   Availability: Maximum one-month notice period.

·   The role may require on-site customer engagement and travel within Saudi Arabia based on project requirements.

## Company Description

The FAENA Movement is a journey of art, culture, and community. Rooted in the soulful traditions of the South and elevated by imaginative design, our culture celebrates authentic hospitality and transformative experiences. We create spaces where dreams are brought to life—through bold ideas, meaningful collaboration, and a deep sense of purpose.  
  
As we continue our expansion into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Faena The Red Sea will mark a new chapter—visionary in spirit, exceptional in execution. We’re building more than a hotel; we’re shaping a world of beauty, wonder, and connection. If you’re driven by creativity, excellence, and a desire to be part of something extraordinary, we invite you to help bring this vision to life.

## Job Description

FAENA The Red Sea is seeking an exceptional and service-driven **Assistant Head Butler** to join our Guest Experience team. Supporting the Head Butler, this role is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operation of the Butler team while ensuring every villa guest receives an intuitive, personalised, and seamless luxury experience. The Assistant Head Butler will help drive Forbes Five-Star service standards, coordinate bespoke guest experiences, and inspire the team to deliver the exceptional hospitality that defines the FAENA brand.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the Head Butler in supervising and coordinating the daily operations of the Butler team.
* Ensure exceptional, personalised service is delivered to villa guests throughout their stay.
* Oversee daily butler operations to ensure luxury service standards are consistently achieved.
* Coordinate guest requests, preferences, and bespoke experiences with accuracy and attention to detail.
* Work closely with Front Office, Housekeeping, Culinary, Spa, Concierge, and Engineering to deliver seamless guest experiences.
* Ensure smooth arrival, in-villa stay, and departure experiences for all guests.
* Supervise villa preparation, turndown service, and in-room amenities to ensure impeccable presentation.
* Handle guest concerns and service recovery professionally and discreetly.
* Coach, mentor, and support the development of the Butler team to uphold Forbes Five-Star standards.
* Ensure guest preferences and profiles are accurately maintained to personalise future visits.
* Conduct quality inspections of villas prior to guest arrival.
* Assist with scheduling, daily task allocation, and operational planning for the Butler team.
* Support VIP arrivals, celebrations, special occasions, and bespoke in-villa experiences.
* Monitor service delivery and identify opportunities to continuously elevate the guest experience.
* Act as the primary point of contact in the absence of the Head Butler while maintaining the highest levels of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

## Qualifications

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management or a related field preferred.
* 3–6 years of experience in luxury butler service, guest relations, or villa operations.
* Previous experience in a supervisory or Senior Butler role within a Forbes Five-Star or ultra-luxury hotel or resort.
* Strong understanding of luxury hospitality standards and personalised guest service.
* Experience within Rooms Division, Butler Service, Front Office, or Guest Experience operations.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to anticipate guest needs and deliver intuitive, personalised service.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and guest management systems is advantageous.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.
* Passion for luxury hospitality and creating unforgettable guest experiences.

The Business Support Manager / Executive Assistant plays a vital role in ensuring the smooth operation of the Executive Director's office and the overall success of the Projects department. This individual will be responsible for managing executive priorities, communications, and meetings, as well as providing administrative, operational, and governance support. By creating a structured and efficient support system, the Business Support Manager enables the Executive Director and the PMO team to deliver accurate and timely outcomes.
Project duration: 5 months

Manage executive priorities, communications, and meetings, ensuring effective leadership coordination.
Streamline cross-functional workflows and standardize templates and trackers for efficient project management.
Support the development and implementation of PMO governance routines and reporting processes.
Conduct research, compile information, and provide recommendations to executive management for informed decision-making.
Create and maintain action trackers, project plans, schedules, and controlled support records for organized project execution.

Proven experience in coordinating teams, stakeholders, and project-support activities within a complex project environment.
Strong leadership-support, coordination, and stakeholder-management skills to effectively navigate executive priorities.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Security Manager , and facility safety – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
Here's what you'll do during a typical day:
+ Lead and develop the team: Recruit, train, supervise, and mentor security team members; conduct performance evaluations, provide professional development opportunities, and recognize achievements to build a motivated and high-performing team
+ Manage security operations: Implement security protocols to protect guests, employees, and property whilst ensuring compliance with local regulations and company brand standards.
+ Supervise property safety: Oversee security patrols, identify potential risks, and take proactive measures to address safety and security concerns
+ Support investigations: Assist in conducting investigations related to accidents, thefts, property loss, and policy violations, ensuring proper documentation and follow-up
+ Oversee emergency responses: Manage on-site emergency responses, including fires, medical incidents, and safety hazards, while coordinating with appropriate teams
+ Act as law enforcement liaison: Maintain communication as needed with local, state, and federal law enforcement agencies on security-related matters
+ Ensure accurate documentation: Review and maintain security reports, incident records, and compliance documentation
+ Support hotel operations as part of the leadership team: Take on duty manager responsibilities as needed and ensure compliance with safety protocols and hotel standards
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture
At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands (https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/) , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog (https://jobs.hilton.com/blogs) to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

## **Job Title**

Sales Manager – GCC & Middle East (Channels/ Distribution)

##   
**Location(s)**

Saudi Arabia - Remote

**About Us**

Revvity is a developer and provider of end-to-end solutions designed to help scientists, researchers, and clinicians solve the world’s greatest health challenges. We pair the enthusiasm of an industry disruptor with the experience of a longtime leader. Our team of 11,000+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health.

Find your future at Revvity

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute a channel/partner strategy for the GCC & Middle East region (excluding Turkey) covering distributors, system integrators, end-user labs, imaging facilities, pre-clinical research organisations, biopharma sites.
* Manage existing distributors and recruit/qualify new channel partners: set commercial terms, quotas, training, performance review, incentive schemes and joint business plans.
* Drive sales of our portfolio via channels: reproductive health diagnostic kits and systems, life sciences instruments/automation (sample prep, imaging, high‐content, animal imaging), infectious disease assays including T-SPOT.TB automation and workflows.
* Oversee distributor performance: sales pipeline, forecasting, margin management, inventory, promotional programmes, joint marketing activities.
* Work closely with regional product line managers, marketing, technical service, regulatory teams to support launches, regulatory clearance (KSA, UAE, GCC), customer training, after‐sales support.
* Deep knowledge of the KSA market: major labs, public/private healthcare networks, life sciences research institutes, automation budgets and procurement cycles.
* Monitor competitor activities, distributor landscape, market trends (diagnostics automation, animal imaging, HCS), and communicate insights to global management.
* Attend partner conferences, industry trade shows, distributors meetings, and represent Revvity in the region.
* Travel regionally (GCC/ME) as required (30-40%) and engage with cross‐functional global teams.

**Key Requirements / Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree (Business, Life Sciences, Engineering or equivalent); advanced degree (MBA, MSc) is a plus.
* 8-12 years’ experience in sales or channel management in the diagnostics/life sciences/automation industry, with strong exposure in the GCC & Middle East, and specifically in KSA.
* Proven success in managing distributors/channels, achieving sales targets via indirect model in the region.
* Strong operational understanding of automation, high‐content screening, imaging systems, animal imaging or instrumentation business; also a strong diagnostics portfolio (reproductive health, infectious disease) is highly desirable.
* Deep network in KSA and GCC: major labs, life sciences research institutes, distributor community, procurement organisations.
* Deep knowledge of GCC regulatory frameworks and regional logistics requirements, including SFDA, MOHAP, DHA, and other local authority approvals, as well as distributor importation processes, warehousing, cold-chain management, and customs regulations.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills, ability to develop joint business plans, manage complex distributor ecosystems, and drive growth through partners.
* Fluent in English; Arabic proficiency strongly preferred.
* Travel readiness across the region.
* Strong analytical skills: forecasting, pipeline management, channel metrics, margin discipline.

**Preferred but Not Mandatory**

* Prior experience launching diagnostic/automation solutions in Saudi Arabia (including registration/clearance, local regulations).
* Understanding of Gulf healthcare/regulatory environment, distributor contracts, incentive models, and public/private procurement dynamics.
* Experience in pre-clinical research or animal imaging business in the region.

  

*Revvity is a developer and provider of end-to-end solutions designed to help scientists, researchers, and clinicians solve the world’s greatest health challenges. We pair the enthusiasm of an industry disruptor with the experience of a longtime leader. Our team of 11,000+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health.*

*Find your future at Revvity*

description:
Eram Talent is seeking an experienced Mechanical Supervisor specializing in Rotatory Maintenance for a short-term assignment of 25 days. This role requires a highly skilled professional to oversee and manage rotatory equipment maintenance activities at the plant. The successful candidate will ensure efficient maintenance operations, minimize downtime, and maintain safety and quality standards.

The position offers the opportunity to work on critical plant equipment, directly contributing to operational efficiency. If you have strong expertise in rotatory maintenance and leadership skills, we encourage you to apply.

**Requirements**

* Minimum 7 years of experience in mechanical supervision with a focus on rotatory maintenance.
* Proven hands-on experience with rotating equipment such as pumps, compressors, fans, blowers, gearboxes, and motors.
* Experience working in a plant environment, preferably in oil & gas, power, chemical, or similar industries.
* Strong knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance of rotatory equipment.
* Ability to read and interpret P&ID, maintenance manuals, and technical drawings.
* Skilled in using measuring and alignment tools like dial gauges, laser alignment tools, feeler gauges, micrometers, and vernier calipers.
* Good leadership and communication skills to manage and coordinate maintenance teams effectively.
* Familiarity with safety regulations and practices related to mechanical maintenance.
* Ability to work efficiently under a short-term contract of 25 days with a focus on timely completion of maintenance tasks.

At OMQ, the Procurement Specialist plays a pivotal role in ensuring the availability of all required materials and supplies for event execution — at competitive prices, high quality, and timely delivery. The role is responsible for executing daily purchasing operations, negotiating with suppliers, managing quotations, following up on purchase orders, and ensuring timely supply aligned with quality standards and required specifications. The specialist also contributes to enhancing the procurement cycle's efficiency and improving supply chain performance in support of OMQ’s objective to reduce costs without compromising the quality of event preparations.  
  
**  
Key Responsibilities:**  
  
Review event requirements with the production, creative, and operations teams to identify needed materials and equipment.  
Source suitable suppliers based on quality, availability, and cost, and obtain competitive quotations.  
Generate purchase orders, follow up on necessary approvals, and ensure orders are delivered on schedule as per the event timeline.  
Verify contract and purchase compliance with budget allocations and agreed terms prior to signing.  
Analyze quotations based on quality, price, payment terms, and delivery timeline, and recommend the most optimal choice.  
Supervise the Logistics Coordinator to ensure delivery timelines align with the overall event schedule and materials meet approved specifications.  
Address any delays or supply issues promptly without disrupting event execution.  
Build and maintain a comprehensive supplier database, categorized by supplier rating, material types, quality, and priority, with continuous updates.  
Prepare periodic reports on procurement performance indicators and propose improvements to the procurement cycle.

  

**Qualifications and Requirements**  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.  
2–3 years of experience in procurement, preferably in the events industry.  
Strong negotiation skills to secure optimal value.  
Solid understanding of supply chain fundamentals, contracts, and material technical specifications.  
Good knowledge of purchasing costs, payment terms, and pricing methods.  
Ability to analyze quotations and evaluate suppliers based on quality and compliance criteria.  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ERP systems (such as Odoo).

Work Condition: Office and Outdoor activities

description:
We are looking for a **Strategic Partnerships & Influencer Lead** to build and lead moomoo’s partnership and creator growth strategy in Saudi Arabia.

You will identify the partners, creators and communities that influence Saudi investors, build strong local relationships, structure commercially effective collaborations, and turn them into measurable business growth.

As an early member of the Saudi team, you will have significant ownership in shaping moomoo’s local influencer and partnership strategy, while building and leading the team as the business scales.

**1\. Build Local Influencer & Partnership Strategy**

* Map the Saudi influencer, financial, media and business ecosystem and identify high-potential opportunities.
* Develop local partnership strategies that drive brand awareness, customer acquisition, AUM and revenue.
* Identify new growth opportunities based on local market insights.

**2\. Own Strategic Partnerships**

* Source and build relationships with financial institutions, media, fintechs, consumer platforms, major brands and other strategic partners.
* Own the full partnership cycle from outreach and negotiation to launch and performance review.
* Develop creative cooperation models including co-marketing, education, referral programs, events, sponsorships and integrated campaigns.

**3\. Build and Scale the Influencer Network**

* Identify and build relationships with leading finance, investing, business and relevant mainstream creators.
* Develop a strong influencer portfolio across different audience segments and content formats.
* Negotiate sustainable long-term, performance-based or exclusive cooperation models.
* Work with creators to develop content that aligns with both audience needs and business objectives.

**4\. Drive Commercial Results**

* Own the commercial performance of influencer and partnership channels.
* Evaluate opportunities based on CAC, customer quality, AUM, trading activity, revenue and strategic value.
* Track performance, optimize partnerships and prioritize opportunities with the strongest business impact.

**5\. Build Local Market Intelligence**

* Develop a strong understanding of how Saudi investors discover, evaluate and trust financial platforms.
* Build relationships across the local financial and business ecosystem.
* Monitor competitors, creators, platforms and emerging opportunities, and translate insights into local growth strategies.

**6\. Lead Cross-functional Execution**

* Work closely with Marketing, Operations, Product, Compliance, Legal, Brand and Data teams to move opportunities from idea to execution.
* Coordinate internal resources, timelines and requirements for partnership launches.
* Ensure influencer and partnership activities meet local regulatory and internal requirements.

**7\. Build & Lead the Team**

* Build and lead the Saudi Partnerships & influencer team as the market scales.
* Set team priorities, targets and execution standards, and ensure strong delivery against business goals.
* Coach and develop team members across prospecting, relationship management, negotiation and commercial execution.
* Establish scalable processes and local playbooks for sourcing, evaluating and managing partnerships and influencers.
* Build a high-ownership, commercially driven team culture and contribute to moomoo’s broader Saudi growth strategy.

**Requirements**

* **5+ years of experience** in business development, strategic partnerships, influencer/KOL partnerships, fintech, financial services, technology or media.
* Proven ability to source, negotiate and close meaningful commercial partnerships.
* Proven experience leading, coaching or developing BD, Partnership or KOL teams, with the ability to drive both individual and team performance.
* Strong understanding of the Saudi business, creator, media and digital ecosystem.
* Excellent relationship-building and communication skills with creators, founders and senior decision-makers.
* Strong commercial judgement and analytical ability, including understanding of CAC, AUM, revenue and ROI.
* Able to work from strategy through hands-on execution in a fast-moving, early-stage market.
* Strong cross-functional coordination and project-management skills.
* **Fluent English** required; **Arabic and deep Saudi market knowledge strongly preferred**.
* Experience in brokerage, investing, fintech or financial services is highly preferred.

description:
Job Description

With operations in 100 countries, JPMorgan Chase is a true global leader in the financial services industry. We believe the true measure of our success lies in the trusted relationships we share with our clients, our reputation in the industry, and the quality and integrity of the services we provide. In every area of our work, we're committed to being the best and doing what's right for our clients. And it's that unshakeable commitment shared by everyone at JPMorgan Chase which makes this such a rewarding place to build a career.

Job Summary

As a 2027 Corporate & Investment Bank - Global Corporate Banking Program - Large- Cap - Off-Cycle Internship (January- June & July-December) Saudi within JPMorgan Chase, you will spend your internship alongside top professionals in the business, developing strategies that help our government, institutional, and corporate clients grow and innovate. You will have the opportunity to analyse market data, manage client transactions, and come up with innovative solutions to complex business challenges. We will provide you with the necessary support and training to help you succeed in this dynamic and collaborative work environment.

Job Responsibilities

Assisting GCB bankers in managing internal aspects of existing client relationships

Helping with industry and credit analysis, including reviewing financial statements, supporting the credit approval and documentation process

Gaining exposure to product, strategy, or client coverage-based teams

Preparing internal memos, for example senior management briefings, decision committee memoranda

Participating in the analysis and negotiation of financing requests in coordination with credit, product, legal and compliance teams

Coordinating with product and country teams to identify and execute transactions for clients globally across a range of products, for example capital markets, risk solutions, transaction banking

Networking with industry leaders, accessing best-in-class training and learning how all our businesses work together to provide excellent customer service

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills.

Exceptional analytical, research and project management skills

Familiarity with business fundamentals

Ability to quickly solve problems on your own and with a team

Enthusiasm, energy and a drive to succeed

A collaborative mindset and willingness to partner and work on a team

The confidence and initiative to take on early responsibility and manage your own projects

Proficiency in MS Word and Excel

Fluency in English and Arabic

Expected graduation date between January 2027 and December 2028

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

Being on-track for a United Kingdom 2:1 Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in your undergraduate studies is preferred.

Application deadline: January-June, 31st July 2026, July-December, 6th November 2026

We will be filling our classes on a rolling basis. We strongly encourage you to submit your application as early as possible before job postings close.

At JPMorgan Chase, we’re creating positive change for the diverse communities we serve. We do this by championing your innovative ideas through a supportive culture that helps you every step of the way as you build your career. description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!

At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Interior Design (ID) Manager to join our team. The (ID) Manager will lead the interior design efforts for high-end luxury construction projects, ensuring the highest standards of design, quality, and craftsmanship. The role requires an experienced professional with a strong background in managing luxury interior design projects internationally. The ID Manager will oversee all interior design phases, from concept development through to project completion, ensuring alignment with the client’s vision, luxury standards, and project objectives. This position demands a blend of creativity, leadership, and technical expertise to manage large-scale luxury projects, working closely with clients, consultants, and project teams across global markets.  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**  
  
**Interior Design Leadership & Oversight:**  
• Lead the development of interior design concepts for luxury residential, commercial, and hospitality projects.  
• Ensure that all design elements, including layouts, materials, finishes, and furnishings, meet luxury standards and reflect the client’s vision.  
• Provide strategic leadership to the interior design team, ensuring the seamless delivery of all design phases from concept through construction.

**Project Coordination & Collaboration:**  
• Collaborate with architects, MEP teams, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure that interior design elements integrate smoothly with the overall project design.  
• Lead coordination meetings with internal teams and external consultants to resolve design challenges and ensure alignment with luxury standards.  
• Manage the interface between interior design and other disciplines, ensuring consistency and cohesion across all project elements.  


**Luxury Interior Execution:**  
• Oversee the selection and specification of high-end materials, finishes, fixtures, and custom furnishings, ensuring they align with the luxury project’s design narrative.  
• Ensure that all interior spaces reflect the unique luxury aesthetics required for each project, balancing functionality and elegance.  
• Review detailed interior design documentation, drawings, and specifications, ensuring precision and adherence to luxury standards.  


**Quality Control & Design Integrity:**  
• Implement robust quality control processes to ensure that all interior design elements meet the highest luxury and craftsmanship standards.  
• Regularly review design deliverables, ensuring they comply with the client’s vision, international building codes, and local regulations.  
• Ensure design integrity is maintained throughout construction and fit-out, coordinating closely with contractors and on-site teams to resolve any design-related issues.  


**Client Engagement & Relationship Management:**  
• Serve as the primary point of contact for clients on all interior design matters, understanding their expectations and ensuring the design exceeds them.  
• Present interior design concepts, mood boards, material selections, and progress updates to clients, incorporating their feedback while maintaining the integrity of the luxury design vision.  
• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, ensuring ongoing collaboration and satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.  


**Budget & Schedule Management:**  
• Work closely with the project management team to ensure that the interior design aligns with the overall project budget and schedule, without compromising luxury quality.  
• Prepare and review cost estimates for interior design elements, ensuring selections align with project budgets and financial objectives.  
• Monitor procurement and delivery of materials, furniture, and finishes to ensure timely completion in line with project milestones.  


**Sustainability & Innovation:**  
• Integrate sustainable and innovative design practices into luxury interiors, ensuring environmentally responsible solutions without sacrificing aesthetics.  
• Stay updated with global trends in luxury interior design, ensuring the latest innovations and technologies are incorporated into project designs.  
  
**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**  


• Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.

• A minimum of 15-18 years of experience in interior design management, with at least 10 years focused on luxury projects.

• Extensive international experience managing large-scale, high-end luxury residential, commercial, or hospitality projects.  
• Strong background working with high-profile clients and delivering interior designs of the highest standards in international markets.  
• Technical Skills:  
• Proficiency in interior design software such as AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, and other visualization tools.  
• Strong knowledge of luxury materials, finishes, and bespoke furnishings, including international sourcing and procurement.  
• Deep understanding of local and international building codes, sustainability practices, and luxury design standards.  
• Soft Skills:  
• Excellent leadership, team management, and mentoring abilities, with experience leading multidisciplinary design teams.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

The Surveyor will be responsible for carrying out all surveying activities related to bridge and infrastructure construction works on the Projects. The role involves providing accurate site measurements, setting out works, verifying construction alignment and levels, conducting as-built surveys, and supporting project teams to ensure all works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.

## Your role

**Surveying & Setting Out**

* Perform site surveys, control point establishment, and setting out for bridge and infrastructure works.
* Conduct horizontal and vertical alignment checks for bridges, roads, retaining walls, culverts, and associated structures.
* Set out foundations, pile locations, abutments, piers, bridge decks, utility corridors, and roadway elements.
* Verify coordinates, levels, dimensions, and structural positioning before and during construction activities.
* Ensure survey control networks are maintained throughout the project lifecycle.

**Construction Support**

* Provide survey support to construction, engineering, and quality teams.
* Monitor construction tolerances and ensure compliance with approved design requirements.
* Assist in resolving field measurement discrepancies and coordinate with design and site teams.
* Prepare and validate as-built surveys for completed construction works.
* Support progress measurement and quantity verification activities.

**Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure all surveying activities comply with project specifications, client requirements, and industry standards.
* Maintain accurate survey records, reports, and documentation.
* Verify contractor survey submissions and provide technical recommendations as required.
* Support quality inspections and audits related to survey activities.

**Technology & Data Management**

* Operate and maintain survey equipment including:
    * Total Stations
    * GPS/GNSS Systems
    * Digital Levels
    * Laser Scanners (where applicable)
* Process field survey data and produce survey reports, drawings, and coordinate files.
* Utilize survey software and CAD platforms for data analysis and reporting.
* Ensure integrity and accuracy of all survey information generated on site.

**Health, Safety & Environmental Compliance**

* Adhere to all project HSE requirements and safe working practices.
* Participate in toolbox talks, safety briefings, and project safety initiatives.
* Ensure surveying operations are conducted safely in active construction environments.

## About you

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Surveying, Geomatics, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Professional surveying certification or registration is preferred.
* Minimum 5-10 years of surveying experience within major civil infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 3 years of dedicated bridge construction experience.
* Previous experience on GCC or KSA projects is highly desirable.
* Experience working with international consultants, contractors, or government infrastructure projects is preferred.
* Strong understanding of bridge geometry, structural alignment, and construction tolerances.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, IFC drawings, and survey control data.
* Strong knowledge of infrastructure construction methodologies.
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Effective communication and coordination abilities.
* Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary project teams.
* Strong organizational and reporting skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet project deadlines.

## Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Tax-free salary.
* Life insurance coverage.
* Medical insurance.
* Annual leave balance.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Annual flight contribution.
* Transportation & housing allowances.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Senior Project Control Engineer/ Specialist** to join our team!

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Provides guidance, direction, and specialized assistance for the resolution of complex project control and cost control problems.
    

* Analyzes, evaluates, and forecasts status against an established baseline schedule.
    
* Sets up a baseline budget for resources, revenue, and cost using an appropriate WBS in coordination with the Project Manager.

* Utilizes historical data and trends to maintain a realistic basis for future planning and forecasting.
    
* Monitors and tracks project progress and perform Earned Value Management, including calculation and reporting of EV, EAC and ETC to assess performance and forecast final project cost.
    
* Participates in monthly and quarterly reviews and supports the project team in explaining variances and justifications.
    
* Supports the Project Director in reviewing and finalizing the business plan.
    
* Completes performance reviews for direct reports and supports personnel development.
    
* Customize project control systems to meet specific project requirements.

* Develop and maintain schedules for construction and design projects
    
* Support Billing and Collection process from preparing invoices to coordinating with other stakeholders for timely collection
    
* Preparation of multiple Trackers / Logs to monitor cost related information and issues.
    
* Supervise and mentor Project Controls engineers when required
    
* Performs other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.
    

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor of Engineering/Finance
    
* **+10 years of experience** in construction, design or other related projects
    
* Proficient PC skills including proficiency in various Project Controls software (PMIS, Oracle PM related software, Primavera).
    
* MS Office proficiency plus Excel Advanced knowledge.
    
* Good communication and team player.
    
* Stakeholders Management.
    
* Power BI knowledge and experience

description:
## Company Description

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,460 hotels in operation and under development in 95+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos.  
  
People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

## Job Description

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Spa Manager to lead our luxury spa facility in Mansard Riyadh, A Radisson Collection Hotel. As Spa Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of spa operations, ensuring exceptional guest experiences, and driving business growth while maintaining the highest standards of service excellence. This is an exciting opportunity to lead a dynamic team in one of the region's most prestigious hospitality environments, where your strategic vision and operational expertise will directly impact our organization's success and reputation.

* Lead, mentor, and motivate a diverse spa team, fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages professional development and continuous improvement
* Oversee all daily spa operations, including scheduling, resource allocation, and workflow optimization to ensure seamless service delivery
* Develop and implement strategic initiatives to enhance guest experiences, increase customer satisfaction, and build long-term loyalty
* Manage financial performance, including budgeting, revenue forecasting, cost control, and pricing strategies to maximize profitability
* Maintain rigorous quality assurance standards across all spa treatments and services, conducting regular audits and implementing corrective actions as needed
* Coordinate with hotel departments and external partners to create integrated guest journeys and support marketing initiatives
* Innovate and develop new spa treatments, wellness programs, and promotional offerings that align with market trends and guest preferences
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, and regulatory requirements, maintaining detailed documentation and conducting staff training on protocols
* Analyze operational metrics and guest feedback to identify opportunities for improvement and make data-driven decisions
* Manage vendor relationships, procurement, and inventory to optimize quality and cost-effectiveness
* Conduct performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and support staff onboarding and training programs
* Handle guest concerns with empathy and professionalism, resolving issues decisively while maintaining transparency and service excellence

## Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field; certification in Spa Management, Wellness, or similar discipline is preferred
* Minimum 3 or more years of progressive experience in spa or hospitality management, with proven track record of leading teams and managing operations
* Demonstrated expertise in financial management, budgeting, revenue analysis, and business performance optimization
* Strong leadership and people management skills with the ability to inspire, develop, and retain high-performing teams
* Exceptional guest service orientation with a commitment to delivering luxury experiences and exceeding expectations consistently
* Comprehensive knowledge of spa treatments, wellness concepts, industry trends, and best practices in the spa and hospitality sector
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and engage with diverse, international clientele
* Proficiency in spa management software, point-of-sale systems, and other relevant technology platforms
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a detail-oriented approach to quality assurance and operational excellence
* Strategic thinking and visionary mindset with the ability to innovate and drive organizational growth
* Knowledge of health, safety, compliance, and regulatory requirements specific to spa and wellness facilities
* Flexibility and resilience in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with the ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing circumstances
* Proven ability to manage vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and optimize procurement processes

## Additional Information

**Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?**

**Live the Magic of Hospitality -** Be part of a team that creates **exceptional experiences and memorable moments** every day. Let your **Yes I Can!** spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

**Build a Great Career -** No matter your background or experience, we invest in your **growth, learning, and career development**—helping you reach your full potential.

**Experience the Team Spirit -** Join a workplace that’s **inclusive, fun, and meaningful**. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our **Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives**.

**Lead with Your Ambition -** Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to **make a difference**—in hospitality, your community and beyond.

**Enjoy Global & Local Perks -** No matter where you’re located, you’ll enjoy exclusive global benefits - like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!

**Join us in shaping the future of hospitality!** If you’re ready to **bring your talent, energy, and passion**, we’d love to hear from you.

**Apply now and let’s make every moment matter.**

We welcome applicants from all **backgrounds, abilities, and experiences**. If you need any adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

description:
**About the Role**

We are recruiting a Creator Park Manager to join a dedicated, full-time team embedded in our client’s Festival Programming function in Riyadh. The team will support two major events in Saudi Arabia: a flagship event in summer 2027 (July to August) and a further event in November 2027.

You will run the festival’s influencer zone, the Creator Park. You will decide which creators appear and when, and shape everything fans experience there, including:

* Stage schedules
* Creator line-ups
* The content calendar
* Fan experiences
* Content capture

You will recommend creators to the client and design the formats, such as showmatches, meet and greets and community moments. You will also plan the practical set-up behind every format, from PCs and internet connectivity to filming and creator areas, and make real-time decisions on site.

This is a hands-on producing role. The grade reflects your seniority and judgement, not the size of a team you supervise. We are looking for a programmer who personally builds the creator schedules, formats and content calendars.

**Key Responsibilities**

Creator Park Programming

* Programme the Creator Park, including its stages, creator schedules, content calendar, fan experience and content capture.
* Build a line-up and schedule that keeps fans engaged throughout each event.

Creator and Talent Coordination

* Identify and recommend creators to the client, who makes the final decision and handles contracting.
* Coordinate with creators, creator organisations and talent management teams.

Format Design

* Design formats such as showmatches, meet and greets, community moments and content capture.
* Define the mechanics, throughput, space and staffing needs of every format.

Operational Planning

* Plan the operational needs of the Creator Park, including hardware, software, connectivity, content capture, stages and creator areas.
* Turn creative formats into clear technical and operational requirements.

Live Delivery and Review

* Make real-time decisions on site during the live events.
* Capture performance after each event cycle so the programme can keep improving.

**Requirements**

* At least 5 years of experience in creator-led programming or esports events, at Manager level.
* Experience across at least two live event seasons.
* A proven record of personally producing creator and club programming, scheduling and live delivery. Only experience where you personally produced the work counts towards the requirement.

**Ideal Background**

* A creator, influencer or esports programmer from large-scale live events.
* Established relationships with creator organisations and talent management are a strong advantage.

**Languages**

* Professional English is required.
* Arabic is preferred.

**Working Conditions**

* Full-time and exclusive: you will be dedicated to the client for the full contract term, with no other clients or projects.
* Working options: work remotely on Riyadh hours (Sunday to Thursday), with travel to Riyadh and event locations as directed, or be based at the client’s office in Riyadh.
* On site in Riyadh: you must be in Riyadh for the full operating periods of the summer 2027 event (July to August) and the November 2027 event, whichever working option you choose.

**Benefits**

* A competitive package for the duration of a 14-month contract, with the potential to extend by up to 3 months
* Flexible working, with a remote option during the planning phase
* Creative ownership of the festival’s creator and influencer programme
* A senior, hands-on role in a dedicated specialist team embedded with a major client
* Valuable experience on one of the region’s most high-profile live events programmes

**Position Summary**

The Manager – Security & Threat leads the governance of security operations and threat management across Qiddiya Workers Villages.

**Key Purpose of the Role**

To prevent, detect, and respond to security threats through disciplined security governance and emergency preparedness.

**Key Responsibilities**

·       Develop and implement security and threat management frameworks.

·       Oversee access control, patrols, and CCTV operations.

·       Lead threat assessments and vulnerability analyses.

·       Coordinate intelligence and threat alerts with authorities.

·       Investigate security incidents and implement corrective actions.

·       Ensure compliance with Saudi security regulations.

·       Maintain training and licensing compliance.

**Key Deliverables and Accountabilities**

·       Approved security and threat frameworks.

·       Threat risk registers and assessments.

·       Incident investigation reports.

·       Emergency and crisis response plans.

·       Security KPI dashboards and reports.

**KPIs/ Performance Metrics**

·       Security incident rate and response time.

·       Threat assessment completion rate.

·       Access control compliance rate.

·       Training and licensing compliance rate.

·       Audit non-conformance rate.

**Requirements**

**Experience Requirements**

·       Minimum 8 years of experience in security and threat management.

·       At least 3 years in a managerial role.

**Technical and Professional Competencies**

·       Security governance and SOP development.

·       Threat assessment and vulnerability analysis.

·       Access control and surveillance systems.

·       Incident investigation and crisis response.

·       Contractor performance management.

**Behavioral Competencies**

·       Leadership and accountability.

·       Stakeholder engagement and collaboration.

·       Decision-making under pressure.

·       Integrity and professionalism.

·       Continuous improvement mindset.

**Authority and Decision- Making limits**

·       Stop unsafe or non-compliant security practices.

·       Escalate credible threats to leadership and authorities.

·       Approve corrective security action plans.

Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential.
