**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Project Controls Manager** to join our team. In this role, you will develop, manage, and execute all phases of the project controls effort for a major iconic metro station project, including planning, scheduling, cost analysis, reporting, forecasting, and performance monitoring.

Position Overview: Develops, manages, and/or executes all phases of the project controls effort for a major iconic metro station project, including planning, scheduling, cost analysis, progress measurement, forecasting, reporting, and change control. The incumbent utilizes widely diversified knowledge of project controls activities and draws upon extensive experience and exposure to major transportation infrastructure, metro, rail, station, and complex building projects. The role supports the successful delivery of the project by monitoring performance against schedule, budget, milestones, and contractual requirements.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Develop, manage, and execute all phases of the project controls effort, including planning, scheduling, cost analysis, progress measurement, forecasting, reporting, and change control.
    
* Provide guidance, direction, and specialized assistance to the project for the resolution of difficult and complex project control problems.
    
* Interface with clients, attend regular meetings, and provide statistical, progress, cost, schedule, and performance reports.
    
* Manage a team of Project Control Engineers/Specialists responsible for analyzing, evaluating, and forecasting project costs and schedule performance.
    
* Oversee the development and maintenance of the project baseline schedule, including critical milestones, interfaces, testing, commissioning, and handover requirements.
    
* Assess the impact of design changes, construction changes, interface issues, delays, and schedule slippages.
    
* Oversee the development and maintenance of project controls systems, reports, dashboards, and performance analysis.
    
* Coordinate project controls requirements across civil, structural, architectural, MEP, systems, finishes, public realm, testing, commissioning, and handover activities.
    
* Coordinate staffing requirements, assign and supervise project controls work activities, and train personnel.
    
* Complete performance reviews and provide personnel development for assigned employees.
    
* Support change management by providing schedule and cost impact analysis for variations, claims, delays, and potential change orders.
    
* Keep project and company management fully informed of project controls status, issues, trends, and risks.
    
* Participate in business development efforts by gathering and presenting a variety of background data, as required.
    
* Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.
    

What Required Skills You’ll Bring

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Construction Management or related field, or equivalent work experience.
    
* Minimum 12 years of related experience.
    
* Experience in a supervisory capacity.
    
* Experience in project controls on major transportation infrastructure, metro, rail, transit station, or complex building projects.
    
* Requires basic engineering knowledge in electrical, mechanical, civil, or a related field.
    
* Proficient PC skills, including proficiency in various Project Controls Software and Microsoft Office Suite.
    
* Strong knowledge of planning, scheduling, cost control, progress measurement, forecasting, reporting, change control, and performance analysis.
    
* Proven ability to perform in a supervisory capacity.
    
* Thorough knowledge of industry practices.
    
* Strong analytical, communication, coordination, and reporting skills.
    
* Ability to meet Parsons Project Controls Manager Certification requirements.
    

**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring**

* Experience on iconic metro station, rail, transit, or major transportation infrastructure projects is preferred.
    
* Experience supporting civil, structural, architectural, MEP, systems, finishes, public realm, testing, commissioning, and handover activities.
    
* Experience with Primavera P6 or equivalent planning and scheduling software.
    
* Experience with project controls dashboards, reporting systems, PMIS platforms, and digital delivery tools.
    
* Strong understanding of schedule and cost impact analysis for changes, claims, delays, and interface issues.
    
* Experience working with clients, consultants, suppliers, subcontractors, government agencies, and regulatory authorities.
    
* Regional experience in Saudi Arabia or the Middle East would be an advantage.

description:
## Company Description

Join a hotel that is a member of the Accor network, whose group brings together more than 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants and lifestyle destinations. Here, we believe in you and what you bring to the table. There are many opportunities for development and advancement. Every gesture, every smile, every action, contributes to creating a positive and memorable impact for our customers, our colleagues and also for our planet. Together, we embody the vision of responsible hospitality.

Take the opportunity to become a Heartist®, and let your heart guide you in this world where life beats faster.

## Job Description

We are seeking a professional and customer-focused Royal Service and Reservations Agent to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our valued guests, managing reservations, handling inquiries, and delivering exceptional service that reflects our commitment to excellence. You will work in a fast-paced environment where attention to detail, organizational skills, and a genuine passion for customer satisfaction are essential to success.

* Process and manage guest reservations through multiple channels, ensuring accuracy and timely confirmation
* Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, and other communication platforms with professionalism and courtesy
* Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date reservation records and guest information in our system
* Coordinate with various departments to ensure seamless service delivery and guest satisfaction
* Handle special requests and customize arrangements to meet individual guest needs
* Resolve customer concerns and complaints promptly and professionally
* Manage booking schedules, availability, and room allocations efficiently
* Provide guests with detailed information about services, amenities, and local attractions
* Process payments and transactions accurately while maintaining confidentiality
* Contribute to achieving occupancy and revenue targets through effective sales techniques
* Ensure compliance with company policies and hospitality standards

## Qualifications

* Proven experience of 2+ years in customer service, reservations, or hospitality industry
* Excellent communication skills in English; Arabic language proficiency is highly preferred
* Strong organizational and time management abilities with the capacity to multitask
* Proficiency with reservation management systems and computer applications
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record-keeping
* Problem-solving skills with the ability to handle challenging situations calmly
* Customer-focused mindset with a genuine commitment to service excellence
* Professional demeanor and ability to work effectively in a team environment
* Familiarity with luxury hospitality service standards and protocols
* Knowledge of CRM software and booking platforms is preferred
* Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays as required
* Strong interpersonal skills and cultural sensitivity

## Additional Information

**Your Team and Working Environment:**

Join our warm and welcoming **Royal Service & Reservations team**, where exceptional guest service, attention to detail, teamwork, and guest satisfaction are at the heart of everything we do. In this dynamic and fast-paced environment, you will work closely with the Royal Service, Reservations, and other hotel departments to ensure a seamless and personalized guest experience.

As a **Royal Service & Reservation Agent**, you will play an important role in handling guest requests, inquiries, and reservations professionally and efficiently. You will be responsible for providing accurate information, coordinating guest requirements, and ensuring all requests are followed up and delivered to the highest standards. You will contribute to the smooth day-to-day operation of the department while maintaining excellent communication and service standards at all times.

Alomar Holding Company, a leading Saudi Arabian investment group specializing in real estate development and construction, is seeking a Procurement Manager to drive procurement excellence across its diverse business units. As part of a dynamic organization committed to quality, governance, and sustainable growth, you will play a pivotal role in shaping procurement strategies that support long-term value creation and align with the Kingdom’s economic vision.

Key responsibilities include:

* Develop and implement comprehensive procurement strategies to support company goals.
* Lead and manage the procurement team across various business units, providing guidance and mentorship.
* Negotiate contracts and agreements with suppliers to secure favorable terms and cost savings.
* Monitor market trends and supplier performance to identify risks and opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to forecast procurement needs and ensure timely delivery of goods and services.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, legal regulations, and ethical standards in all procurement activities.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance procurement processes, efficiency, and value creation.
* Manage supplier relationships to build strong partnerships and ensure quality and reliability of supply.

### Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field
* 7+ years of procurement experience, including at least 3 years in a managerial role leading teams
* Procurement experience within construction or real estate development, including sourcing construction materials and subcontractor services
* Hands-on experience with strategic sourcing, negotiation, contract management, and procurement process improvement
* Experience using Odoo ERP or similar procurement systems
* Knowledge of relevant legal and regulatory procurement frameworks
* Business fluent in Arabic and English
* Proven ability to partner with internal stakeholders across finance, legal, operations, and project/construction teams, and to present procurement strategies to senior leadership

### Preferred Qualifications:

* MBA or equivalent advanced degree
* Experience managing logistics contracts within procurement
* Experience monitoring supplier performance and driving supplier relationship management initiatives
* Experience managing external stakeholder relationships with suppliers, subcontractors, and logistics/service providers
* Experience presenting procurement savings and risk updates to board-level stakeholders

* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage
* Pension scheme in accordance with Saudi labor regulations
* Paid annual leave and public holidays
* Professional development and training opportunities

Electrical Technician II

KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) provides holistic and value-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle. These include world-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets.

KBR is looking for Electrician, Helper

**Responsibilities:** 

* To lead, supervise and coordinate the day to-day activities of Instrument maintenance activities develop by technician on all Instrument systems plant, equipment and facilities within the designated area of responsibility. He is the Focal point for daily Instrument maintenance execution plan
* Ensure that technician complies and applied SATORP's Safety and Quality procedures, during the execution of Instrument maintenance activities.
* Conduct frequent site visits to ensure proper execution of work and check on the activity’s technicians engaged in routine maintenance activities.
* Lead and Technicians assigned to his area.
* Receive work directions from the Instrument foreman in relation to
* Instrument systems maintenance orders/requests and ensure translating these directions into actions.
* Follow-up on Instrument maintenance work progress and submit regular progress reports to the Instrument foreman with recommendations.  Keep a record of daily maintenance works against planned maintenance programs and prepare work completion reports, where applicable.
* Work closely with Instrument foreman in recommending and implementing changes aimed at improving the availability and reliability of
* Instrument/instrument systems within the designated area of responsibility.
* Assist in implementing engineering modifications and enhancements to Instrument equipment by making recommendations to increase the suitability and serviceability of Instrument systems.
* Enforce SATORP’s policies, procedures and regulations and ensure that all safety measures and precautions are strictly considered and taken care of during conducting onsite maintenance works.
* Proactive Safety aptitude and behavior.
* Strong knowledge of maintaining and repairing Instrument systems.
* Good knowledge in Instrument equipment design, installation and maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of maintaining and repairing Mechanical and electro hydraulic systems
* Good knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance principles and working procedures.
* Strong knowledge of standards, procedures and regulation to develop activities taking care of Health, Safety and Environmental preservation 
* Strong communication and people skills.
* Ability to perform work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
* Synergic and Capable of handling multiple tasks.
* Good commands oral and written English.
* Ensure that personnel have the skills, training and all needed resources,   
    equipment’s and tools to conduct routine maintenance activities in safe   
    and effectively manner, according to the contract terms and conditions.

* Minimum 6 years’ experience in Oil & Gas maintenance – High School.
* Minimum 4 years’ experience in Oil & Gas maintenance – Diploma.
* Hold a valid certification issued by a recognized third-party certification body or an accredited Saudi institute, attesting to the individual’s qualifications and competency to perform the works.
* Strong technical understanding of maintenance management of Oil & Gas Facilities
* Well organized and proactive with excellent communication skills
* Proven leadership skills with large organizations
* Maturity of judgment under pressure and ability to resolve problems
* Strategic management skills
* An ability to achieve business results working in a multi-cultural environment
* Flexibility to travel internationally and live in KSA

**Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!**

* **We Are a Team of Teams –** We have a will to succeed, but we value the achievements of our team of teams over individual accomplishments. Our collective focus makes us a better, stronger, more effective company.

Not only are we committed to operating safely, sustainably and equitably, but we are also committed to using our capabilities and expertise to help our customers accomplish their sustainability goals.

Al Khobar, KSA / Hybrid | Full-time | Principal individual contributor | Reports to VP Engineering

About the company:

The company is a construction-technology company headquartered in Al Khobar, KSA. We build a connected-worker platform for large construction and industrial sites. Smart helmets, anchors, and gateways feed a real-time SaaS platform that supports worker location, safety compliance, automated mustering, and productivity analytics across major GCC projects.

About the role:

As Principal Platform Engineer, you will be the senior individual contributor accountable for the platform's technical integrity. You will set architecture, make critical implementation contributions, and lead across boundaries through design quality and earned technical trust.

This is not an engineering-management role. You will not own hiring, performance cycles, or sprint administration. You will mentor engineers, establish contribution standards, unblock hard technical work, and partner with engineering management and Product on sequencing and team health.

What success looks like - first 6 months:

You understand architecture, ownership boundaries, open decisions, and production risks deeply enough to lead a walkthrough of any core platform area.

The most consequential platform decisions are captured in clear architecture decision records, with explicit trade-offs and evidence.

The AIP layer - including agent runtime, MCP surface, and AI-powered product capabilities - has a coherent technical direction and at least one production-shaped vertical slice.

The contribution standard is operational: scoped issues, reviewable changes, clear component boundaries, reliable tests, and links between implementation and architecture.

You have delivered a material platform capability or de-risked a major architectural uncertainty through working software and measurable validation.

Engineering, Product, Hardware, Field Engineering, and leadership trust your technical judgment and understand the platform direction.

What you will own:

Architecture across ontology and semantics, governed pipelines and lineage, streaming and data sources, SDK and API surfaces, authorization and governance, application services, and release infrastructure.

Architecture decision records for consequential platform choices, revisiting old decisions when evidence or implementation pressure indicates a better path.

The technical direction of WC3's AI-native capabilities, including agent runtime design, MCP interfaces, retrieval, tool use, output evaluation, and responsible-AI controls.

Engineering standards that allow multiple contributors and teams to change the platform safely.

What you will do:

Design and implement production capabilities across the stack, spending substantial time in code, prototypes, reviews, debugging, and system validation.

Define and evolve domain models and ontology patterns that connect workers, devices, sites, events, rules, and customer workflows.

Design governed data pipelines with clear contracts, lineage, replay behavior, quality checks, and operational ownership.

Build secure, stable API and SDK surfaces for internal teams, partners, customers, and AI agents.

Make pragmatic data-store choices across relational, time-series, streaming, search, and vector workloads.

Drive the current C#/.NET backend while reasoning credibly across Go, Python, Java, Node.js, and TypeScript when the product requires a different trade-off.

Raise engineering maturity through automated testing, CI gates, release safety, observability, service-level objectives, incident learning, and migration discipline.

Embed security and compliance into design and implementation, including data residency, encryption, audit logging, access control, tenant isolation, and responsible-AI guardrails.

Mentor senior engineers, review designs and code, create reference implementations, and help contributors earn ownership of platform areas.

Collaborate with Product, Hardware, Field Engineering, customers, and partners to connect architecture choices to real site outcomes.

What you will bring:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including sustained impact at Staff, Principal, Lead Architect, or equivalent senior individual-contributor scope.

A track record of designing and delivering scalable, multi-tenant SaaS platforms or large distributed systems in production, including incidents, migrations, and scaling failures.

Experience owning a platform across its lifecycle from architecture and implementation through deployment, operation, and evolution.

Deep backend and distributed-systems judgment, with strong hands-on ability in at least one of C#/.NET, Go, Python, Java, or Node.js and credible range across others.

Strong API design skills across REST and/or GraphQL, OpenAPI or SDK code generation, and secure identity patterns such as OAuth 2.0, JWT, and SSO.

Cloud and delivery experience with GCP and/or AWS, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and production operations.

Experience with ontology-driven or governed platforms such as Palantir Foundry/AIP, Databricks Unity Catalog, or equivalent first-principles work with ontologies, pipelines, lineage, governed SDKs, and applications.

Hands-on experience with LLM integration patterns such as prompting, retrieval, tool or function calling, MCP, agent runtime design, and output evaluation.

Principal-level influence through technical writing, architecture facilitation, mentorship, and alignment without direct authority.

Exceptional written and spoken English, including precise issues, ADRs, design documents, reviews, and stakeholder communication.

Nice to have:

Direct, hands-on Palantir Foundry and/or AIP experience on a live production surface.

Agentic frameworks, multi-agent orchestration, or durable workflow systems.

IoT or connected-device ingestion, device-to-cloud communication, and high-volume event processing.

Enterprise integrations including identity providers, ERP systems, project-management platforms, Oracle, or Procore.

description:
**KSA National – National Talent & Compliance Lead**

At Horizontal Digital, we hold ourselves to one key belief: You’re only as good as your worst customer experience. This mantra is what drives our digital consultancy to think beyond the easy answers and instead create websites, apps, portals and other experiences that solve customer needs for Fortune 500 companies in intuitive and empathetic ways. And we make this lofty standard a reality by fusing strategy, data, design and technology together to arrive at solutions that set the bar higher for everyone.

We use these values to fuel superior results:

**Lock arms**

We forge relationships that make our impact 1,000x stronger. This means working across departments and engaging both our clients and our communities to deliver the greatest good.

**Show hustle**

We’re not ones to sit on our hands and wait. Instead, we anticipate opportunities, collectively roll up our sleeves and find ways to execute the exceptional.

**Embrace change**

From new technologies to workplace philosophies, we welcome the unexpected and constantly anticipate what’s next.

**Elevate empathy**

We listen before we take action. This means understanding a variety of perspectives and holding ourselves to a higher standard of accountability.

**Never settle**

We motivate each other to push past the easy answers and collectively arrive at bigger, more inspiring ideas.

**But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.**

We are seeking an experienced KSA national professional to join us as our new National Talent & Compliance Lead. This is a senior role with two parts. The larger part is compliance & visas: you will become our primary in-house point of contact for Saudization, government relations and the full visa and immigration lifecycle for our people and their families, taking on responsibilities we have historically relied on an external PRO company to manage. The second part is Saudi national hiring: leading our efforts to attract, source and recruit outstanding Saudi national talent, and helping us stay ahead of our Nitaqat obligations rather than reacting to them.

What you’ll do:

**Compliance & Visas**

* Manage the end-to-end visa and immigration process for expatriate employees and their eligible family members — work visas, iqama issuance and renewal, dependent/family visas, and exit/re-entry and cancellation processes.
* Apply for and manage the different types of visas needed for Horizontal Digital employees travelling to Saudi Arabia for work (e.g., business/visit visas).
* Work with our insurance broker to add new employees and eligible family members to our health insurance plan, and manage related updates, amendments and removals.
* Own our Nitaqat/Saudization position — track our Saudi/non-Saudi headcount ratio and quota band on an ongoing basis,  and proactively flag to leadership when we are approaching or sitting in the or red zone, together with recommended corrective action.
* Act as Horizontal Digital’s primary point of contact for Saudization, visas and government relations matters
* Monitor and interpret changes to KSA labour law, MHRSD regulations, and Qiwa/Muqeem/GOSI/visa platform requirements, and translate these into clear, practical guidance for leadership and HR.
* Own the government-related and administrative side of onboarding and offboarding for employees, contractors and their families — visas, iqama, labour contracts, GOSI registration, health insurance enrolment/removal and similar — coordinating closely with HR, IT and hiring managers.
* Keep leadership and the HR team up to date on Saudization-, visa- and labour law-related rules, deadlines and obligations that affect the business.
* Maintain accurate compliance, visa and insurance tracking and reporting, and prepare regular updates for leadership.

**Saudi National Hiring**

* Lead sourcing, screening and recruitment for Saudi national hires, building and maintaining a strong, ongoing pipeline of Saudi talent across our open roles.
* Identify, propose and help build programs and initiatives to attract, develop and retain Saudi national employees (for example, university and graduate partnerships, or engagement with relevant government talent initiatives).
* Partner with hiring managers and leadership on workforce planning that factors in Saudization targets and quota requirements from the outset.
* Maintain accurate candidate tracking and reporting in our Applicant Tracking System.
* Support wider Talent Acquisition and HR projects and administrative tasks as needed.
* Act as culture ambassador for the Saudi team which consists of Saudi nationals and expats, supporting with local engagement activities and events that help our Saudi team feel connected to the wider group and connected with each other

**Who you are:**

* A KSA national who can engage confidently with both government contacts and internal leadership.
* Genuinely knowledgeable about Saudi labour law, visa/immigration processes and the Nitaqat/Saudization program, and committed to keeping that knowledge current as regulations evolve.
* A proactive, forward-looking thinker who flags risk early rather than after the fact.
* A strong communicator who can advise and influence senior stakeholders as comfortably as external government contacts, brokers and candidates.
* Meticulous and reliable with time-sensitive paperwork — visa deadlines, renewals and insurance enrolments don't get missed on your watch.
* A skilled recruiter who genuinely enjoys finding and engaging strong local talent.
* Highly organized, able to manage compliance and visa deadlines alongside multiple hiring pipelines at the same time.
* Trustworthy with confidential and compliance-sensitive information.

**What you bring:**

* KSA National (required).
* Proven experience in a Saudization, government relations/PRO, visa & immigration, or senior HR role in Saudi Arabia.
* Hands-on experience managing expatriate visa and iqama processes — work visas, dependent/family visas, renewals, exit/re-entry and cancellations — directly or in close oversight of a provider that does.
* Experience coordinating with an insurance broker on employee and dependent health insurance additions, amendments and removals.
* Strong working knowledge of the Nitaqat/Saudization program, MHRSD regulations, and the Qiwa/Muqeem/GOSI platforms.
* Experience sourcing and recruiting Saudi national candidates.
* Experience with designing and leading Saudi National Graduate programmes
* Excellent stakeholder management and advisory skills, comfortable engaging senior leadership.
* Strong organizational skills, with a track record of managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Exceptional professional written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and interface with individuals at all levels, both inside and outside the organization.
* Knowledge of ATS systems and Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and Excel.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.

**Our KSA Benefits include:**

* 22 days holiday

* Comprehensive medical insurance plan for employee and spouse and children
* Flexible office times and working from home twice per week

* Remote working from a place of your choice for 2 weeks a year

*Horizontal Digital is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified Saudi nationals, including those with disabilities who possess the required skills and appropriate accommodations.*

description:
**Job Title:** Corporate Communications Manager

**Location:** Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia

**Function:** Corporate Communications

**Position Type:** Permanent, full-time (Relocation supported)

### **About the Opportunity**

We are constructing one of the largest primary metals and industrial complexes in the Middle East—a multi-billion-dollar project backed by international industrial shareholders and a major sovereign investment ecosystem.

Having spent the development phase out of view, we are now transitioning from confidentiality to high international visibility. As there is currently no existing communications function, website, owned channels, or brand system, this appointment represents a ground-floor "build mandate". Everything the organisation communicates publicly over the next decade will begin with this role.

### **The Role**

You will establish the organisation as a credible, disciplined, and internationally legible industrial enterprise. You will own the strategy and execution of our emergence from confidentiality, the overarching corporate narrative, and the governance standards required for an asset backed by listed shareholders across multiple jurisdictions.

This is a true build role. Initially, you will be doing the work personally while directing it—equally comfortable drafting executive remarks late at night and presenting reputation risk strategy to the Board the following morning. (Note: Government relations and regulatory affairs are managed separately).

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Strategy & Narrative:** Develop the corporate story, message architecture across global markets, and the sequenced launch strategy.
* **Media & Reputation:** Build regional and international media relationships from scratch; oversee inbound queries, spokesperson preparation, and media monitoring.
* **Brand & Digital Assets:** End-to-end launch of our bilingual website, corporate identity, editorial calendar, and an extensive photo/film asset library.
* **Executive Communications:** Serve as trusted advisor to executive leadership; draft speeches, statements, opinion pieces, board materials, and investor narratives.
* **Shareholder Coordination:** Manage disclosure interfaces with shareholder communications and investor relations functions across multiple jurisdictions on a no-surprises basis.
* **Internal & Site Communications:** Build a multichannel architecture for a rapidly growing, multilingual workforce spread across corporate offices and active construction sites.
* **Issues & Crisis Management:** Establish and test crisis frameworks, scenarios, holding statements, and simulation drills prior to operational launch.
* **Department & Partner Management:** Build the operating model, hire the internal team, manage budgets, and select agency partners.
* **Capital Markets Readiness:** Align the equity story with the corporate narrative to establish securities disclosure discipline in preparation for future capital market activity.

### **First-Year Expectations**

* **First Quarter:** Complete governance audits; secure approval for disclosure protocols and emergence calendars; initiate brand and website agency briefs.

RISE TO THE CHALLENGE

Philip Morris Trading KSA is looking for a Manager Communications to join the team. As a Manager Communications, you will be part of the Corporate Affairs function, reporting to the Sr Manager Corporate Affairs. Manager Communications role is responsible for developing and executing communication initiatives that strengthen our reputation, support business priorities, and ensure consistent, engaging messaging across internal and external audiences.

• This is a full time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The working schedule is from Sunday to Thursday

• Interested candidates are invited to apply through the application link provided in this job posting. Application will be accepted until 27-October-2026

YOUR ‘DAY TO DAY’

Drive Strategic Communications

• Develop and implement communication plans that support business objectives and corporate priorities

• Translate complex topics into clear, compelling, and audience-focused messages.

• Ensure consistency of messaging across internal and external communication channels.

Manage External Communications

• Plan and execute media and public relations initiatives that strengthen the company's reputation.

• Build and maintain relationships with journalists, media representatives, industry stakeholders, and external partners.

• Respond to media inquiries and coordinate press materials, including media releases, statements, and briefing documents.

• Support and prepare leaders and spokespersons for media engagements and speaking opportunities.

• Monitor emerging issues and help develop communication strategies that protect and enhance company reputation.

Lead Internal Communications

• Develop and deliver internal communication campaigns that connect employees to the company's strategy, culture, and priorities.

• Create engaging content for internal communication channels, including intranet, newsletters, and internal social platforms.

• Support change management initiatives through effective communication plans and materials.

• Manage communication calendars and ensure timely delivery of key messages.

Deliver Events & Stakeholder Engagement Activities

• Plan and execute virtual, hybrid, and in-person events such as town halls, leadership sessions, employee activations, and external engagements.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure communications activities are aligned and impactful.

• Provide guidance and communications expertise to internal stakeholders and project teams.

Continuous Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve communication processes, channels, and stakeholder engagement.

• Analyze communication effectiveness and recommend enhancements to improve reach, understanding, and impact.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• KSA National

• Bachelor's degree in Communications, PR, Journalism, Marketing, Corporate Affairs or a related field, or equivalent

• 7–10 years' experience in corporate, internal or external communications, PR, or stakeholder engagement, including work with media

• Strong storytelling and copywriting skills, with excellent written and verbal communication

• Skilled at building trusted relationships and leading cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders

Job Identification: 214367
Job Category: Housekeeping and Laundry
Job Schedule: Full time
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Cluster Housekeeping Order Taker , you’re not just taking and processing guest orders – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
Here's what you'll do during a typical day:
+ Handle housekeeping requests : Receive, record, and follow up on guest housekeeping requests promptly and professionally to ensure timely completion.
+ Coordinate housekeeping operations: Communicate with Room Attendants, Housekeeping Supervisors, and other departments to ensure rooms are cleaned, inspected, and ready on time.
+ Maintain accurate records: Update the Property Management System with correct room statuses, guest requests, service orders, Lost and Found records, and operational reports.
+ Support guest satisfaction: Respond to guest requests courteously, monitor service response times, and ensure all requests are resolved according to Hilton service standards.
+ Manage room and service updates: Coordinate room status changes with Front Office and assign tasks to Housekeeping team members through the hotel operating system.
+ Ensure operational accuracy: Verify laundry charges, minibar postings, and housekeeping records are accurately updated and maintained.
+ Ensure smooth operations: Follow up on pending tasks, management comments, and service orders while supporting the housekeeping team in delivering exceptional guest experiences.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
How We’ll Help You Thrive
At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:
Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves and their loved ones. In many countries, eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
*Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.
Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture
At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands (https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/) , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog (https://jobs.hilton.com/blogs) to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

ABIS is seeking an experienced Hydrojetting Incharge / Team Leader with shutdown and turnaround experience to oversee and lead hydrojetting operations on site. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the hydrojetting team, ensuring safety compliance, coordinating with other departments, and delivering quality service within project timelines. * Coordinate with project management, safety officers, and other teams to ensure smooth execution of hydrojetting activities.

* Plan and allocate resources effectively to meet project schedules and deliverables.
* Conduct risk assessments and implement measures to mitigate hazards.
* Provide technical guidance, training, and support to the hydrojetting team.
* Monitor equipment condition and report any maintenance needs.
* Prepare and maintain records of operations, safety checks, and incidents.

* Minimum of 10 years of experience in hydrojetting operations, including leadership roles. 3 years as Team Leader experience for Hydrojetting Department
* Proven experience working in shutdown and turnaround environments, preferably within oil and gas industry.

* Excellent team management and communication skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight project deadlines.
* Certification or training related to hydrojetting and safety is an advantage.
* Strong commitment to safety and quality standards.

Manage and organize the CEO’s calendar, appointments, and meetings. Prioritize meetings, requests, and commitments based on business priorities. Coordinate with executive management, Board members, and external parties. Organize official visits, interviews, and business meetings. Ensure the CEO’s schedule is efficiently managed and aligned with business priorities.

2\. Meetings & Follow-Up

Coordinate and schedule meetings for the CEO, including preparing agendas and required materials. Attend meetings when required and prepare accurate meeting minutes. Follow up on decisions, assignments, and action items to ensure timely completion. Maintain action trackers and provide timely reminders on high-priority tasks. Monitor pending actions and provide regular updates to the CEO.

3\. Correspondence & Communication

Manage and organize the CEO’s emails, correspondence, and communications. Draft and prepare official letters, emails, and business correspondence when required. Facilitate communication between the CEO and various departments. Handle confidential and sensitive information with the highest level of professionalism and discretion. Ensure timely and accurate responses to requests and communications.

4\. Reports & Presentations

Prepare and organize reports, presentations, and briefing materials for meetings. Collect and consolidate information and data from different departments when required. Maintain and organize the CEO’s files, documents, and records. Ensure all executive documents are accurate, up to date, and easily accessible.

5\. Travel & Executive Support

Arrange business travel, including flights, hotels, transportation, and related requirements. Prepare detailed travel itineraries, meeting schedules, and visit plans. 1 • • Coordinate with internal and external parties to ensure smooth execution of business trips and executive engagements. Provide administrative support for executive assignments and special projects when required.

6\. Stakeholder Coordination

Communicate professionally with Board members, executive management, clients, partners, government entities, and other stakeholders. Facilitate effective communication between the CEO and relevant internal and external stakeholders. Represent the CEO’s office in a professional manner that reflects the company’s standards, reputation, and position. Maintain strong professional relationships with key stakeholders.

Accuracy and efficiency in managing the CEO’s calendar and schedule.

Timely follow-up and closure of assignments and action items.

Responsiveness to correspondence, requests, and executive requirements.

Quality and effectiveness of meeting organization and executive materials.

CEO and stakeholder satisfaction. Compliance with confidentiality and proper handling of sensitive information.

Timely preparation of reports, presentations, and required documentation.

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

High level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

## Job Description

We are seeking a detail-oriented and efficient Laundry Attendant to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will play a vital part in maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness and organization within our laundry operations. Reporting to the Laundry Supervisor, you will be responsible for sorting, processing, and preparing linens while ensuring all health and safety protocols are consistently followed. Your commitment to quality and collaborative approach will directly contribute to the success of our housekeeping operations.

* Sort soiled guestroom and food & beverage linens as required, filling containers and preparing them for pick-up with accurate labeling
* Identify and set aside misused or damaged linen for further investigation and reporting
* Report any foreign articles found within the linen or chute area (such as glass, food, cutlery, or needles) to the Supervisor immediately
* Fold, roll, and organize clean towels, bathrobes, and room linens into containers for distribution by floor staff
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe working environment at all times
* Adhere to all health and safety protocols, including proper use of personal protective equipment such as masks and gloves
* Assist with washing towels and linens when required, following all guidelines for chemical handling and proper lifting techniques
* Report any equipment malfunctions or potential health and safety hazards to the Supervisor promptly
* Support other team members and assist with additional duties within the laundry area as needed
* Attend training courses and professional development sessions provided by the Housekeeping and Human Resources departments

## Qualifications

* High School diploma or vocational training certification
* Minimum 1 year of work experience in laundry operations or housekeeping (preferred)
* Basic understanding of the English language, both written and verbal
* Physical capability to lift, carry, and handle items weighing up to 25 lbs regularly
* Strong organizational and time management skills with attention to detail
* Ability to follow instructions and procedures consistently and accurately
* Knowledge of health and safety protocols and chemical handling best practices
* Excellent teamwork and communication skills with a collaborative mindset
* Reliability, punctuality, and strong work ethic
* Physical stamina and endurance for a fast-paced laundry environment
* Previous experience in luxury hotel housekeeping operations (preferred)
* Problem-solving ability and resilience in a dynamic work setting

## Additional Information

**Your Team and Working Environment:**

Join our dedicated and hardworking team as a **Laundry Attendant**, where attention to detail, cleanliness, and maintaining high standards are at the core of everything we do. In this essential role, you’ll be responsible for supporting daily laundry operations, ensuring linens, towels, and other items are properly processed, organized, and prepared while maintaining quality, hygiene, and safety standards. Surrounded by committed colleagues who value teamwork and professionalism, you’ll play an important role in supporting our housekeeping operations and contributing to an exceptional guest experience—one well-maintained linen at a time.

**Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:**

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to grow. Regardless of background or experience, we celebrate individuality and provide equal opportunities for all team members to thrive and succeed.

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As an Assistant Front Office Manager, you’re not just helping oversee daily front office operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:
Support daily front office operations: Assist in overseeing Front Office activities, including guest service, registration, room inventory, and adherence to policies and standards
Monitor and elevate service: Assist in tracking guest satisfaction, addressing service issues, and guiding the team to implement improvements that enhance the guest experience
Support revenue initiatives: Assist in promoting hotel services and executing up-selling tactics to drive room occupancy and revenue growth
Facilitate team knowledge: Provide regular updates and training to ensure the team is well-informed of hotel offerings, services, and local attractions
Delight our guests: Welcome guests, respond to inquiries, and resolve concerns promptly to uphold service standards
Oversee VIP guest experience: Review VIP reservations and ensure an elevated and seamless check-in and check-out experience
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support front office team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Job Category

Job Details

****About Salesforce****

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

  
  
As a Data and AI Governance Sales Specialist, you will own your business segment, a dynamic, cross-industry space that is one of the fastest-growing segments for Salesforce in the Kingdom.

You will act as the primary point of contact for data management solutions, specifically **Data Governance, Data Quality, and Data Security**, serving clients across diverse industries.

Reporting directly to the EMEA Specialist VP Sales, this is an individual contributor role with the strategic weight of a sector lead, backed by the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem.

  

  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing >>**

  

* **Strategic Ownership:** Develop and execute a comprehensive business plan for your region, acting as the strategic owner of your territory and driving the pipeline from prospecting through to close.
* **C-Suite Relationship Building:** Build deep, lasting relationships with CXOs, CIOs, and IT leaders across diverse industries, translating complex data challenges into high-impact business outcomes.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Solution Architects, Professional Services, and strategic partners to deliver seamless customer outcomes and maximize deal value.
* **Pipeline Excellence:** Maintain accurate pipeline forecasting within Salesforce CRM using the MEDDPICC methodology, and articulate the value of Data Integration, Quality, and Governance as the foundation for AI-driven business transformation.

  

**You're Our Person If >>**

  

* You have a proven track record of quota-carrying sales experience within Data Management software, a history of overachievement, and an established network of local contacts.
* You possess a demonstrated ability to navigate varied organizational structures across multiple industries and build champions within both business and technical functions.
* You have a proven ability to manage complex sales cycles up to C-level executives, professional fluency in English and Arabic, and are based in KSA.

  

**Even Better If >>**

  

* You possess deep expertise in Data Management, specifically around data governance, data quality, and integration technologies.
* You have strong familiarity with the broader commercial landscape across multiple KSA verticals.
* You hold a degree or equivalent experience; we evaluate backgrounds on core competencies, including extracurricular leadership, military experience, or volunteer work.

  

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best*, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best*. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this [Accommodations Request Form](https://careers.mail.salesforce.com/accommodations-request-form?_ga=2.139086459.912759425.1690463420-976932181.1684251251).

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our [Candidate Privacy Statement](https://www.salesforce.com/en-us/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/documents/legal/Privacy/salesforce-candidate-privacy-statement-december-2024.pdf) for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. [Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.](https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal) Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

  

We're Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well *and* doing good – you've come to the right place.

Leverage your abilities and join the dynamic team of a leading company specializing in Mining and Industrial Mineral .
The Heavy Equipment Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the reliability and efficiency of heavy mobile equipment and diesel generators through effective maintenance strategies and technical supervision. The role focuses on minimizing downtime, improving equipment performance, and ensuring safe and compliant operations across the site.
Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Key Accountabilities

• Develop and implement preventive and predictive maintenance plans.

• Diagnose mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical faults, and supervise corrective maintenance to minimize downtime.

• Monitor equipment performance, conduct root cause analysis, and ensure availability of heavy equipment and diesel generators.

• Track operating hours and maintenance schedules, and manage spare parts requirements and inventory in coordination with procurement.

• Ensure compliance with safety standards and investigate equipment-related incidents.

• Prepare technical reports, analyze KPIs (Availability, MTBF, MTTR), and utilize CMMS systems for tracking and reporting.

• Supervise maintenance technicians, assign tasks, and evaluate team performance.

Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 10 years of experience in mining, cement, silica, or heavy industry.

• Strong knowledge of heavy equipment, diesel generators, and maintenance & reliability practices.

• Proficiency in AutoCAD, SolidWorks, and CMMS systems.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Leadership and team supervision skills with good communication.

• High level of safety awareness.

# Requisition ID: 299172
+ Relocation Authorized: National/International - Camp
+ Telework Type: Full-Time Office/Project
+ Work Location: Dhalm

# Extraordinary teams building inspiring projects:
Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place.
Differentiated by the quality of our people and our relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, we align our capabilities to our customers' objectives to create a lasting positive impact. We serve the Infrastructure; Nuclear, Security & Environmental; Energy; Mining & Metals, and the Manufacturing and Technology markets. Our services span from initial planning and investment, through start-up and operations.
Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments . They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report .
# Project Overview:
The Ar Rjum Project comprises a green field gold project with three open pit mining operations with associated waste dumps and ore stockpile, a processing plant, tailings management facilities, and supporting infrastructure including water supply, power supply, maintenance facilities, offices, temporary and permanent accommodation village.
The Project is situated within the Central Arabian Gold Region, approximately 200 km north-east of Taif towards Riyadh and about 26 km South of Al Mouwayh, which is a small town situated on the Jeddah - Riyadh highway.
# Job Summary:
The Project Deputy ESH Manager supports the project ES&H Manger in developing and implementing ESH management programs, systems and processes; provides the technical oversight of the environment, safety and health activities at a project level; serves as the recognized expert in matters relating to ESH; and provides the overall support for the project to be successful in controlling the risk of harm to people, property and the environment.
# Major Responsibilities:
+ Supports ESH Manager in developing and maintaining an ESH program (plans, systems, procedures, standards) to control ESH risks
+ Adopts client and regulatory requirements where required by contract or law
+ Actively supports the Site Manager in the implementation of the ESH program
+ Monitors the implementation of the ESH program and reports successes and areas of improvement
+ Review contractor ES&H plans, procedures, reports, training records, inspection records, and other required submittals.
+ Identifies and assesses best practices for implementation
+ Evolves and adapts the ESH program through the project stages
+ Develops and maintains a plan of activities aligned with the project schedule and risk factors
+ Develops, supervises and maintains a team that provides in-field ESH support to all project levels
+ Maintains a working relationship with client representatives
+ Participates in the senior leadership ESH meeting that sets and monitors the project ESH strategy
+ Acts as the lead investigator for any serious incident on project
+ Promote a positive safety culture by engaging with workers, supervisors, construction management, and contractors in the field.
# Education and Experience Requirements:
+ Bachelor degree or higher in an Environmental, Safety or Health discipline
+ NEBOSH Certification
+ 10+ years of ESH experience in the industrial construction or heavy engineering industry
+ 4+ years of experience directly supervising a team of ESH professionals (≥ 5 people)
+ Experience in influencing at a project senior leadership level
+ Knowledge of construction planning through the project stages of feasibility, execution and close-out
+ Experience in managing and/or providing technical oversight of ESH subcontractors or consultants
+ Significant experience in ES&H management on mining process plant construction
# Required Knowledge and Skills:
+ Leadership skills to enable a team to be successful - coach, mentor, participate, direct
+ Professional skill set to deliver quality ESH programs, reporting and monitoring
+ High level of written and verbal communication
+ Attributes that openly display ESH as a personal value
+ Clear communication and ability to influence safe behaviors at all levels.
+ Ability to coach, mentor, and develop ES&H personnel.
+ Ability to analyze ES&H data and drive corrective and preventive actions.
# Total Rewards/Benefits:
For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of employees and beyond! Because our teams face some of the world's toughest challenges, we offer robust benefits to ensure our people thrive. Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth. Learn more at Bechtel Total Rewards
# Diverse teams build the extraordinary:
As a global company, Bechtel has long been home to a vibrant multitude of nationalities, cultures, ethnicities, and life experiences. This diversity has made us a more trusted partner, more effective problem solvers and innovators, and a more attractive destination for leading talent.
We are committed to being a company where every colleague feels that they belong-where colleagues feel part of "One Team," respected and rewarded for what they bring, supported in pursuing their goals, invested in our values and purpose, and treated equitably. Click here to learn more about the people who power our legacy.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, national origin, disability, citizenship status (except as authorized by law), protected veteran status, genetic information, and any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. **Job Summary:** Leading the mechanical discipline with specialization in rotating equipment. Knowledge of static equipment will be an added advantage. Active participation and involvement in proposal and bidding activities. Technical support during construction and commissioning phases as deemed required. Engineering being the core expertise, active involvement on a daily basis during the engineering phase in an EPC Environment on one/multiple projects as the case may be.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for planning, scheduling, monitoring and controlling all engineering activities of the Mechanical Discipline
* Interdisciplinary coordination and support team building exercise
* Proactive rather than reactive. Highlight any issues or problems in front of the management so as to help take remedial action on time
* Active participation in progress review meetings, technical meetings, client meetings, and vendor meetings
* Support Procurement-related activities such as raising Material requisitions (MR), Technical Bid Clarification/Evaluation (TBC/ TBE), Draft Purchase Requisitions
* Support bidding team by raising RFQs, Technical evaluation of bids, and cost estimate
* Support construction by responding to construction site-related technical queries (TQ)
* Review and comment on GES plus engineering deliverables on a case-by-case basis
* Ensuring safety and quality of deliverables.
* Participate in Value engineering practices such as value engineering, lessons learned sessions, Risk Assessment/Management Studies and workshops, Constructability studies and workshops
* Ensure Customer satisfaction and appreciation

**Requirements**

**Experience:**

* +10 years combined experience in Oil and Gas, Petrochemicals, Power Industry
* Experience working with GES plus/ EPC Contractors on Saudi Aramco jobs, SABIC and other reputed organizations
* Experience of attending FAT/SAT activities.
* Experience as support to pre-commissioning activities

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (BS, BE or B Tech) in Mechanical
* Training and certification courses

**Required Skills & Abilities:**

**1-** **Core Competencies:**

* Good Leadership and Effective Communication
* Fostering and instilling team spirit among colleagues
* Ability to learn from mistakes
* Good planner and executor. Punctual, disciplined, and giving high importance to timelines and schedules
* Resourceful and Presentable.
* Abreast with the present developments in Industry and ready to learn, accept and change accordingly for the common good.
* Logical and Analytical
* Good Mentor and open to sharing knowledge

**2- Technical Skills:**

* Comprehensive knowledge of rotating equipment in Oil and Gas, Petrochemicals, Power, and Water Industries
* Knowledge and sound command over Saudi Aramco, Sabic, DEP, Royal Commission Standards, Codes and Practices. HCIS Standards and Regulations
* Knowledge and sound command over International Codes and Standards such as ASME, ANSI, API, ATEX, JIS, CSA, NEC, NFPA, FM, UL
* Develop and prepare technical specifications and Data sheets for Pumps (Centrifugal, Reciprocating, Positive Displacement, Screw type and in all ranges…small, medium and large)
* Develop and prepare Technical Specification and Data Sheets for Compressors (Instrument Air, Process Air, Nitrogen, Low Pressure (LP), High Pressure (HP) and Side stream (LP/HP) Gas Compressors, Refrigeration Compressors)
* Good Knowledge and Command over Mechanical Seal systems and their application in line with Industry standards and process requirements
* Sound knowledge of Piping, Civil/Structural, Electrical, instrumentation and Control requirements while specifying and preparing data sheets for rotating equipment
* Knowledge of static equipment such as tanks, spheres, columns, furnaces, reactors, exchangers, and pressure vessels is an advantage
* Actively participated in Safety Studies such as QRA, Envid, Hazid, Hazop and SIL

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

# **A Day in the Life**

The Credit & Collections function supports Medtronic’s business in Saudi Arabia by managing customer receivables, following up on payments, resolving account discrepancies, and minimizing credit risk. The team works closely with healthcare customers, Sales, Customer Care, and Finance to maintain accurate accounts and support timely collections. This role is based in Riyadh with a flexible work arrangement.  
  
As a Credit & Collections Clerk III, you will manage a portfolio of customer accounts, follow up on overdue payments, reconcile balances, and resolve invoice discrepancies. Working with healthcare customers, Sales, Customer Care, and Finance, you will help remove payment barriers and maintain accurate account records. Your work will directly contribute to timely collections, reduced overdue receivables, and stronger customer relationships.

  
  

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Manage a portfolio of customer accounts and follow up on overdue payments to support timely collections.
* Reconcile customer balances and resolve discrepancies involving invoices, payments, and credit notes.
* Coordinate with Sales, Customer Care, and Finance to resolve disputes and remove payment barriers.
* Monitor payment commitments and escalate overdue accounts or potential credit risks in line with company procedures.
* Maintain accurate records of collection activities, customer communications, and account status.
* Prepare accounts receivable updates highlighting overdue balances, collection progress, and required follow-up actions.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Diploma in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with at least two years of experience in accounts receivable or collections.
* Experience in customer account reconciliation, overdue payment follow-up, and invoice discrepancy resolution.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and written and verbal business communication in Arabic and English.

  

**Preferred Qualification**s

* Experience in credit and collections within the healthcare or medical device industry.
* Hands-on experience using SAP for accounts receivable activities and customer account reporting.

About Us:
Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.
How We Work:
At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values:
Bold in how we dream and innovate
Responsive to feedback, challenges and opportunities
Accountable for results and best in class outcomes
Visionary in future focused problem-solving
Exceptional in execution and impact
We are seeking a proactive, creative, and tenacious Sr. Named Account Manager to drive new cyber security business across multiple vertical markets across the Central Region of Saudi Arabia. This role will demand interaction with large scale enterprises at the ‘C’ level, as well as with technical staff within the security and IT organisation.
You will manage a portfolio of approximately 40 named accounts, encompassing a mix of white-space and existing customers. Selling the full Proofpoint Platform, while leveraging all internal resources and our ecosystem of partners to enable continued growth of your account portfolio. In this role you will be able to expand the Proofpoint footprint, ensuring your customers are effectively protected from advanced threats and targeted attacks by our award winning technology.
Your day-to-day
+ Establish strong business relationships at the executive level within Enterprise accounts above 2,500 users (cross-vertical focus)
+ Focus on both penetrating new accounts as well as expanding our presence with existing customers by introducing them to all our security, compliance and information protection platform.
+ Articulate and promote the company’s value proposition and services to become a trusted advisor within your customer base
+ Work with internal resources, including aligned System Engineers to prepare account strategies and plans.
+ Collaborate with Systems Engineers to organise and deliver compelling and flawless product demonstrations
+ Partner with the channel ecosystem to gain access into new accounts
+ Deliver operational excellence, to include forecast accuracy and pipeline generation progression
+ Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Proofpoint’s competitive positioning in the marketplace
What you bring to the team
+ Experienced technology sales professional, with a particular focus on SaaS value-based technologies. Experience within Cyber Security is an advantage.
+ Proven track record of over-achieving targets, net new logo achievements and capacity to leverage channel partnerships within Saudi Arabia.
+ Relentless attention to detail and never-give-up attitude with a high level of activity, i.e., customer and partner meetings emphasizing executive value selling (CISO, CIO, CMO, etc.)
+ Ability to establish business relationships at the executive level, and ability to become a trusted client advisor
+ Experience of closing complex opportunities in the range of $100k – $1m
+ Proficient user of formal sales playbook methodologies e.g. MEDDIC, Challenger, TAS, Command of the Message.
+ Growth mindset, willingness to be coached, and diligence to follow a proven sales process
+ Entrepreneurial self-starter with a consistent focus on account planning, pipeline generation and opportunity progression. You’re strategic in approach, but always act with urgency.
+ Preferably you’ll have experience of using Salesforce
+ Fluency in Arabic and English is required
Why Proofpoint?
At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us:
+ Competitive compensation
+ Comprehensive benefits
+ Career success on your terms
+ Flexible work environment
+ Annual wellness and community outreach days
+ Always on recognition for your contributions
+ Global collaboration and networking opportunities
Our Culture:
Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success-every day, for everyone.
We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com .
How to Apply
Interested? Submit your application along with any supporting information- we can’t wait to hear from you!
Proofpoint has been honored with six Best Places to Work Awards in 2024 by workplace culture leader Comparably, including Best Company Career Growth, Best Company Outlook, Best Global Culture, Best Engineering Teams, Best Sales Teams, and Best HR Teams.
We are the leader in human-centric cybersecurity. Half a million customers, including 87 of the Fortune 100, rely on Proofpoint to protect their organizations. We’re driven by a mission to stay ahead of bad actors and safeguard the digital world. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.
Our BRAVE Values:
At Proofpoint, we are BRAVE in everything we do, and our values aren’t just words—they shape how we work, collaborate, and grow.
We seek people who are bold enough to challenge the status quo, responsive in the face of ever-evolving threats, and accountable for delivering real impact.
We value those with a visionary mindset who anticipate what’s next and push cybersecurity forward, and we celebrate exceptional execution that ensures we continue to defend data and protect people.
Proofpoint is an equal opportunity employer, we hire without consideration to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status or disability.
Find your network, your allies, and your biggest fans. We know that work is simply better when you’re surrounded by people who inspire you—who share ideas, cheer you on, and genuinely want to see you succeed. That’s why we offer social circles, sponsored networks, and connection points across teams and time zones—to help you find your people, build your community, and thrive together.
This isn’t just a job—it’s a mission to protect people and defend data in a world that never slows down. We’re building the future of human-centric cybersecurity, and that future belongs to all of us. We take ownership, move fast, and hold ourselves accountable—because that’s what it takes to stay ahead. And we do it together, winning as one.
Be empowered to reach your full potential through meaningful challenges and personalized support—designed around you and your goals. Whether you're growing as a leader or leveling up from great to exceptional as an individual contributor, we’re here to help you get there.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! Here's what you'll do during a typical day:
Maintain hotel facilities: Ensure physical functionality and safety of the property, including guest rooms, public spaces, and heart-of-house areas
Respond to service requests: Quickly handle guest calls and team member work orders
Perform a variety of maintenance tasks: Conduct repairs and maintenance across various areas, including carpentry, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and masonry

Document maintenance activities: Record completed inspections and repairs and flag any issues requiring further attention

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership.
