Job Description

WSP in the Middle East is currently hiring for a Project Director – Aviation to join our team in KSA. The Project Director holds full accountability for the successful delivery of a major aviation programme within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, with a strong emphasis on airport design modernisation and infrastructure enhancement. This senior leadership role provides strategic direction to multi‑disciplinary teams, ensures strict alignment with client and contractual expectations, and represents WSP at the highest levels with authorities, stakeholders, and executive decision‑makers. The position carries responsibility for the complete spectrum of project performance, including schedule management, technical delivery, quality assurance, risk mitigation, and commercial governance.

Strategic Leadership & Governance
Provide strategic direction and leadership to all project teams operating on-site and across remote support functions.
Establish and maintain a strong governance framework ensuring clarity of roles, responsibilities, reporting lines, and escalation protocols.
Drive a culture of delivery excellence, safety, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Client & Stakeholder Management
Serve as the primary point of contact for the client, ensuring transparent communication, alignment on objectives, and proactive issue resolution.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client representatives, aviation authorities, regulatory bodies, and key external stakeholders.
Represent WSP in high-level steering committees, progress reviews, and commercial discussions.

Project Delivery & Execution
Lead the overall delivery of the aviation project from initiation to handover, ensuring compliance with contractual, technical, and statutory requirements.
Oversee planning, design, construction, and commissioning phases, ensuring deliverables meet required standards.
Monitor schedule performance, identify critical paths, and implement recovery plans when required.

Quality Assurance & Technical Oversight
Ensure adherence to WSP quality frameworks, aviation standards, and global best practice.
Drive technical excellence across all engineering, design, and operational workstreams.
Review and validate key technical submissions, design packages, and project deliverables.

Risk, Safety & Compliance
Establish and manage a robust risk management strategy, covering technical, commercial, operational, and external risks.
Champion a strong safety culture, ensuring compliance with HSE regulations and WSP safety principles.
Implement proactive measures to mitigate project risks and ensure long-term programme stability.

Commercial, Financial & Contract Management
Provide oversight of all commercial activities including contract performance, change management, claims avoidance, and budget control.
Ensure financial integrity through accurate forecasting, cost monitoring, and commercial reporting.
Lead commercial negotiations where required, safeguarding WSP’s contractual and financial position.

Team Leadership & People Management
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing multi-disciplinary project team.
Ensure optimal resource planning, performance management, and succession planning.
Promote collaboration across WSP teams in KSA, the UAE, and global support offices.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Aviation Management, or related discipline (Master’s preferred).
20+ years of experience in project and programme delivery, with significant exposure to large-scale aviation, airports, or complex infrastructure programmes.
Proven track record in leading multi-billion SAR aviation or transport projects in the Middle East (KSA experience preferred).
Strong background in PMC/consultancy environments with familiarity in contract administration (FIDIC or similar).

Technical & Leadership Competencies
Deep understanding of aviation standards, airport systems, airside/landside operations, and regulatory frameworks.
Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
Strong commercial acumen with experience managing large budgets and complex contracts.
Ability to lead diverse teams across multiple geographies and disciplines.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

AtkinsRealis are looking for a Design Manager (DM) for PMC Development (RIBA Stage 1-4).

The PMC Design Manager shall be project based in KSA, assigned to support and assist the PMC Senior Project Managers to oversee the Client appointed Lead Design Consultants (LDC) on various development projects (RIBA Stages 1 – 4), in accordance with the PMC Development Framework scope of services. The role requires active and direct involvement, approach to work that is structured, systematic, efficient and disciplined having excellent communication and reporting skills.

## Your role

* Tender for LDC / Consultancy Services: Produce scope of works services for tender documentation considering the Clients existing Framework Agreements with various Consultants and the Project Brief to be developed by the appointed LDC.
    
* Oversight of Design and Approval Phase: DM shall oversee the Client appointed LDC activities and coordinate the designs for various stages and elements of each Project to align with the project objectives (brief), monitor the status of design progress & LDC deliverables, Client approvals and statutory approvals/permits.
    
* Design Review: PMC Services exclude all technical review obligations (no PI cover for technical reviews), technical reviews shall be undertaken by the LDA appointed separately by the Client. DM shall manage, document, co-ordinate, stage design reviews and audit the designs for compliance with the design briefs, risk and value analyses, and production of deliverables in accordance with the design brief, Quality Management Plan and HSE Plans and in accordance with procedures agreed with Client. Manage the Stakeholder design review and reporting process. Compile the Stage Gateway report at the end of each RIBA Stage.
    
* Change Management: DM shall review design documents to ensure that they are in general accordance with the versions of those documents previously approved by Client and do not contain unauthorized changes that may impact on each Projects’ time and cost. Any changes instructed by the Client shall be administered by the Client appointed Cost Consultant, register of design changes to maintained and agreed between Client and LDC. DM shall evaluate the necessity and feasibility of all potential design changes and compile / review the impact of design changes in terms of time, cost, and quality, and make a recommendation for Client’s consideration.
    
* Cost Management / Cost Estimate Review: LDC obligations include Cost Management to design to approved budget. DM shall assist PMC to ensure that the LDC Cost Manager assist, cooperate, meet and review with Client, PMC, Cost consultant and other parties to participate in any cost estimates, value engineering studies or constructability studies, so as to aid in construction direction, analysis and overall economies in the Works.
    
* Design Coordination: DM shall assist PMC to manage the design processes in accordance with procedures agreed with Client. PMC shall control the planning and scheduling of the design processes and forecast the dates by which design deliverables shall be required. DM shall review and monitor design progress and any independent checking and inform Client on the issues, so the approvals are facilitated, and the overall process is expedited.
    
* Value Management & Value Engineering: DM shall oversee the LDC obligation to comply with the Value Management requirements and where instructed, to implement the Value Engineering exercise in collaboration with the Client’s Cost Consultant.
    
* Design Workshops & Progress Meetings: DM shall coordinate with the client and LDC to establish routine design workshops and progress meetings. Minutes of Meetings shall be produced in accordance with PMC obligations.
    
* Completeness of Scope of Work for RFP Bidding: DM shall assist PMC to ensure that Scope of work for RFP are 100% complete before bidding. PMC shall ensure that LDC prepare, from the approved Project Brief, the Drawings, Specifications, finish schedules, product/equipment descriptions and other construction information (i.e., the “Contract Documents”) to form a robust scope of work.
    
* Design Reports: DM shall ensure that the LDC issue a Design Progress Report monthly. This report shall include the activities of all Sub-consultants of the Consultant, irrespective of any contractual relationship between them. Where no Lead Design Consultant has been appointed by Client, the PMC shall be responsible for writing the Design Progress Report.
    
* Design Risk Assessment: Collaborate with the LDC to identify, list, monitor and eliminate all design risks through the various design stages.
    

## About you

* Education: A bachelor’s degree in architecture or engineering, or a related field qualification is required. PMP in project management is advantageous.
    
* Experience (Client Criteria): Design Manager (Hospitality / Education & Schools / Culture / Arts / Museums / Mixed) at pre-contract stage, 7+ years’ experience including 3-years PgMC/PMC Managerial experience on similar projects.
    
* Industry Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of various Asset types (Mixed-Use), including its regulations, best practices, and emerging trends.
    
* Software: Proficiency in design coordination tools and platforms (e.g., BIM, Revit, AutoCAD).
    
* Project Management Expertise: Proficiency in project management methodologies, tools, and techniques, with a proven track record of successfully delivering complex projects.
    
* Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with various stakeholders, both technical and non-technical, and present project updates and proposals effectively.
    
* Time Management: Exceptional time management skills to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
    
* Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and unforeseen challenges, ensuring successful project completion.
    
* Safety Focus: A deep commitment to maintaining project safety standards and prioritizing safety in all aspects of the project.
    
* AtkinsRéalis Values: AtkinsRéalis require all staff to uphold the company values relating to safety, integrity, collaboration, innovation and excellence.
    

## Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Tax-free salary.
    
* Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
    
* Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
    
* Generous annual leave balance.
    
* Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
    
* Remote work opportunities outside of country.
    
* Company gratuity scheme.
    
* Discretionary bonus program.
    
* Annual flight contribution.
    
* Relocation assistance.
    
* Transportation & housing allowances (available for remote work locations).
    
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
    

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!

At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Senior Risk Engineer** to join our team! In this role you will get to **lead project planning, scheduling, and schedule‑risk management activities to ensure successful and timely delivery of complex infrastructure and rail projects**.

## **What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Review and approve contractors’ baseline schedules in line with contract conditions and Parsons Recommended Practices.
    
* Validate the compatibility and adequacy of project resources to support timely completion.
    
* Develop and maintain a Master Schedule integrating multiple packages and interfaces across design and construction.
    
* Analyze updated/progress schedules, identify potential delays/slippages and critical events, and recommend mitigation, corrective actions, and recovery plans.
    
* Conduct “what if” and time‑impact analyses to assess the schedule impact of changes, variations, and potential events.
    
* Prepare regular progress and monthly reports with program analysis, forecasts, and recommendations, and deliver presentations on interim and major milestones.

**Job Description:**

  

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Project Controls & Change Management Manager** to join our team! In this role, you will work closely with the Project Controls Director and management, engineering, procurement, construction, commercial, contracts, finance, and client representatives to assess the impact of changes and support informed project decision-making.

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

### Project Controls Management

* Establish and implement project controls procedures, systems, tools, and reporting requirements.
* Develop and maintain the project control baseline, including scope, schedule, cost, resources, and key performance indicators.
* Oversee the preparation and maintenance of the integrated master schedule.
* Ensure that project budgets, commitments, actual costs, forecasts, and cash flows are accurately maintained.
* Monitor project performance against approved cost and schedule baselines.
* Review schedule updates, progress reports, cost reports, forecasts, and variance analyses.
* Ensure timely identification of trends, deviations, risks, and opportunities.
* Coordinate the preparation of monthly project performance reports and executive dashboards.
* Ensure consistent reporting across project teams, contractors, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.
* Lead the development of recovery plans for projects experiencing cost, schedule, or performance issues.
* Support earned value management, productivity analysis, resource planning, and performance measurement activities.
* Ensure project control data is accurate, complete, traceable, and suitable for management decision-making.

### Change Management

* Establish and administer the project change management and change control process.
* Manage the identification, registration, assessment, approval, implementation, and closeout of project changes.

* Promote consistent project controls and change management practices across the organization.
* Facilitate workshops, review meetings, risk sessions, and change control boards.
* Communicate project performance, risks, trends, and change impacts clearly to senior management.
* Support contract negotiations and commercial discussions by providing reliable project controls information.
* Develop strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

### Governance and Continuous Improvement

* Ensure compliance with company policies, project procedures, contractual requirements, and applicable standards.
* Establish effective document control and audit trails for project controls and change management activities.
* Support internal, client, and external audits.
* Identify opportunities to improve project controls processes, reporting systems, data quality, and change management workflows.
* Implement lessons learned and best practices across projects.
* Support project closeout by ensuring that final costs, schedules, approved changes, claims, and contractual records are complete and accurate.

    * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Quantity Surveying, or a related field.

    * Understanding of project change control, cost management, schedule management, and contract administration principles.
    * Ability to interpret project drawings, specifications, schedules, contracts, estimates, and technical documents.
    * Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, and communication skills.
    * Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
    * Experience in using project controls or document management systems.
    
* **Preferred Qualifications**
    * Professional certification such as PMP, AACE, PSP, CCP, MRICS, or equivalent.
    * Knowledge of earned value management principles.
    * Experience with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Oracle Unifier, EcoSys, SAP, Procore, or similar project management systems.
    * Experience with contract forms such as FIDIC, NEC, EPC, EPCM, or design-build agreements.
    * Knowledge of cost forecasting, progress measurement, schedule analysis, and risk management.
    * Experience preparing time impact analyses and extension-of-time assessments.
    * Experience working with contractors, subcontractors, consultants, and client organizations.
* **Technical Skills**
    * Change registers and change control workflows
    * Cost estimating and cost impact analysis
    * Schedule impact analysis
    * Trend and risk management
    * Budget and forecast control
    * Contract change administration
    * Variation orders and claims management
    * Progress measurement and earned value management
    * Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project
    * Excel-based reporting and data analysis
    * Document control and audit management
    * Project management information systems
    * Core Competencies
    * Strong attention to detail
    * Commercial and contractual awareness
    * Analytical and problem-solving ability
    * Effective stakeholder coordination
    * Clear written and verbal communication
    * Ability to identify potential project impacts early
    * Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
    * Sound judgment and decision-making
    * Integrity and confidentiality
    * Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary project environment
* **Key Performance Indicators: Performance may be measured by:**
    * Timeliness and accuracy of change evaluations
    * Completeness of the change register
    * Percentage of changes processed in accordance with project procedures
    * Accuracy of cost and schedule impact assessments
    * Timely incorporation of approved changes into project baselines
    * Reduction of unapproved or undocumented changes
    * Accuracy of change forecasts and trend reports
    * Timely resolution of pending change items
    * Quality of change documentation and audit compliance
    * Stakeholder satisfaction with the change control process

معلومات عامة

المسمى الوظيفي: قائد تطوير الأعمال والشراكات - قطاع الجهات غير الربحية

المدير المباشر: قائد تطوير الأعمال والشراكات

مقر العمل: الرياض أو جدة أو الخبر، مع إمكانية تحديد مقر العمل بما يتناسب مع موقع المرشح ومتطلبات العمل

الهدف من الوظيفة

قيادة جهود تطوير الأعمال والشراكات مع الجهات غير الربحية في المملكة، وبناء علاقات استراتيجية تسهم في توسيع أثر دراية ونموها. ستعمل على فهم احتياجات العملاء وتحويلها إلى حلول رقمية وشراكات طويلة الأمد تحقق قيمة حقيقية للمجتمع

المسؤوليات الرئيسية

قيادة جهود تطوير الأعمال واستقطاب فرص ومشاريع جديدة مع الجهات غير الربحية والجهات ذات العلاقة في المملكة.

بناء وإدارة الشراكات الاستراتيجية مع الجمعيات، والمؤسسات الأهلية، والأوقاف، والجهات الحكومية، والجهات المانحة، والشركاء الاستراتيجيين.

فهم احتياجات العملاء وتحليل تحدياتهم، والعمل مع الفرق الداخلية لتصميم حلول رقمية ومقترحات تحقق قيمة وأثرًا مستدامًا.

إدارة دورة تطوير الفرص بدءًا من بناء العلاقة والاجتماعات التعريفية، مرورًا بإعداد العروض والمقترحات، وحتى التفاوض وإبرام العقود.

متابعة مستجدات القطاع غير الربحي ، بما في ذلك المبادرات الوطنية، والأنظمة، ودورة حياة المنح، والفرص التمويلية، وتحويلها إلى فرص أعمال.

تمثيل دراية في المؤتمرات والملتقيات والفعاليات، وبناء شبكة علاقات مهنية تعزز حضور الشركة في القطاع.

تحقيق مستهدفات النمو من خلال إدارة خط فرص (Pipeline) فعال، وتعزيز رضا العملاء، والمساهمة في تنمية الإيرادات والشراكات طويلة الأمد.

متطلبات الوظيفة

1. المتطلبات الأساسية

الإيمان بقيمة التقنية في خدمة المجتمع، والاهتمام بالعمل الرسالي والقيمي، والرغبة في المساهمة في مشاريع تحقق أثرًا مستدامًا.

خبرة لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في تطوير الأعمال، أو الشراكات الاستراتيجية، أو إدارة العلاقات، ويفضل أن تكون سنتان على الأقل منها في القطاع غير الربحي أو الجهات المانحة أو القطاعات ذات العلاقة.

فهم جيد لمنظومة القطاع غير الربحي في المملكة العربية السعودية ، بما في ذلك بيئة الجمعيات، والأوقاف، والجهات المانحة، والإلمام بدورة حياة المنح والبرامج التنموية.

قدرة مثبتة على بناء العلاقات والتفاوض مع القيادات التنفيذية وصناع القرار، وتحويل الفرص إلى شراكات ومشاريع ناجحة.

إجادة اللغة العربية تحدثًا وكتابة، مع مهارات قوية في إعداد العروض التقديمية والمقترحات.

شخصية مبادرة وقيادية تمتلك حسًا تجاريًا، وشغفًا بصناعة الأثر، والقدرة على العمل باستقلالية وفي بيئة سريعة النمو.

2. المتطلبات المفضلة

يفضل أن يكون المتقدم سعودي الجنسية، أو يمتلك شبكة علاقات مهنية قوية وخبرة عملية واسعة في القطاع غير الربحي بالمملكة العربية السعودية.

امتلاك شبكة علاقات فاعلة مع الجمعيات، والمؤسسات الأهلية، والأوقاف، والجهات المانحة، أو الجهات الحكومية ذات العلاقة.

خبرة سابقة في تطوير الأعمال أو الشراكات في شركات التقنية، أو التحول الرقمي، أو البرمجيات كخدمة (SaaS)، أو الخدمات الاستشارية.

الإلمام بإجراءات المنافسات، والمنح، والمبادرات الوطنية، وآليات التمويل في القطاع غير الربحي.

خبرة في تمثيل الجهات في المؤتمرات والملتقيات وبناء الشراكات الاستراتيجية، مع القدرة على إدارة العلاقات مع كبار التنفيذيين وصناع القرار.

Job Title: Business Development & Partnerships Lead - Non-Profit Sector.

Line Manager: Director of Business Development & Partnerships.

Location: Riyadh, Jeddah, or Al-Khobar (Workplace location can be determined based on candidate location and business needs).

Job Purpose

Lead business development and partnership efforts with non-profit entities in the Kingdom, building strategic relationships that contribute to expanding Dirayaah’s impact and growth. You will work to understand client needs and translate them into digital solutions and long-term partnerships that deliver real value to the community.

Key Responsibilities

Lead business development efforts and attract new opportunities and projects with non-profit organizations and relevant entities in the Kingdom.

Build and manage strategic partnerships with associations, civil foundations, endowments, government entities, donors, and strategic partners.

Understand client needs and analyze their challenges, collaborating with internal teams to design digital solutions and proposals that create sustainable value and impact.

Manage the entire opportunity lifecycle, from relationship building and introductory meetings to proposal preparation, negotiation, and contract closing.

Stay informed on non-profit sector developments, including national initiatives, regulations, grant lifecycles, and funding opportunities, converting them into business prospects.

Represent Dirayaah at conferences, forums, and events, cultivating a professional network that enhances the company's presence in the sector.

Achieve growth targets by maintaining an effective sales pipeline, enhancing client satisfaction, and driving revenue growth and long-term partnerships.

Job Requirements

1. Basic Requirements:

Belief in the power of technology to serve society, passion for values-driven work, and a strong desire to contribute to projects with sustainable impact.

Minimum of 5 years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or relationship management—with at least 2 years preferably in the non-profit sector, donor organizations, or related fields.

Strong understanding of the non-profit ecosystem in Saudi Arabia, including associations, endowments, donors, grant lifecycles, and developmental programs.

Proven track record in relationship building and negotiation with C-level executives and decision-makers, turning opportunities into successful partnerships and projects.

Proficiency in spoken and written Arabic, alongside strong skills in drafting presentations and proposals.

Proactive and leadership personality with a strong commercial mindset, passion for creating impact, and ability to work independently in a fast-growing environment.

2. Preferred Requirements:

Saudi nationality is preferred, or possessing a strong professional network and extensive practical experience within the non-profit sector in Saudi Arabia.

Active network of connections with associations, civil foundations, endowments, donor agencies, or relevant government bodies.

Prior experience in business development or partnerships within tech companies, digital transformation, Software as a Service (SaaS), or consulting services.

Familiarity with procurement processes, tenders, grants, national initiatives, and funding mechanisms in the non-profit sector.

Experience representing organizations at conferences and forums, building strategic partnerships, and managing relationships with top executives and decision-makers.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Housekeeping Supervisor, you’re not just ensuring the cleanliness of guest rooms – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:
Keep guest rooms spotless: Clean and tidy assigned rooms, including making beds, cleaning bathrooms, dusting, vacuuming, and performing deep cleaning tasks as needed
Replenish linens and amenities: Replace bed linens, towels, and guest essentials as needed
Manage supplies: Stock, maintain, and transport the housekeeping supply cart daily
Delight our guests: Respond to guest requests promptly and courteously
Manage waste disposal: Dispose of trash and recyclables in designated areas
:

What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands, and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

How We’ll Help You Thrive

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program

Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents

Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care

Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves and their loved ones. In many countries, eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

*Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

description:
### **Location:** Remote / Flexible   
Job Type: Entry-Level Placement

### **Experience Required: No previous HR qualifications or experience required**

e-Careers is a dynamic and forward-thinking training company dedicated to changing lives through innovative training and career development solutions.

Human Resources remain essential across every industry, creating opportunities for motivated individuals who want to build practical skills and begin a long-term professional career.

e-Careers will provide you with the training to help you gain an CIPD qualification, then introduce you to a host company that will offer you a guaranteed remote internship placement. If successful, the host company may offer you a full-time paid role in Human Resources.

Are you organised, people-focused, and interested in how businesses attract and support great talent? A growing number of employers are expanding their HR and Talent Acquisition teams, creating opportunities for individuals looking to begin a long-term career in this field.

We are working alongside employers across multiple industries who are seeking motivated individuals ready to develop practical HR knowledge and step into entry-level opportunities.

### **What the Traineeship Offers:**

* CIPD qualification through an online, self-paced learning environment

* Full tutor support

* Guaranteed remote internship (part-time or full-time)

* 1 in 4 people offered a job from their host company after their internship

* Practical exposure to HR, recruitment support and workplace communication

* A career pathway into HR, Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development or People Operations

description:
The Shift Supervisor is responsible for managing staff and overseeing operations on the floor during their assigned shift at the attraction. This role ensures that the attraction operates smoothly and efficiently while maintaining the highest standards of guest service. The Shift Supervisor plays a key role in creating a positive guest experience by leading the team, addressing any operational issues promptly, and ensuring that all activities are carried out according to SEVEN’s standards and policies.

**Requirements**

**Functional Accountabilities**

**Staff Supervision and Management**

* Lead and manage the team during the assigned shift, ensuring that all staff members are performing their duties effectively and adhering to SEVEN’s standards.
* Assign tasks and responsibilities to team members based on operational needs, ensuring optimal coverage and service delivery.
* Provide on-the-spot training, guidance, and support to staff, ensuring that they have the knowledge and skills required to perform their roles.

**Operational Oversight**

* Monitor and oversee all operational activities on the floor, including guest services, equipment maintenance, and safety protocols.
* Ensure that the attraction is clean, well-maintained, and fully operational at all times during the shift.
* Address any operational issues or guest concerns promptly, escalating to the Attractions Manager if necessary.

**Guest Service Excellence**

* Ensure that all guests receive high-quality service, with a focus on creating a positive and memorable experience.
* Handle guest inquiries, complaints, and feedback in a professional and courteous manner, taking appropriate actions to resolve any issues.
* Promote a culture of guest service excellence among the staff, leading by example and encouraging team members to go above and beyond for guests.

**Safety and Compliance**

* Enforce safety protocols and ensure that all staff and guests are adhering to SEVEN’s safety standards and procedures.
* Conduct regular checks of equipment and facilities to identify any potential safety hazards or maintenance needs.
* Ensure that all shift activities comply with local regulations and SEVEN’s internal policies.

**Reporting and Documentation**

* Maintain accurate records of shift activities, including staff attendance, guest interactions, and any incidents or issues that occur.
* Prepare shift reports for the Attractions Manager, highlighting key operational outcomes, challenges, and recommendations for improvement.
* Ensure that all documentation is completed accurately and submitted in a timely manner..

**Guest Experience**

* Ensure all guests receive high-quality service, creating a positive and memorable experience during their visit.
* Address guest inquiries, complaints, and feedback promptly and professionally, resolving any issues to maintain guest satisfaction.
* Lead by example to promote a culture of guest service excellence, encouraging staff to exceed expectations and deliver exceptional service.

**Service Level Standards**

* Adheres to SLS

**Minimum Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent; additional qualifications in hospitality or management are a plus.

**Professional Certifications**

* Certification in Hospitality Management or a related field is a plus.

**Required Experience**

* 3-5 years of experience in a supervisory role within a guest-facing environment, preferably in the entertainment or hospitality industry.
* Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to manage a team and handle multiple operational tasks simultaneously.
* A proven track record of delivering excellent guest service and managing guest interactions effectively.

Job Description

WSP is seeking highly skilled and experienced Material Inspectors to join our team in Riyadh for a prestigious road infrastructure project. The ideal candidates will have a strong background in construction consultancy with extensive experience in site supervision of road infrastructure projects, including roads, bridges, highways, and tunnels.

Conduct thorough inspections and testing of construction materials to ensure compliance with project specifications and standards.

Oversee and monitor the quality of materials used in construction projects, including asphalt, concrete, aggregates, and other related materials.

Perform on-site material sampling, testing, and analysis as required.

Review and interpret project drawings, specifications, and material submittals to ensure adherence to design and quality standards.

Prepare detailed reports on material quality, test results, and any non-compliance issues, providing recommendations for corrective actions.

Collaborate with project managers, engineers, contractors, and other stakeholders to resolve material-related issues and ensure project timelines are met.

Maintain accurate records of all inspections, tests, and related documentation.

Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations and industry best practices at all times.

Minimum of 7 years of experience in construction consultancy with a focus on road infrastructure projects such as roads, bridges, highways, and tunnels.

Diploma or degree in Materials Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related field.

Valid Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) registration as a Material Technician, Material Engineer, or a related qualification.

Strong knowledge of construction materials, testing methods, and quality control procedures.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Proficiency in using material testing equipment and software applications relevant to the role.

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

As well as rewarding you with competitive pay, WSP offers standard benefits including first class medical cover, paid professional subscriptions.

Be you, be happy - we strive to have a friendly and inclusive culture which respects and maximizes the contribution individuals can bring to WSP. Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of gender, race, disability, age, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. We will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

Job Purpose:

This role is responsible for delivering exceptional customer experience within the showroom by providing professional sales consultation, promoting CEER’s products and services, and achieving individual and showroom sales targets. This role acts as the primary point of contact for retail customers, guiding them through the vehicle purchase journey from initial inquiry to deal closure.

Key Functional Responsibilities:

• Deliver a seamless, premium end-to-end customer experience from initial inquiry through vehicle handover, acting as a trusted advisor and brand ambassador throughout the customer journey.
• Lead customer engagements by identifying their needs, presenting suitable vehicles and solutions, conducting test drives, preparing quotations, negotiating terms, and closing retail sales in line with company policies.
• Serve as a subject matter expert on vehicles, products, financing options, and emerging technologies, translating complex technical information into customer-centric value propositions that support informed purchase decisions.
• Build and maintain long-term customer relationships, proactively managing follow-ups, referrals, repeat business opportunities, and customer retention initiatives to drive sustainable sales growth.
• Ensure all customer interactions align with CEER’s brand standards and service excellence guidelines.
• Achieve individual and showroom sales targets, KPIs, and conversion ratios.
• Maintain accurate customer and sales pipeline data in CRM systems, ensuring timely updates, pipeline hygiene, and adherence to lead response SLAs.
• Ensure all sales documentation is completed accurately and submitted timely.
• Maintain high showroom presentation standards, ensuring vehicles are displayed and merchandised in line with brand and visual guidelines.
• Adhere to company policies, pricing guidelines, and ethical sales practices, ensuring full compliance with regulatory requirements and internal approval processes.

• Manage and convert customer leads into vehicle sales opportunities.
• Promote and sell value-added products and services, including finance, insurance,
accessories, and software subscriptions.
• Coordinate and conduct vehicle demonstrations and test drives for qualified prospects.

Job Requirement:

• Education: High School or Diploma in Business, Marketing, or a related field.

• Experience: 4 Years Minimum in automotive retail sales, customer-facing roles, or a relevant field.

description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Spa Manager, you’re not just overseeing daily spa operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:
Oversee daily spa operations: Manage guest service, product quality, inventory, systems, and departmental budgets to ensure smooth and effective spa performance
Maximize revenue opportunities: Develop spa menus and implement marketing and merchandising strategies to support revenue growth and enhance the guest experience
Maintain spa facilities: Ensure spa areas and equipment are well-maintained, clean, and in excellent working order
Enhance guest satisfaction: Monitor service trends, respond to feedback, and implement improvements to elevate the overall spa experience
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise, coach, and mentor team members; conduct performance evaluations, provide professional development opportunities, and recognize achievements to build, engage, and retain a high-performing team
Uphold regulatory standards: Maintain compliance with health, safety, and sanitation, ensuring the highest standards of guest and team member wellbeing

What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands, and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

description:
Overview
Working across the globe, V2X builds smart solutions designed to integrate physical and digital infrastructure from base to battlefield. We bring 120 years of successful mission support to improve security, streamline logistics, and enhance readiness. Aligned around a shared purpose, our $3.9B company and 16,000 people work alongside our clients, here and abroad, to tackle their most complex challenges with integrity, respect, responsibility, and professionalism.
Serves as the AH64/AH6i Technical Inspector, operating within the role of Aviation Maintenance Quality Control/Quality Assurance (QC/QA) under the direction of the QC Manager. Responsibilities include inspecting and signing off on red 'X' and circle red 'X' conditions related to aircraft systems and components, conducting inspections on airframe, power-train, power-plant, armament, electrical, and avionics systems. Determines the necessity for Maintenance Test Flight (MTF)/Maintenance Operational Check (MOC) and interprets inspection criteria for maintenance staff. Utilizes common measuring tools, precision measuring gauges, and alignment fixtures (GFE). Assists the Customer in maintaining a current technical library and applicable aircraft forms and records. Collaborates with Weight and Balance (W&B) technicians to complete records and documentation according to Customer directives. Acts as the site QC Data Analyst and administers technical and compliance documentation. Establishes maintenance quality control processes, procedures, standards, and reports, ensuring safe operations in all related activities. Conducts maintenance and technical inspector training, inputting OJT training data into the learning management system database.
Responsibilities
+ Performs quality technical inspection of aircraft, equipment, vehicles, aircraft components, parts, and systems (including avionics, electrical, instrument and armament) as required by functional assignment.
+ Performs quality and safety inspections of on-site equipment and tools used in aircraft maintenance, vehicles, and equipment.
+ Performs in-progress and final quality technical inspections during maintenance, repair, modification, rework, and overhaul of aircraft, aircraft components, and component parts.
+ Inspects job procedural forms and maintenance forms used in the performance of aircraft maintenance, vehicle and equipment maintenance to assure compliance with approved methods and procedures.
+ Assists in preparation, processing, and answering of Quality Deficiency Reports (QDRs). Assists in aircraft accident investigations, prepares estimated cost of damage reports as required.
+ Establish the maintenance quality control processes, procedures, standards, measures, and reports in support of the maintenance program and in coordination with Supply Chain Management (SCM) activities.
+ Directs inquires, investigations, and research analysis related to quality control maintenance processes and supporting maintenance activities, to the QC Manager.
+ Ensures all quality control maintenance operations and related maintenance support activities are conducted in a safe manner.
+ In coordination with the QC Manager, supports the Downed Aircraft Recovery Team (DART) processes and procedures.
+ Conducts maintenance training and technical inspector training as required.
+ Other tasks as directed by the QC Manager.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
+ Associates degree required, Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
+ As a condition of employment in Saudi Arabia, all candidates must successfully complete the Saudi Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development’s Qualification Verification Program (QVP) to ensure eligibility for visa processing and employment authorization.
+ Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Inspector Authorization (IA) certificate.
+ AH-6i TI and training experience.
+ FAA Airframe and Powerplant certificate.
+ Ten (10) years’ experience AH-6i, MD-500 series, MH-6, OH-58, AH-64
Experience Requirements:
+ Experience as an AH-6i, MD-500 series, MH-6, OH-58, AH-64 MDS Aircraft Technical Inspector. Note: Post hire AH-6i familiarization course will be required if applicant is not an A&P, AH-6i, MD500 series, MH-6, OH-58 or AH-64 qualified mechanic.
+ Five (5) years’ experience maintaining specific or similar Mission Design Series (MDS).
+ Able to use the Automated Weight and Balance Software (AWBS).
At V2X, we are deeply committed to both equal employment opportunity, including protection for Veterans and individuals with disabilities, and fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We ensure all individuals are treated with fairness, respect, and dignity, recognizing the strength that comes from a workforce rich in diverse experiences, perspectives, and skills. This commitment, aligned with our core Vision and Values of Integrity, Respect, and Responsibility, allows us to leverage differences, encourage innovation, and expand our success in the global marketplace, ultimately enabling us to best serve our clients. #LI-RB1

description:
We are seeking an experienced **Construction Manager** to lead and oversee the execution of multiple construction projects, with a strong focus on on-site operations, technical quality, subcontractor management, and engineering team leadership.

The Construction Manager will be responsible for managing the company’s site engineers and ensuring that all subcontractors execute their works in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, contracts, quality standards, and project schedules.

This is a **field-based role** and requires a highly technical and hands-on construction professional who is capable of identifying execution issues, coordinating different trades, resolving technical problems, and driving projects toward successful completion.

Key responsibilities include managing site engineering teams, supervising subcontractors across all disciplines, coordinating civil, architectural and MEP works, monitoring construction progress, reviewing workmanship quality, resolving site conflicts, controlling sequencing between trades, monitoring material requirements, and ensuring that works are properly completed before inspection and handover.

The Construction Manager will also conduct regular site inspections, lead site coordination meetings, monitor subcontractor performance, identify delays and risks, implement recovery actions when required, and provide management with clear progress updates and recommendations.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant construction experience, preferably with a main contractor or general contracting company.
* Proven experience managing multiple subcontractors across different construction disciplines.
* Strong technical knowledge of civil, architectural, finishing and MEP coordination works.
* Excellent understanding of construction sequencing, site execution methods, drawings, specifications and quality standards.
* Strong experience in building and residential construction projects.
* Proven ability to manage and lead engineers, site supervisors and subcontractors.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills on site.
* Ability to identify construction defects and technical issues before works are concealed or handed over.
* Strong knowledge of project schedules, progress monitoring and recovery planning.
* Experience reviewing subcontractor progress and completed works prior to payment certification.
* Strong communication, leadership and coordination skills.
* Must be comfortable working primarily on construction sites rather than in an office-based role.
* Previous experience in Saudi Arabia or the GCC is preferred.
* Arabic and English communication skills are preferred.

Preferred candidate profile: A hands-on construction professional with strong technical capability and equally strong leadership skills, preferably someone who has worked for a Main Contractor / General Contractor and has directly managed engineers and multiple specialized subcontractors.

description: WISKOTS (Wasim I. S. AlKabour Est. for Inspection) is a Saudi Arabian engineering company specializing in industrial integrity, inspection, maintenance, and specialized asset protection solutions for the energy, petrochemical, utilities, and infrastructure sectors. At WISKOTS, we believe our people are our greatest strength. Supervisory and Team Coordination • Provide technical leadership and work direction to assigned direct reports. • Coordinate with field supervisors, storekeepers, logistics, and procurement personnel throughout the project lifecycle. • Monitor team performance, identify training needs, and escalate conduct or performance concerns appropriately. • Assign tasks, set priorities, and ensure deadlines are met across assigned projects. description:
## Company Description

Join a hotel that is a member of the Accor network, whose group brings together more than 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants and lifestyle destinations. Here, we believe in you and what you bring to the table. There are many opportunities for development and advancement. Every gesture, every smile, every action, contributes to creating a positive and memorable impact for our customers, our colleagues and also for our planet. Together, we embody the vision of responsible hospitality.

Take the opportunity to become a Heartist®, and let your heart guide you in this world where life beats faster.

## Job Description

We are seeking an accomplished and visionary Director of Sales and Marketing to lead our sales and marketing operations in Turaif, Saudi Arabia. In this pivotal leadership role, you will drive revenue growth, develop comprehensive sales and marketing strategies, and build high-performing teams that deliver exceptional results. The ideal candidate will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, fostering innovation while maintaining a strong customer focus across all initiatives.

* Develop and execute comprehensive sales and marketing strategies aligned with organizational objectives and market opportunities in the Saudi Arabian region
* Lead, mentor, and manage sales and marketing teams, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Analyze market trends, competitive landscape, and customer insights to identify growth opportunities and inform strategic decision-making
* Oversee budget management and P&L responsibility, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and maximizing return on investment
* Design and implement targeted marketing campaigns utilizing digital channels, traditional media, and innovative approaches to enhance brand visibility and customer engagement
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to track sales and marketing effectiveness, providing regular performance reviews and strategic recommendations
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, partners, and stakeholders to support business development and market expansion
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product, operations, and customer service teams to ensure seamless execution of sales and marketing initiatives
* Stay current with industry best practices, emerging technologies, and market developments to maintain competitive advantage
* Customize sales and marketing programs to address the unique needs and preferences of the local market

## Qualifications

* Minimum 8+ years of progressive sales and marketing experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership or director-level role
* Proven track record of developing and executing successful sales and marketing strategies that drive revenue growth and market share expansion
* Strong expertise in digital marketing, marketing automation tools, and CRM platforms
* Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and motivate high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment
* Excellent analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis, market research, and business intelligence tools
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels
* Strategic thinking and business acumen with strong financial management capabilities
* Experience in business development and identifying new market opportunities
* Proficiency in customizing marketing programs and sales approaches for diverse customer segments
* Fluency in Arabic (preferred) with strong understanding of Saudi Arabian business culture and market dynamics
* Experience working in the Middle Eastern market or with international organizations (preferred)
* Demonstrated ability to work independently while fostering collaborative team environments
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively

## Additional Information

* Position based at Mövenpick Hotel Waad Al Shamal, Turaif, Saudi Arabia.
    
* Arabic-speaking candidates are preferred.
    
* Must be willing to work and reside in Turaif.
    
* Strong understanding of the local corporate market, particularly mining, industrial, and government sectors, is an advantage.
    
* The candidate must demonstrate a proactive approach to business development, revenue growth, and client relationship management.
    
* Must be committed to delivering excellent guest experiences and maintaining Mövenpick and Accor brand standards.

Job Description

Quality Inspector is mainly tasked with the quality assurance and quality control activities and ensures that NOV quality management system processes and procedures are followed.

- Quality Control Inspectors validate that our materials and manufactured components are compliant. This role involves receiving inspection of incoming material and shop floor inspection of precision machined components and assemblies with tolerances less than 0.001".
- Conduct receiving inspections on incoming material or components for conformance to purchase orders, company drawings, procedures, specifications and Code requirements and then complete any related Receiving Inspection Reports and documentation.
- Use a range of manual measurement tools and fixtures to complete dimensional, in-process, and final inspections on components and assemblies and then prepare any related Dimensional Inspection Reports and documentation.
- Work closely with the Production team to identify non-conformances and take immediate action to support corrective action and resolution of all issues.
- Prepare comprehensive Non-Conformance Reports and Corrective Action Reports in a timely manner for review by the QC Manager or QC Supervisor.
- Assist with Quality Surveillance of sub suppliers.
- Responsible for keeping equipment and work area clean and orderly and perform basic preventative maintenance functions on equipment as required.
- Experience in oil and gas will be an added value.
- Required to adhere and comply with Saudi law, the Company policies and procedures; ISO Quality Program and procedures, Company policies and Safety and Environmental Regulations.
- May perform other duties as assigned by Supervisor / Manager.
Facility Specific Responsibilities:
Have a good exposer on advanced measuring instruments & Inspection of parts, assemblies and final product.
- Verify all the record material with ref to work order.
- Must be able to follow written and oral instructions.
- Must be adaptable to a changing work environment, competing demands and is able to deal with frequent change, delays or unexpected events.
- Must be willing and able to work flexible shifts and changing work schedules.

Diploma or equivalent Experience in the same industry.
4-5 years of experience.

Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.

We Power the Industry that Powers the World
Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.

Global Family
We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.

Purposeful Innovation
Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.

Service Above All
This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

The osteopath travels with the family: when they leave Jeddah for Paris, hands-on care continues without a break, and you decide how it is delivered. Registration, references and training history are checked by us first, with nothing taken on trust. Medical Staff Talent introduces and verifies; it does not employ, so the family meets only an osteopath we have vetted. Benefits Your gross compensation sits at £79,500 – £94,500, for a role held with unsupervised responsibility. The salary is agreed directly between the family and the clinician; each clinician should take advice from their own tax adviser on whether the income is taxable in their circumstances. Your residence and the cost of the move are covered by the family, with nothing to arrange on your own. Flights home are provided by the family, which keeps a long-term osteopath post sustainable. You sign with the family itself, never with us, and nothing is left to assumption. Engagement essentials Availability to begin within six weeks of offer. Live-in and single-status: the role suits clinicians who relocate alone, with full flexibility to travel worldwide with the family at short notice. description:
Job Description

Main Duties: Media Archiving & Asset Management

Catalog, index, and archive video footage, photographs, and other digital media assets in the organization’s media asset management system.

Ensure all archived materials are properly tagged, categorized, and stored according to established metadata and archival standards.

Maintain the integrity and accessibility of the digital media archive to support newsroom and editorial needs.

Content Retrieval & Editorial Support

Provide timely retrieval of archived materials requested by journalists, producers, editors, and digital teams.

Assist editorial teams in locating relevant footage, images, and historical materials to support news coverage, reports, and feature stories.

Support urgent newsroom requests during live coverage and breaking news situations.

Media Operations Coordination

Coordinate with editorial, production, and digital teams to ensure proper ingestion and documentation of newly produced media assets.

Monitor media workflows to ensure accurate archiving and compliance with internal media management procedures.

Assist in maintaining efficient operational processes within the Library & Media department.

Quality Control & Compliance

Ensure the accuracy, quality, and completeness of archived materials and associated metadata.

Verify usage rights, licensing information, and source attribution where applicable.

Maintain compliance with organizational policies related to content management, copyright, and media usage.

System & Database Management

Support the operation and optimization of the organization’s Media Asset Management (MAM) or Digital Asset Management (DAM) systems.

Assist in updating and improving archival systems, processes, and workflows to enhance accessibility and operational efficiency.

Contribute to periodic audits and reviews of archived media content.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As an Receiving Clerk, you’re not just supporting timely and accurate billing and payment collections – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:
Process invoices and commissions: Generate accurate invoices and ensure timely payment or deduction of travel agent commissions
Maintain account accuracy: Post charges and credits promptly and reconcile subsidiary ledgers with the general ledger
Monitor and collect payments: Follow up on outstanding balances to maintain positive cash flow and reduce overdue accounts
Resolve billing issues: Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve disputes
Prepare and send statements: Issue timely account statements, targeting daily delivery

Building on the expertise of Elia Group (Belgium) and 50Hertz (Germany) ,EGI delivers strategic, technical, and regulatory advisory services to tackle complex challenges of the energy transition. Key Responsibilities: EAM / APM Solution Delivery Lead or support requirement gathering, functional design, configuration, and implementation of EAM and APM platforms, or similar solutions. Act as a functional SME for asset management processes during implementation projects, upgrades, and rollouts. Support system configuration , validation, testing, and user acceptance activities. Reliability & Risk-Based Maintenance Contribute to RCM, RBM, FMECA/FMEA, AHI (Asset Health Index) , and risk-based maintenance frameworks for key utility asset classes Support translation of reliability and risk models into EAM/APM system logic , thresholds, and workflows. APM & Condition Monitoring Enablement Support APM use cases including: Condition monitoring integration Asset health scoring Failure probability and criticality assessment Predictive and diagnostic analytics enablement Work with data and analytics teams to ensure asset-centric data structures support APM outcomes. description:
## Company Description

The FAENA Movement is a journey of art, culture, and community. Rooted in the soulful traditions of the South and elevated by imaginative design, our culture celebrates authentic hospitality and transformative experiences. We create spaces where dreams are brought to life—through bold ideas, meaningful collaboration, and a deep sense of purpose.  
  
As we continue our expansion into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, **FAENA The Red Sea** will mark a new chapter—visionary in spirit, exceptional in execution. We’re building more than a hotel; we’re shaping a world of beauty, wonder, and connection. If you’re driven by creativity, excellence, and a desire to be part of something extraordinary, we invite you to help bring this vision to life.

## Job Description

At Faena The Red Sea, wellness is immersive, transformative, and deeply personal. As a **Spa Therapist**, you will create exceptional experiences that restore balance, inspire relaxation, and elevate the guest journey through intuitive care and world-class treatments.

This role is responsible for delivering luxury spa services including massages, facials, and body therapies while ensuring the highest levels of professionalism, hygiene, and guest satisfaction. The ideal candidate is passionate about wellness, attentive to detail, and dedicated to creating meaningful and memorable moments for every guest.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform professional spa treatments including massages, facials, body scrubs, and wellness therapies in line with Faena luxury standards
* Assess guest needs and preferences to personalize treatments and ensure maximum comfort and satisfaction
* Maintain the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and sanitation within treatment rooms, equipment, and spa areas
* Prepare treatment rooms before each appointment and ensure rooms are reset following treatments
* Ensure proper handling, usage, and storage of spa products, oils, tools, linens, and equipment
* Deliver exceptional guest service with warmth, professionalism, and attention to detail throughout the guest journey
* Promote wellness and relaxation while creating a calm and welcoming environment for all guests
* Educate guests on treatment benefits, aftercare recommendations, and wellness routines
* Support spa retail initiatives by recommending suitable spa and wellness products to guests
* Follow all spa operational procedures, health and safety regulations, and brand standards
* Maintain punctuality and manage treatment schedules efficiently to ensure seamless operations
* Communicate effectively with spa reception and fellow team members regarding guest preferences, schedules, and operational updates
* Handle guest concerns or feedback professionally and escalate when required
* Stay updated on new wellness trends, treatment techniques, and luxury spa practices
* Participate in training sessions, team meetings, and ongoing development programs
* Ensure guest confidentiality and privacy are always maintained

## Qualifications

* Diploma or certification in Massage Therapy, Spa Therapy, Beauty Therapy, Wellness Therapy, or a related field.
* Minimum 2–4 years of experience as a Spa Therapist within a luxury hotel, resort, wellness retreat, or high-end spa environment.
* Proven ability to perform a variety of treatments including massages, facials, and body therapies.
* Additional certifications in specialized treatments such as Aromatherapy, Hot Stone Therapy, Deep Tissue Massage, Reflexology, or Lymphatic Drainage are highly desirable.
* Valid First Aid and CPR certification preferred.
* Strong understanding of spa hygiene, sanitation, and health & safety practices in accordance with luxury hospitality standards.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build genuine guest connections.
* Warm, professional, and well-groomed presentation with a passion for wellness and guest care.
* Ability to work flexible schedules including weekends, evenings, and public holidays as required by operational needs.
* Fluent English communication skills required; additional languages including Arabic are an advantage.
* Strong teamwork skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced luxury hospitality environment.

description:
Bring your curiosity, leadership, and professionalism to strengthen compliance, support innovation, and help the firm navigate change.

As a Vice President in Corporate Tax within the EMEA Corporate Tax team, you will lead day-to-day corporate income tax and VAT affairs for entities in the GCC, supporting compliance, advisory, and strategic initiatives. You will partner closely with the regional tax lead; stakeholders across lines of business, Finance, and Management; and external advisors to assess new business initiatives, reorganizations, and operational changes. You will manage relationships with tax authorities, lead or support audits and enquiries, and anticipate regulatory changes to maintain readiness. You will help define governance expectations, promote consistent controls, and communicate actionable guidance with clarity and influence.

This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and reports to the tax lead for the MENA region who is based in Dubai.

Job responsibilities

Own day-to-day corporate income tax and VAT affairs for legal entities across the region, ensuring timely compliance and high-quality advice.

Support assessment and approval of new business initiatives and corporate reorganizations from corporate income tax and VAT perspectives, in partnership with the regional Head of Tax.

Manage relationships with tax authorities; lead and support audits, enquiries, and information requests.

Engage with lines of business, Finance, and Management to understand operations and developments; identify and advise on key tax issues affecting the region.

Coordinate with external advisors and collaborate with the broader EMEA Corporate Tax team to deliver consistent outcomes.

Monitor evolving tax rules and obligations in the GCC; translate changes into practical guidance, controls, and implementation plans.

Prepare clear analyses, memos, and communications that frame issues, options, and recommendations for stakeholders.

Drive process improvements that strengthen compliance, documentation quality, and audit readiness.

Maintain governance and risk alignment for corporate taxes and VAT; escalate and remediate issues promptly.

Track, prioritize, and deliver multiple projects with accountability and transparency.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

Arabic and English language proficiency.

Professional accounting or tax qualification.

Demonstrated corporate income tax and VAT experience in the GCC, ideally within financial services.

Working knowledge of governance and risk principles applicable to corporate taxes and VAT.

Professional proficiency in written and verbal communication.

Strong analytical and critical thinking to develop commercially sound solutions.

Ability to work independently, manage workload and projects, and meet deadlines.

Collaborative mindset and interpersonal skills to build relationships across diverse stakeholders.

Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

Ability to produce clear documentation and present recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

In-house or professional services background supporting financial services firms.

Familiarity with GCC tax authority practices and systems, including Saudi rules and processes.

Experience with cross-border reorganizations and business change approvals.

Exposure to ERP or finance systems and data flows that impact tax compliance and reporting.

Experience coordinating external advisors and multi-jurisdictional tax projects.

Ability to develop process improvements and control enhancements in tax operations.

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we’re setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

## Company Description

**Join** **us at Accor,** **where** **life pulses** **with** **passion!**​

As a pioneer in the art of responsible hospitality, the Accor Group gathers more than 45 brands, 5,600 hotels, 10,000 restaurants, and lifestyle destinations in 110 countries. While each brand has its own personality, where you will be able to truly find yourself, they all share a common ambition: to keep innovating and challenging the status-quo.​

By joining us, you will become a Heartist®, because hospitality is, first and foremost, a work of heart.​

You will join a caring environment and a team where you can be all you are. You will be in a supportive place to grow, to fulfil yourself, to discover other professions and to pursue career opportunities, in your hotel or in other hospitality environments, in your country or anywhere in the world!​

You will enjoy exclusive benefits, specific to the sector and beyond, as well as strong recognition for your daily commitment.​

Everything you will do with us, regardless of your profession, will offer a deep sense of meaning, to create lasting, memorable and impactful experiences for your customers, for your colleagues and for the planet.

**Hospitality** **is** **a** **work** **of** **heart****,**​  
**Join** **us and** **become** **a** **Heartist****®.**

## Job Description

As a Recreation Attendant you are responsible to provide warm, engaging and authentically local personalized service to all guests who utilize the facilities.

**What you will be doing:**

* Actively engage with guests and assist in all guests’ needs, which may include, but are not limited to: issuing towels, issuing chaise lounge covers, assist in chaise lounge set-up, and cabana set-up.
* Pick up and remove used towels and debris from the pool deck areas throughout the day.
* Provide unique experiences to all of our guests through warm, personal & detailed service in a luxury, upscale and fast paced environment.
* Ensure a positive first impression of the pool for our guests through detailed cleanliness, set-up and ambiance control.
* Maintain complete knowledge of all wellness & recreation services, activities, amenities and hotel services/features.
* Up-sell and promote wellness & recreation offers at every available opportunity in order to maximize sales revenue.
* Perform opening/closing side duties as assigned and set the pool according to standards and procedures.
* Be well versed in hotel fire & life safety/emergency procedures.
* Maintain a high standard of personal appearance and hygiene at all times.
* Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the Management of the Hotel.

description:
The Senior Manager, HSE is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing Health, Safety, and Environmental strategies, systems, and compliance programs across projects and operations. The role ensures that all activities are performed safely, sustainably, and in accordance with applicable regulations, company policies, and international best practices.

### Key Responsibilities

* Drive a strong safety culture across projects and operational teams through leadership, coaching, and awareness programs.
* Monitor compliance with local regulations, international standards, and company HSE requirements.
* Oversee HSE performance across contractors, consultants, and project teams.
* Conduct regular site inspections, audits, and compliance reviews to identify risks and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Lead incident investigations, root cause analysis, and lessons learned initiatives.
* Develop and monitor HSE KPIs, dashboards, and management reports.
* Ensure environmental management plans are implemented, including waste management, pollution prevention, sustainability, and resource conservation initiatives.
* Review project designs, construction methodologies, and operational activities to identify and mitigate HSE risks.
* Manage emergency preparedness and response plans, including drills and crisis management procedures.
* Support procurement and contract management teams on HSE requirements and contractor prequalification processes.
* Provide regular HSE updates and recommendations to senior management.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in occupational health & safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
