description:
### **Job Description**

## Overview

The Project Control Manager is responsible for planning, monitoring, controlling, and reporting project performance across scope, schedule, cost, risk, and resources. The role ensures projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with organizational objectives by establishing robust project controls, governance frameworks, and performance reporting mechanisms.

## Your role

**Project Planning & Control**

* Develop and maintain project control frameworks, procedures, and standards.
* Establish project baselines for scope, schedule, and budget.
* Monitor project progress against planned milestones and deliverables.
* Identify schedule variances and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure effective change management and configuration control processes.

**Cost Management**

* Track project budgets, forecasts, commitments, and expenditures.
* Analyze cost performance and provide variance reports.
* Support financial planning, budgeting, and cost optimization initiatives.
* Ensure accurate project financial reporting and compliance.

**Schedule Management**

* Develop and maintain integrated project schedules using project management tools.
* Conduct schedule risk analysis and critical path assessments.
* Monitor project milestones and provide schedule performance reports.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to mitigate delays and project risks.

**Risk & Performance Management**

* Identify, assess, and monitor project risks and opportunities.
* Maintain risk registers and mitigation plans.
* Develop key performance indicators (KPIs) and project dashboards.
* Provide trend analysis and performance insights to leadership teams.

**Reporting & Governance**

* Prepare and present project status reports for senior management.
* Facilitate project review meetings and governance forums.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, standards, and contractual requirements.
* Support audits and project assurance activities.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with project managers, finance teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Communicate project performance, risks, and issues effectively.
* Support decision-making through accurate and timely project data and analysis.

## About you

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management, Finance, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in project controls, project management, PMO, or related disciplines.
* Experience managing large-scale projects and cross-functional stakeholders.
* PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-SP, or similar certification preferred.

## Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Tax-free salary.
* Life insurance coverage.
* Medical insurance.
* Annual leave balance.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Annual flight contribution.
* Transportation & housing allowances.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, familycare, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

## About AtkinsRéalis

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

[Find out more.](https://careers.atkinsrealis.com/)

### **Worker Type**

Employee

### **Job Type**

Regular

*At* *AtkinsRéalis**, we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.* 

  

Created by the integration of long-standing organizations dating back to 1911, AtkinsRéalis is a world-class engineering services and nuclear company dedicated to engineering a better future for our planet and its people. We create sustainable solutions that connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. We deploy global capabilities locally to our clients and deliver unique end-to-end services across the whole life cycle of an asset including consulting, advisory & environmental services, intelligent networks & cybersecurity, design & engineering, procurement, project & construction management, operations & maintenance, decommissioning and capital. The breadth and depth of our capabilities are delivered to clients in strategic sectors such as Engineering Services, Nuclear and Capital. News and information are available at [Atkinsrealis](http://www.atkinsrealis.com/) or follow us on [LinkedIn](http://www.linkedin.com/company/atkinsrealis/).

description:
The Senior Manager - Entertainment Operations Maintenance (Supply Chain & workforce competency) establishes and governs the frameworks at corporate level, applicable portfolio wise:

▪ Technical Supply Chain Governance - sets portfolio requirements for critical spares part, tools, inventory, central warehousing and lifecycle support; across SEVEN stakeholders

▪  Technical Training & Competency Management - defines competency standards, training pathways, assessment evidence and portfolio tracking

▪ Technical Document Control - governs technical files, asset information, records and document-management structures; management of changes.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES/ ACCOUNTABILITIES**

▪  Establish, maintain and periodically review the corporate frameworks, policies and minimum controls for the assigned disciplines

▪ Define clear governance boundaries: set the framework, monitors implementation and reports systemic issues

▪ Develop and maintain the technical supply chain framework for attraction maintenance, covering critical spares, consumables, special tools, test equipment, inventory criticality, obsolescence and lifecycle support.  
▪ Define minimum requirements of assets listed under the Master asset list system; simultaneously defining spare parts, and consumables classification, specifications, master data, traceability, storage and preservation, stock-control principles and EAM/ERP/CMMS linkage.  
▪ Establish standard templates and controls for technical requisitions, OEM/vendor information, long-lead visibility, warranty support and supplier-performance reporting, and support portfolio vendor strategies with the corporate stakeholders (Finance, Payroll, Procurement, Logistics, and IT).  
▪ Manage Central Warehouse receiving operations, including physical and documentary verification of incoming items, quantity and condition checks, discrepancy recording and escalation, system receipt and Goods Receipt Note (GRN) processing, and appropriate storage, preservation, traceability and stock visibility.  
▪ Review complex implementation and portfolio data through periodic functional governance assessments, report systemic risks affecting availability, maintainability or cost, and initiate corrective actions based on his own audits, department’s observations, and internal, external, or authority audits findings.

▪ Establish and maintain the corporate framework for role-, asset- and task-based competency requirements, training pathways, assessment evidence, authorisation levels and renewal criteria.  
▪ Own the corporate competency framework, tracker methodology and consolidated portfolio competency view. Maintain a clear distinction between training attendance, assessed competence.  
▪ Define minimum templates and records for training, assessment, refresher activities, mentoring and OEM knowledge transfer in coordination with Learning & Development and approved providers.  
▪ Monitor framework implementation and competency-data quality, using governance reviews, performance trends, incidents, internal or external audit findings, OEM recommendations and other stakeholder inputs to identify gaps, expiries and capability risks.  
▪ Define and initiate actions, such as new or revised training materials, toolbox talks, refresher or remedial training, competency reassessment or updated requirements, and track implementation and effectiveness through the responsible Complex Technical Managers.

▪ Develop and maintain the corporate technical document-control framework, covering ownership, review, approval, revision, access, distribution, retention, supersession and handover.  
▪ Define standard technical-file requirements, registers, naming conventions, attributes, metadata, taxonomies and EDMS or shared-drive structures for attraction technical information and records.  
▪ Define, in coordination with Asset Management and EAM/CMMS/IT system owners, asset-information requirements, including classification, master data, tagging and links between assets, maintenance plans, documents, spare parts, tools and competency requirements within EAM/CMMS/ERP systems.  
▪ Review complex-level implementation, completeness, currentness and accessibility through periodic functional governance assessments; report gaps and follow up closure.

**Requirements**

▪ Bachelor's degree in supply chain, logistics, business administration, operations, asset management, engineering or another relevant discipline.  
▪ A postgraduate qualification in management, operations, logistics or a related discipline is desirable.  
▪ Professional qualification in supply chain, logistics or transport is desirable.  
▪ Relevant ERP/EAM/CMMS, document management, or technical training and competency certification is advantageous.

Document maintenance activities: Record completed inspections and repairs and flag any issues requiring further attention

description:
### **Job Description**

## Overview

  

A Quantity Surveyor (QS) plays a critical role in ensuring the commercial and contractual success of construction and infrastructure projects. This role involves overseeing costs, managing contracts, assessing commercial risks, and supporting project teams in achieving financially efficient project delivery. The QS acts as a commercial advisor, ensuring compliance with contract terms, financial accuracy, and robust documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

  

## Your role

  

* Review and process IPCs, ensuring checklists are completed and approvals/ payment workflows are followed.
* Review RFCs, VOs, and other commercial change documents, providing clear commercial assessment.
* Support commercial discussions with vendors to resolve issues (IPCs, RFCs, VOs, EOTs, Final Accounts).
* Maintain key commercial logs (contract expiry, payment tracking). Prepare contract addenda/ amendments as needed. Review RFQs/RFPs and raise Sourcing Requests (SRs) and Purchase Requests (PRs) in SAP Ariba.
* Support internal audits by collecting required documentation.
* Review insurance and bond submissions and provide comments.
* Attend commercial meetings and coordinate between Engineers, PMCs, Vendors, and internal stakeholders.

  

## About you

  

* Previous experience of FIDIC Contracts preferred.
* Degree in Quantity Surveying from recognized university.
* Min 5 years post-degree relevant experience in contracts and commercial management.

  

## Rewards & benefits

  

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Tax-free salary.
* Life insurance coverage.
* Medical insurance.
* Annual leave balance.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Annual flight contribution.
* Transportation & housing allowances.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

  

## About AtkinsRéalis  


We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

[Find out more.](https://careers.atkinsrealis.com/)

  

### **Worker Type**

Employee

### **Job Type**

Regular

*At* *AtkinsRéalis**, we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.* 

  

Created by the integration of long-standing organizations dating back to 1911, AtkinsRéalis is a world-class engineering services and nuclear company dedicated to engineering a better future for our planet and its people. We create sustainable solutions that connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. We deploy global capabilities locally to our clients and deliver unique end-to-end services across the whole life cycle of an asset including consulting, advisory & environmental services, intelligent networks & cybersecurity, design & engineering, procurement, project & construction management, operations & maintenance, decommissioning and capital. The breadth and depth of our capabilities are delivered to clients in strategic sectors such as Engineering Services, Nuclear and Capital. News and information are available at [Atkinsrealis](http://www.atkinsrealis.com/) or follow us on [LinkedIn](http://www.linkedin.com/company/atkinsrealis/).
